content: You can’t use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 创新取之不尽用之不竭，越用越多。

content: Life is about making an impact, not making an income.
author: Kevin Kruse
translation: 生命在于影响他人，而非赚钱糊口。

content: Jumping from failure to failure with undiminished enthusiasm is the big secret to success.
author: Savas Dimopoulos
translation: 越过一次次失败，却不丧失热情，才是成功的伟大秘诀。

content: OED wears its status with a magisterial self-assurance, not least by giving its half million definitions a robustly Victorian certitude of tone.
author: 《教授与疯子》
translation: 《牛津英语词典》以一种威严的自信来显示它的重要地位，以维多利亚时代那种坚决肯定的语气来定义五十万个词语，尤其体现这种自信。

content: As time passed, life became more and more comfortable for us all.
author: 《鲁滨逊漂流记》
translation: 岁月悠然而逝，我们享受这样平静舒适的生活。

content: We become what we think about.
author: Earl Nightingale
translation: 我们思考什么，就会变成什么。

content: When conceived it was a project of almost unimaginable boldness and foolhardiness, requiring great bravura, risking great hubris.
author: 《教授与疯子》
translation: 工程的构想可谓不知天高地厚，勇气大得不可思议，完成它需要大胆的尝试，也冒着惨重失败的危险。

content: What you believe, remember, you can achieve.
author: 玫琳凯·艾施
translation: 记住，你相信什么，就能成就什么。

content: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
author: 沃尔特·迪斯尼
translation: 开始做事的方法就是，停止空谈，付诸行动。

content: Just do the best you can. No one can do more than that
author: 约翰·伍登
translation: 唯有竭尽全力，此外别无他法。

content: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 你注定只会成为你决心要变成的那个人。

content: Leave nothing for tomorrow which can be done today.
author: 林肯
translation: 今天能做的，就不要拖到明天。

content: Press forward. Do not stop, do not linger in your journey, but strive for the mark set before you.
author: George Whitefield
translation: 继续前行！不要停下脚步！不要在路上流连！向着前面的目标奋进！

content: If you hear a voice within you say “you cannot paint,” then by all means paint and that voice will be silenced.
author: 梵高
translation: 如果你听到自己心里说“你画不好”，那就竭尽全力画好，那个声音就会乖乖闭嘴。

content: How many roads must a man walk down, before you call him a man?
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 人要走多少路，才能称得上是男子汉？

content: All I can do is be me, whoever that is.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 我所能做的只有做自己，无论我是谁。

content: Don't criticize what you can't understand.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 不要批评你不了解的事。

content: Limitations live only in our minds. But if we use our imaginations, our possibilities become limitless.
author: Jamie Paolinetti
translation: 思维有限，但我们的想象力能造就无限可能。

content: Out of difficulties grow miracles.
author: 尚·德·拉布鲁耶
translation: 艰难之中孕育着奇迹。

content: What you do today can improve all your tomorrows.
author: 拉尔夫·马尔斯通
translation: 你今天的付出会让你所有的明天都更好。

content: Education costs money. But then so does ignorance.
author: Sir Claus Moser
translation: 教育很费钱，无知更费钱。

content: Don't limit yourself. You can go as far as your mind lets you.
author: 玫琳凯·艾施
translation: 不要框住自己。你想得有多远，就能走多远。

content: Do you love humanity and to save it？
author: 电影《但丁密码》
translation: 你热爱人类并且愿意去拯救他们吗？

content: Be sure you put your feet in the right place; then stand firm.
author: 林肯
translation: 让自己的双脚站在正确的位置，然后站稳。

content: A river cuts through rock, not because of its power, but because of its persistence.
author: James N. Watkins
translation: 河流可以切碎岩石，并非因其力大无穷，乃是因为坚持不懈。

content: Don't watch the clock. Do what it does. Keep going.
author: 山姆·勒文森
translation: 不要只看时钟，要效仿时钟，一直前行。

content: Happiness isn't something you put inside, it's already there. Sometimes you just need someone to help you find it.
author: 电影《魔发精灵》
translation: 幸福不需要你把它放入内心，它本来就在你心底。有时，你只需要某个人来帮你找到它。

content: Always do your best. What you plant now, you will harvest later.
author: Og Mandino
translation: 总要竭尽全力。你播种什么，就会收获什么。

content: Press forward. Do not stop, do not linger in your journey, but strive for the mark set before you.
author: George Whitefield
translation: 继续前行！不要停下脚步！不要在路上流连！向着前面的目标奋进！

content: Success is falling nine times and getting up ten.
author: 邦·乔维
translation: 成功就是跌倒九次，第十次仍会站起来。

content: Care and diligence bring luck.
author: 托马斯·富勒
translation: 细心和勤奋能带来好运。

content: Knowing is not enough; we must apply. Willing is not enough; we must do.
author: 歌德
translation: 获得知识并不够，还要去应用；立下志向也不够，还要去行动。

content: Halloween is an opportunity to be really creative.
author: Judy Gold
translation: 万圣节前夜是挥洒创意的好时机。

content: Do not fear to be eccentric in opinion, for every opinion now accepted was once eccentric.
author: Bertrand Russell
translation: 不要害怕想法怪异，现在被接受的想法曾经都是怪异的。

content: It is not beauty that endears, it’s love that makes us see beauty.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 并非美丽招人爱，而是爱让我们看到了美丽。

content: Dream is an exciting and alluring place, where everything is achievable.
author: 电影《蜡笔小新：梦境世界大突击》
translation: 梦是一个让人激动兴奋的充满诱惑的世界，在梦里的话，不管什么事都做得到。

content: We can't help everyone, but everyone can help someone.
author: Ronald Reagan
translation: 我们不能帮助所有人，但每个人都能帮到别人。

content: Your big opportunity may be right where you are now.
author: 拿破仑·希尔
translation: 你的黄金机遇就在眼前！

content: Never give up, for that's just the place and time that the tide will turn.
author: 哈丽特·斯托伊
translation: 永远不要放弃，此时此地即将峰回路转。

content: Good manners and soft words have brought many a difficult thing to pass.
author: Sir John Vanbrugh
translation: 礼貌的行为和温柔的话语会让很多难题迎刃而解。

content: There is nothing impossible to him who will try.
author: 亚历山大大帝
translation: 对勇于尝试的人来说，没有不可能。

content: When faced with our darkest hour, hope is not a tactic.
author: 《深海浩劫》
translation: 面临最黑暗的时刻，仅仅抱有希望可不是什么好办法。

content: "Single" is an opportunity to live life on your own terms and not apologize.
author: Mandy Hale
translation: 单身是可以为自己而生活且无需抱歉的良机。

content: There is a crack in everything. That's how the light gets in.
author: 莱昂纳德·科恩
translation: 万事万物中都有裂缝，这样光才能照射进来。

content: Do not seek to follow in the footsteps of the men of old; seek what they sought.
author: Basho
translation: 不要追寻先人的足迹，追寻先人所追寻的吧！

content: What we think, what we know, or what we believe is, in the end, of little consequence. The only consequence is what we do.
author: 约翰·拉斯金
translation: 我们所思、所知和所信仰的终究影响甚微；能带来影响的只有我们的行为。

content: I did what I could, and I survived, there gotta be a reason.
author: 《深海浩劫》
translation: 我竭尽全力活了下来，那就不能白活。

content: Good, better, best. Never let it rest. 'Til your good is better and your better is best.
author: 哲罗姆
translation: 好，更好，最好。永远不要停下来，直到你的好变得更好，更好变得最好。

content: I am not bound to win, but I am bound to be true.
author: 林肯
translation: 我并非一定要获胜，但我一定要真实。

content: A will finds a way.
author: 奥里森·斯韦特·马登
translation: 心怀志向，总能找到出路。

content: Try to be a rainbow in someone's cloud.
author: 玛雅·安吉罗
translation: 当有人身处阴霾之下时，尽力去做他们的彩虹。

content: There is always room at the top.
author: 丹尼尔·韦伯斯特
translation: 即使到达顶峰，也还会有进步空间。

content: Thought is the wind, knowledge the sail, and mankind the vessel.
author: 奥古斯都·海尔
translation: 思想是风，知识是帆，人性是船。

content: Give light, and the darkness will disappear of itself.
author: 伊拉斯谟
translation: 有了光，黑暗就会自行消失。

content: If the world seems cold to you, kindle fires to warm it.
author: 露西·拉克姆
translation: 如果你觉得这世界一片冰冷，就点燃火焰去温暖它。

content: If you are really thankful, what do you do? You share.
author: W·克莱门特·斯通
translation: 如果你真的心存感激，你该怎么做？分享给他人。

content: My philosophy is if you worry, you suffer twice.
author: 《神奇动物在哪里》
translation: 我的人生信条是：遇事发愁，只会给你平添痛苦。

content: The good life is one inspired by love and guided by knowledge.
author: 罗素
translation: 美好生活是以爱为动力，以知识为向导的。

content: Even if I knew that tomorrow the world would go to pieces, I would still plant my apple tree.
author: 马丁·路德
translation: 即便明天就是世界末日，我仍会种下我的苹果树。

content: Keep your face always toward the sunshine—and shadows will fall behind you.
author: 惠特曼
translation: 总是面向阳光，阴影就会被甩在身后。

content: When the sun is shining I can do anything; no mountain is too high, no trouble too difficult to overcome.
author: 威尔玛·鲁道夫
translation: 只要阳光普照，一切我都可以做到——没有翻不过的高山，没有战胜不了的困难。

content: The real test of good manners is to be able to put up with bad manners pleasantly.
author: Kahlil Gilbran
translation: 对礼貌真正的考验在于能否愉快地忍受粗鲁。

content: Do whatever you do intensely.
author: 罗伯特·亨利
translation: 无论做什么，总要满怀热情。

content: Wherever you may end up in this world, I will be searching for you.
author: 《你的名字。》
translation: 不管你在世界的哪个地方，我一定会再次去见你的。

content: No man is rich enough to buy back his past.
author: 王尔德
translation: 没有人富有到可以赎回自己的过去。

content: Woke up this morning with a terrific urge to lie in bed all day and read.
author: 雷蒙德·卡佛
translation: 今早醒来，特别想躺在床上读书，一整天。

content: Step by step and the thing is done.
author: 查尔斯·阿特拉斯
translation: 一步一个脚印，就能迈向成功。

content: Change is the law of life. And those who look only to the past or present are certain to miss the future.
author: 约翰·F.肯尼迪
translation: 变革才是生活之道。眼下只有过去和现在的人，注定失去未来。

content: Opportunity is missed by most people because it is dressed in overalls and looks like work.
author: Thomas Edison
translation: 机会被大多数人错失的原因是，它穿着工装打扮成了工作的样子。

content: The only place success comes before work is in the dictionary.
author: 文斯·兰巴蒂
translation: 成功排在努力之前这回事，只能在字典里看到。

content: Happiness, it comes on unexpectedly. And goes beyond, really, any early morning talk about it.
author: 雷蒙德·卡佛
translation: 幸福，在不经意间降临，它着实胜过每个谈论幸福的清晨。

content: There are some things you learn best in calm, and some in storm.
author: 维拉·凯瑟
translation: 你会在风平浪静时学一些事情，在暴风骤雨时学会另一些。

content: I can't change the direction of the wind, but I can adjust my sails to always reach my destination.
author: 吉米·迪恩
translation: 我无法改变风向，却可以常常调节船帆到达目的地。

content: You know what charm is: a way of getting the answer yes without having asked any clear question.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 你知道，魅力就是不用问得很直白，就能得到肯定的答复。

content: I abhor war and view it as the greatest scourge of mankind.
author: Thomas Jefferson
translation: 我痛恨战争，并视其为人类最大的祸害。

content: Some people feel the rain. Others just get wet.
author: Roger Miller
translation: 有些人能感受雨，而其他人只是被雨淋湿。

content: As long as we got each other, we got the world spinnin' right in our hands.
author: 《成长的烦恼》主题曲
translation: 只要我们在一起，世界就在我们的掌心转动。

content: A single idea from the human mind can build cities. An idea can transform the world and rewrite all the rules.
author: 《盗梦空间》
translation: 人的一个简单想法可以创造城市，一个念头可以改变世界，重写一切规则。

content: All you need is the plan, the road map, and the courage to press on to your destination.
author: 厄尔·南丁格尔
translation: 你只需要订好计划，准备好地图，鼓起向目标前进的勇气。

content: At its best, schooling can be about how to make a life, which is quite different from how to make a living.
author: Neil Postman
translation: 教育最好的地方在于：不是教人怎么生存，而是教人如何生活。

content: We aim above the mark to hit the mark.
author: 拉尔夫·华尔多·爱默生
translation: 我们瞄准时箭头稍高出靶心，才能射中靶心。

content: All we can do is do our best to relish this remarkable ride.
author: 《时空恋旅人》
translation: 我们唯一能做的，就是好好珍惜这段不凡的旅程。

content: In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 在隆冬，我终于知道，我的内心有一个永不凋零的夏天。

content: Every day may not be good, but there is something good in every day.
author: 爱丽丝·摩丝·厄尔
translation: 并非每天都很美好，但每天都有美好的事情发生。

content: Time goes on and on, never to an end but crossings.
author: 电影《摆渡人》
translation: 时间一直走，没有尽头，只有路口。

content: My goodness, no one gives a gift to Santa Claus!
author: Michael Brown
translation: 天啊，竟然没有人给圣诞老人送礼物！

content: Christmas is doing a little something extra for someone.
author: Charles M. Schulz
translation: 圣诞节就是为一些人多做一点事。

content: Live your beliefs and you can turn the world around.
author: 亨利·大卫·梭罗
translation: 践行你所信仰的，你可以让整个世界转动。

content: The best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas.
author: Linus Pauling
translation: 找到好点子的最佳办法就是多想点子。

content: Happiness resides not in possessions, and not in gold; happiness dwells in the soul.
author: 德谟克利特
translation: 幸福不在财富之中，也不在黄金堆里，幸福在灵魂深处。

content: If it adapts itself to what the majority of our society wants, art will be a meaningless recreation.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 艺术如果去迎合我们的主流社会的要求，就会变成毫无意义的消遣。

content: Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds that you plant.
author: 罗伯特·路易斯·斯蒂文森
translation: 不要因你收获的来评断这一天，而要通过你播种的来评断。

content: You'll never find peace of mind until you listen to your heart.
author: George Michael
translation: 只有倾听自己心底的声音，你才能找到内心的平静。

content: New Year — a new chapter, new verse, or just the same old story? Ultimately we write it.
author: Alex Morritt
translation: 新年是新章节，还是同样的老故事？终究还得靠我们自己来书写。

content: I believe in living today. Not in yesterday, nor in tomorrow.
author: 洛丽泰·扬
translation: 我相信活在今天，不是昨天，也不是明天。

content: The best work is not what is most difficult for you; it is what you do best.
author: 萨特
translation: 最好的工作不是做你认为最难的，而是你最擅长的。

content: What you believe, remember, you can achieve.
author: 玫琳凯·艾施
translation: 记住，你相信什么，就能成就什么。

content: The only thing that separates you from others is your quirks, or even flaws.
author: Natalie Portman
translation: 使你与众不同的正是你的那些怪癖，甚至缺点。

content: Don't complain, don't explain.
author: 雷蒙德·卡佛
translation: 不抱怨，不解释。

content: When things are bad, it's the best time to reinvent yourself.
author: 乔治·洛佩兹
translation: 形势艰难之时，正是重新塑造自己的最佳时机。

content: A strong woman may be stronger than a man, particularly if she happens to have love in her heart.
author: John Steinbeck
translation: 女人坚强起来可能更胜过男人，特别是在她心怀爱意时。

content: Your spirit is strong enough to survive any situation.
author: 莱拉·姬芙蒂·阿奇塔
translation: 你的精神可以强大到助你度过所有境遇。

content: The world is full of magical things patiently waiting for our wits to grow sharper.
author: 罗素
translation: 这世界充满了神奇，只待我们变得更加睿智。

content: Learn to say "no" to the good so you can say "yes" to the best.
author: 约翰·C.麦克斯韦尔
translation: 学会拒绝尚可的事物，才能接受最佳的事物。

content: We are all in the gutter, but some of us are looking at the stars.
author: 王尔德
translation: 我们都在阴沟里，但仍有人仰望星空。

content: You can't get so hung up on where you'd rather be, that you forget to make the most of where you are.
author: 电影《太空旅客》
translation: 不要太执着于你想去的地方，而忘了你可以利用好现状。

content: Sometimes life hits you in the head with a brick. Don't lose faith.
author: 乔布斯
translation: 生活有时像块板砖敲向你的头，但是别失去信念。

content: Everything negative — pressure, challenges — is all an opportunity for me to rise.
author: 科比·布莱恩特
translation: 每件负面的事，比如压力、挑战，都是让我提升的机会。

content: The things that we love tell us what we are.
author: 托马斯·阿奎纳
translation: 我们所爱之物昭示着我们究竟是谁。

content: The days you work are the best days.
author: 乔治亚·欧姬芙
translation: 努力的日子就是最美好的日子。

content: Life is one fool thing after another whereas love is two fool things after each other.
author: 王尔德
translation: 人生就是一件蠢事追着另一件蠢事，而爱情则是两个蠢东西追来追去。

content: Always do your best. What you plant now, you will harvest later..
author: Og Mandino
translation: 总要竭尽全力。你播种什么，就会收获什么。

content: The most important thing is to enjoy your life—to be happy—it's all that matters.
author: 奥黛丽·赫本
translation: 享受生活才是最重要的，要快乐，这样就够了。

content: Language was seen as an expression of art.
author: 电影《降临》
translation: 语言被看作是艺术的一种表达方式。

content: In order to succeed, we must first believe that we can.
author: 尼可斯·卡赞扎基斯
translation: 要想成功，我们首先必须相信自己能成功。

content: Success is achieved and maintained by those who try and keep trying.
author: W.克莱门德·斯托恩
translation: 不断尝试的人才能取得成功并且保持成功。

content: Only who has once been obsessed can set himself free; only who has had something in his mind can let it go.
author: 电影《西游伏妖篇》
translation: 有过执着，放下执着。有过牵挂，了无牵挂。

content: Don't worry when you are not recognized, but strive to be worthy of recognition.
author: 林肯
translation: 如果不被别人认可，不要担心，要努力让自己值得被认可。

content: We are what we believe we are.
author: C.S.刘易斯
translation: 我们相信自己是谁，那我们就是谁。

content: Hope smiles from the threshold of the year to come, whispering, “It will be happier.”
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson
translation: 新年到来之际，希望向你微笑，并在你耳边轻语：“一切会更好。”

content: I'm only thinking of you this New Year.
author: 扇贝
translation: 在此佳节，唯有你在心中--扇贝

content: Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year.
author: 爱默生
translation: 请铭记于心：每一天都是一年中最好的一天。

content: The power of imagination makes us infinite.
author: 约翰·缪尔
translation: 想象力让我们突破极限。

content: Deserve your dream.
author: 奥克塔维奥·帕斯
translation: 要努力当得起你的梦想。

content: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
author: 诺曼·文森特·皮尔
translation: 改变你的想法，就是改变了你的世界。

content: If you saturate your mind with positive thoughts, it will sustain you in any situation.
author: 莱拉·姬芙蒂·阿奇塔
translation: 让大脑装满积极的想法，能让你在任何境遇中都能支撑得住。

content: I like men who have a future and women who have a past.
author: 王尔德
translation: 我喜欢有未来的男人和有过去的女人。

content: You are most willing to do that thing, where is your true talent.
author: 摩西奶奶
translation: 你最愿意做的那件事，才是你真正的天赋所在。

content: For success, attitude is equally as important as ability.
author: 沃尔特·司各特
translation: 要想成功，态度同能力一样重要。

content: Someone is sitting in the shade today because someone planted a tree a long time ago.
author: 沃伦·巴菲特
translation: 前人栽树，后人乘凉。

content: And so rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
author: J. K. Rowling
translation: 人生的低谷成为了我重建生活的坚实基础。

content: I come to win.
author: 莱奥·杜罗奇
translation: 我生而为赢。

content: You change your life by changing your heart.
author: 马克斯·卢卡多
translation: 你转变了心意，便改变了生活。

content: You are the enemy of my enemy, so you are my friend.
author: 电影《决战食神》
translation: 你是敌人的敌人，就是我们的朋友。

content: In the end, life teaches us what is important, and that is family.
author: Stephen Covey
translation: 生活最终会让我们明白什么最重要，那就是家庭。

content: If you are losing your leisure, look out! It may be you are losing your soul.
author: 弗吉尼亚·伍尔夫
translation: 如果你正在失去你的闲暇时光，小心！可能你正在失去你的灵魂。

content: A little chance encounter could be the one you've waited for.
author: 电影《爱乐之城》
translation: 一次小小的偶遇，可能就是你苦候良久的邂逅。

content: If you have only one smile in you give it to the people you love.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 如果你所拥有的只是一个微笑，那就送给你爱的人。

content: Endure to the very end.
author: 莱拉·姬芙蒂·阿奇塔
translation: 要忍耐到底。

content: Everybody's got a job to do, and I do mine as best I can.
author: 玛丽·马特林
translation: 每个人都有自己的事情要做，我会竭尽全力把属于自己的做好。

content: Even if you’re on the right track, you’ll get run over if you just sit there.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 即便你刚好处于正轨，如果你只坐在那里的话，还是会被撞翻。

content: Either you run the day or the day runs you.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 要么你主宰生活，要么让生活主宰你。

content: It’s good to set limits for oneself, but there comes a moment when we must destroy what we have constructed.
author: Josef Koudelka
translation: 为自己设限是不错，不过有时候我们必须打破自己一手建立的一切。

content: The morning, which is the most memorable season of the day, is the awakening hour.
author: 梭罗
translation: 在一天之中，清晨最值得怀恋和纪念，这是一段让万物醒悟的光阴。

content: Happiness is the natural flower of duty.
author: 菲利普·布鲁克斯
translation: 幸福是责任自然而然生出的花朵。

content: We work in the dark to serve the light.
author: 电影《刺客信条》
translation: 我们在黑暗中耕耘，为光明服务。

content: Happiness lies in the joy of achievement and the thrill of creative effort.
author: 福兰克林·罗斯福
translation: 幸福来源于收获时的欢乐和创作时的激动。

content: They say that history is written by the victors.
author: 电影《生化危机：终章》
translation: 人们说历史是由胜利者书写的。

content: Without deviation from the norm, progress is not possible.
author: Frank Zappa
translation: 不偏离常规，就无法取得进步。

content: Life is a sum of all your choices. So, what are you doing today?
author: Albert Camus
translation: 生活就是你所有选择的总和，那么，你今天要做什么？

content: Do right. Do your best. Treat others as you want to be treated.
author: 卢·霍兹
translation: 做正确的事，尽力去做，用自己希望被对待的方式待人。

content: Art doesn't have to do anything. It just has to be there for the fierce pleasure we take in doing it.
author: Raymond Carver
translation: 艺术不需要做什么。在我们从事艺术时，能让人感受到强烈的愉悦就够了。

content: Real generosity toward the future lies in giving all to the present.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 将一切奉献给当下，就是对未来的真正慷慨。

content: I am prepared for the worst, but hope for the best.
author: 班杰明‧迪斯雷利
translation: 我期待最好的，但为最坏的做好准备。

content: I believe every human has a finite number of heartbeats. I don't intend to waste any of mine.
author: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗
translation: 我相信每个人的心跳次数有限，所以我不想浪费任何一下。

content: Most of us have far more courage than we ever dreamed we possessed.
author: 戴尔·卡内基
translation: 我们大部分人所拥有的勇气比我们梦想得到的要多得多。

content: Success is nothing more than a few simple disciplines, practiced every day.
author: 吉姆·罗恩
translation: 成功不外乎是每天对一些基本技能的操练。

content: You need to take responsibility for your life.
author: 《乐高蝙蝠侠大电影》
translation: 你应该为自己的生活负责。

content: No matter how many goals you have achieved, you must set your sights on a higher one.
author: 杰西卡·萨维奇
translation: 不管你实现了多少目标，总要定睛于下一个更远大的。

content: When there is a strong woman character in a story — that always grabs me.
author: 李安
translation: 有坚强的女性角色的故事总能抓住我的心。

content: Either move or be moved.
author: 艾泽拉·庞德
translation: 要么主动寻求改变，要么被动接受改变。

content: Do more of what makes you happy.
author: Carmel McConnell
translation: 多做些让你快乐的事。

content: When love and skill work together, expect a masterpiece.
author: 约翰·拉斯金
translation: 当热爱与技巧融为一体，就能孕育出杰作。

content: When we have become completely free of the need to judge, we will also become completely free of the fear of being judged.
author: Henri Nouwen
translation: 当我们无需评断别人时，就根本不用怕被别人评断了。

content: The more things you do, the more you can do.
author: 露西尔·鲍尔
translation: 你做的事情越多，能做到的事情就越多。

content: They invented hugs to let people know you love them without saying anything.
author: Bil Keane
translation: 拥抱，是让你一句话也不用说，就让别人知道你爱他们。

content: The best cure for the body is a quiet mind.
author: 拿破仑
translation: 对身体最好的治疗就是让头脑安静。

content: One way to keep momentum going is to have constantly greater goals.
author: 迈克尔·考达
translation: 保持前进动力的方法就是，一直拥有更远大的目标。

content: When I was young I thought that money was the most important thing in life; now that I am old I know that it is.
author: 王尔德
translation: 我年轻时以为金钱是世界上最重要的东西，等到老了才知道，真的是这样。

content: Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
author: Sean Patrick Flanery
translation: 你今天做的事要让未来的你心存感激。

content: Be strong and free from fear.
author: 莱拉·姬芙蒂·阿奇塔
translation: 要坚强，毫不惧怕。

content: I grew up thinking art was pictures until I got into music and found I was an artist and didn't paint.
author: Chuck Berry
translation: 我从前一度认为艺术只是绘画而已，但从事音乐后我才发现，自己是个不需要作画的艺术家。

content: There is no substitute for hard work. First in, last out.
author: Mary Callahan Erdoes
translation: 没有什么能替代努力，要最先开始，最后离开。

content: Curiosity is the lust of the mind.
author: Thomas Hobbes
translation: 好奇心是大脑的渴望。

content: Always forgive your enemies; nothing annoys them so much.
author: 王尔德
translation: 永远宽恕你的敌人，没什么比这更让他们恼怒的了。

content: What a waste my life would be without all the beautiful mistakes I've made.
author: Alice Bag
translation: 如果没有犯下这些美丽的错误，对我的生命来说是多么的浪费！

content: We are all different. Don't judge, understand instead.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 我们每个人都不同。别去评断别人，要去理解别人。

content: Don't be afraid of your fears. They're there to let you know that something is worth it.
author: C. JoyBell C.
translation: 别害怕自己的恐惧，它让你知道有些事情值得去做。

content: A random act of kindness, no matter how small, can make a tremendous impact on someone else's life.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 你的一次无心的善举，不论多么微不足道，都可能对他人的生活产生巨大影响。

content: Instead of worrying about what you cannot control, shift your energy to what you can create.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 与其担心你无法掌控的，不如将精力花在你能创造的上。

content: Art is the lie that enables us to realize the truth.
author: 毕加索
translation: 艺术是能让我们认清现实的谎言。

content: Life is too short to waste your time on people who don't respect, appreciate, and value you.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 人生太短，不要浪费在不尊重、不欣赏、也不珍惜你的人身上。

content: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
author: 王尔德
translation: 爱自己，就能开启一生的浪漫。

content: I hope life isn't a big joke, because I don't get it.
author: Jack Handey
translation: 希望生活不是个大笑话，因为我没抓住笑点。

content: Respect other people's feelings. It might mean nothing to you, but it could mean everything to them.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 尊重他人的感受。这对你可能无关紧要，但对他人可能就十分重要。

content: You are stronger than your challenges and your challenges are making you stronger.
author: Karen Salmansohn
translation: 你比你面对的挑战更强大，而这些挑战让你变得更加坚强。

content: It's not your circumstances that shape you; it's how you react to your circumstances.
author: Anne Ortlund
translation: 塑造你的不是你所处的环境，而是你对周遭环境的反应。

content: People are smarter than you think. Give them a chance to prove themselves.
author: Tim Ferriss
translation: 人们比你想象得更聪明，要给他们机会证明自己。

content: With self-discipline most anything is possible.
author: 西奥多·罗斯福
translation: 只要严于自律，大部分事情都可能做成。

content: The bond that links your true family is not one of blood, but of respect and joy in each other's life.
author: Richard Bach
translation: 你与家人间的联系不是血脉，而是尊重对方的生活，并为之感觉喜悦。

content: Be not simply good — be good for something.
author: 梭罗
translation: 不要一味地善良，要有原则地善良。

content: All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make the better.
author: 爱默生
translation: 生活就是实验，实验的次数越多你就做得越好。

content: The secret to happiness is freedom. And the secret to freedom is courage.
author: 修昔底德
translation: 快乐的秘诀是自由，而自由的秘诀是勇气。

content: There's no such thing as simple. Simple is hard.
author: Martin Scorsese
translation: 世界上没有什么是简单的，就连“简单”本身也很复杂。

content: No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world.
author: Robin Williams
translation: 不论别人怎么说，言语和想法能改变世界。

content: Fame doesn't fulfill you. It warms you a bit, but that warmth is temporary.
author: 玛丽莲·梦露
translation: 名誉不能满足你，它能让你感到一点点温暖，但这种温暖是暂时的。

content: Changes and progress very rarely are gifts from above. They come out of struggles from below.
author: 诺姆·乔姆斯基
translation: 鲜有改变和进步是上天赐予的，它们来自于自己的苦心奋斗。

content: Talent without working hard is nothing.
author: 克里斯蒂亚诺·罗纳尔多
translation: 没有勤奋的才华一无是处。

content: Tomorrow belongs to those who can hear it coming.
author: David Bowie
translation: 明天属于那些能听见它来临的人。

content: You will find that it is necessary to let things go; simply for the reason that they are heavy.
author: C. JoyBell C.
translation: 你会明白，放手是必要的——原因很简单，它们太过沉重。

content: You think you know someone. But mostly you just know what you want to know.
author: Joe Hill
translation: 你以为你很了解某个人，但大多时候你了解的只是你想了解的部分。

content: What would life be if we had no courage to attempt anything?
author: 梵高
translation: 如果我们都没有勇气去尝试点什么，生活会变成什么样子呢？

content: Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
author: 穆罕默德·阿里
translation: 别放弃。现在吃点苦，然后带着冠军的荣耀度过余生。

content: Difficult times often bring out the best in people.
author: Bernie Sanders
translation: 困境总能激发出人最好的一面。

content: You'll never be alone if you've got a book.
author: 阿尔·帕西诺
translation: 只要手捧书卷，你就永远不会感到孤独。

content: Love all, trust a few, do wrong to none.
author: 莎士比亚
translation: 爱所有人，信任少数人，不负任何人。

content: You are remembered for the rules you break.
author: 道格拉斯·麦克阿瑟
translation: 你会因你打破的规则而被人铭记。

content: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
author: 李小龙
translation: 如果你热爱生活，就别浪费时间，因为生活是时间组成的。

content: Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.
author: Ian Maclaren
translation: 要与人为善，因为你遇到的每个人都在艰苦奋战。

content: Laziness is nothing more than the habit of resting before you get tired.
author: Jules Renard
translation: 所谓懒惰，不过是一种还没疲惫就休息的习惯罢了。

content: By giving people the power to share, we're making the world more transparent.
author: Mark Zuckerberg
translation: 如果我们给予人们分享的权利，就能让世界更加透明。

content: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
author: Charlie Chaplin
translation: 如果一天里没有欢笑，那这一天就被浪费了。

content: Sometimes if you want to see a change for the better, you have to take things into your own hands.
author: 克林特·伊斯特伍德
translation: 有时当你想看到自己变得更好的时候，你就必须自己动手付出努力。

content: If you think you can do it, you can.
author: 约翰·博罗斯
translation: 如果你认为你能成功，你就能成功。

content: You have to fight to reach your dream. You have to sacrifice and work hard for it.
author: 梅西
translation: 为了实现梦想，你必须奋斗；你必须做出牺牲，必须为之努力。

content: One word frees us of all the weight and pain of life: That word is love.
author: 爱默生
translation: 有一个字能让我们摆脱生活的压力与痛苦，这个字就是“爱”。

content: I believe the target of anything in life should be to do it so well that it becomes an art.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 我认为，在生活中，不管做任何事，其目标都应该是将它做到艺术一般完美。

content: If you do not believe you can do it, then you have no chance at all.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 如果你不相信自己能做到，你就永远没有机会做到。

content: I am always ready to learn although I do not always like being taught.
author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
translation: 虽然我并不喜欢有人教我，但我一直乐于学习。

content: All I can do is follow my instincts, because I'll never please everyone.
author: Emma Watson
translation: 我能做的一切，就是依心而行，因为我不会去取悦任何人。

content: Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens.
author: Jimi Hendrix
translation: 知识是倾诉，但智慧是倾听。

content: Imagination is the one weapon in the war against reality.
author: Jules de Gaultier
translation: 想象力是向现实开战时的一种武器。

content: I think part of my gift, or if I have one, is that I love listening.
author: Eric Clapton
translation: 我觉得我的天赋——如果我有天赋的话——就是我热爱倾听。

content: Life is something that happens when you can't get to sleep.
author: Fran Lebowitz
translation: 生活就是那些在你失眠的时候发生的事情。

content: I always wanted to be somebody, but I should have been more specific.
author: Jane Wagner
translation: 我总是想成为大人物，但对此我应该更加具体些。

content: Truth is more of a stranger than fiction.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 真相比小说更不可思议。

content: A mother's arms are made of tenderness and children sleep soundly in them.
author: 维克多·雨果
translation: 母亲的臂膀是用温柔做的，孩子们可以在其中安然入眠。

content: Everyone is a moon and has a dark side which he never shows to anybody.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 每个人都如月亮一样，拥有一个从不示人的阴暗面。

content: If all men were rich, all men would be poor.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 如果所有人都富有，那么所有人就都是贫穷的。

content: Life is a foreign language; all men mispronounce it.
author: Christopher Morley
translation: 生活就像一门外语，所有人都说不好它。

content: Art is making something out of nothing and selling it.
author: Frank Zappa
translation: 艺术就是变无为有，然后把它卖出去。

content: Better to write for yourself and have no public, than to write for the public and have no self.
author: Cyril Connolly
translation: 为自我写作而不顾大众胜过为大众写作而丢失自我。

content: The important thing was to love rather than to be loved.
author: W. Somerset Maugham
translation: 重要的是去爱，而不是被爱。

content: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
author: J. K. Rowling
translation: 能展现真实的自我的，与其说是我们的能力，倒不如说我们所做的选择。

content: I'll let you be in my dreams if I can be in yours.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 如果我能进入你的梦乡，我也会把你拥入我的梦里。

content: Money is better than poverty, if only for financial reasons.
author: Woody Allen
translation: 钱比贫穷更好，如果仅仅因为经济原因的话。

content: Everything is funny as long as it is happening to somebody else.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 所有事情都是有趣的，只要它发生在别人身上。

content: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
author: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
translation: 当你排除掉了所有的不可能，剩下的无论多么说不通，它都一定是真相。

content: Be careful about reading health books. You may die of a misprint.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 读健康类书籍可得小心！你可能会因为一点印刷错误丢了性命。

content: Never explain — your friends do not need it and your enemies will not believe you anyway.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 不用解释——你的朋友不需要，而你的敌人如何也不相信。

content: A good novel tells us the truth about its hero; but a bad novel tells us the truth about its author.
author: G. K. Chesterton
translation: 一本好的小说告诉我们关于主角的种种真相；而一本糟糕的小说告诉我们关于作家自己的种种真相。

content: Everyone is necessarily the hero of his own life story.
author: John Barth
translation: 每个人都必定是自己人生故事中的主角。

content: Famous remarks are very seldom quoted correctly.
author: Simeon Strunsky
translation: 名言很少能被正确引用。

content: Food is the most primitive form of comfort.
author: Sheila Graham
translation: 食物是最原始的安慰人心的东西。

content: There are no seven wonders of the world in the eyes of a child. There are seven million.
author: Walt Streightiff
translation: 孩子的眼里从来没有“世界七大奇迹”——而是七百万大奇迹。

content: Well-timed silence has more eloquence than speech.
author: Martin Fraquhar Tupper
translation: 时机恰当的沉默比话语更有说服力。

content: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 生命中最重要的两天，是你出生的那一天，和你弄清楚为何而生的那一天。

content: Fashion is a form of ugliness so intolerable that we have to alter it every six months.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 时尚是一种无法容忍的丑陋，以至于我们每六个月就得改变它一次。

content: Never eat more than you can lift.
author: Miss Piggy
translation: 吃的永远不要比能拿的多。

content: Nothing is impossible. Some things are just less likely than others.
author: Jonathan Winters
translation: 没有什么是不可能的，只是有些事可能性比其他的小一点而已。

content: Self-confidence is the first requisite to great undertakings.
author: Samuel Johnson
translation: 自信是成大事的首要条件。

content: Education's purpose is to replace an empty mind with an open one.
author: Malcolm Forbes
translation: 教育的目的是使空洞的大脑变得开放宽广。

content: Life wouldn't be worth living if I worried over the future as well as the present.
author: W. Somerset Maugham
translation: 如果我既担忧未来又担忧现在，那么这样的生活不值得我去过。

content: I often quote myself. It adds spice to my conversation.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 我常常引用自己的话，它可以为我的谈话增添点色彩。

content: Every day, in every way, I am getting better and better.
author: Émile Coué
translation: 每一天，我都在以各种方式变得越来越好。

content: Simplicity is the peak of civilization.
author: Jessie Sampter
translation: 极简是文明的极致。

content: You cannot shake hands with a clenched fist.
author: Indira Gandhi
translation: 握紧拳头时，你是无法握手的。

content: A lot of fellows nowadays have a B.A., M.D., or Ph.D. Unfortunately, they don't have a J.O.B.
author: Fats Domino
translation: 现在有很多人都拥有学士、硕士，或者博士学位，但不幸的是，他们都没有“工作”。

content: Only the mediocre are always at their best.
author: Jean Giraudoux
translation: 只有平庸的人才会永远在他们最好的状态。

content: All animals are equal but some animals are more equal than others.
author: George Orwell
translation: 一切动物生而平等，但有些动物生来比其他动物更平等。

content: It is not necessary to understand things in order to argue about them.
author: Pierre Beaumarchais
translation: 没有必要为了争论事物而去理解事物。

content: Parents were invented to make children happy by giving them something to ignore.
author: Ogden Nash
translation: 父母的存在，是有意让孩子忽略一些事情，从而让他们感到欢乐。

content: One machine can do the work of fifty ordinary men. No machine can do the work of one extraordinary man.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 一台机器能干五十个普通人的活，但一个杰出的人的工作没有机器可以做。

content: The world is full of willing people, some willing to work, the rest willing to let them.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 这个世界充满了乐于做事的人。一些人乐意工作，其余的人乐意让他们工作。

content: While we try to teach our children all about life, our children teach us what life is all about.
author: Angela Schwindt
translation: 当我们教会孩子生活的一切时，孩子却教会我们什么是生活的真谛。

content: Only two things are infinite, the universe and human stupidity, and I'm not sure about the former.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 世上只有两种东西是无限的：宇宙以及人类的愚蠢。而对于前者，我还不太确定。

content: You can't build a reputation on what you are going to do.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 你是无法靠你打算去做的事情树立名声的。

content: You must first have a lot of patience to learn to have patience.
author: Stanislaw J. Lec
translation: 你首先得耐下心，才能学会有耐心。

content: If a thing isn't worth saying, you sing it.
author: Pierre Beaumarchais
translation: 如果一件事不值得说出来，你就把它唱出来吧。

content: Everyone is born with genius, but most people only keep it a few minutes.
author: Edgard Varese
translation: 每个人生来都是天才，但大多数人只把天资保留了几分钟。

content: Money is like a sixth sense without which you cannot make a complete use of the other five.
author: W. Somerset Maugham
translation: 金钱就像人的第六感，没有它你就无法完整地使用其他五感。

content: There cannot be a crisis next week. My schedule is already full.
author: Henry Kissinger
translation: 下周不可能有危机，我的日程早就排满了。

content: A problem is a chance for you to do your best.
author: Duke Ellington
translation: 问题也是机会，你得以把事情做到最好。

content: Drama is life with the dull bits cut out.
author: Alfred Hitchcock
translation: 戏剧就是去掉了无聊片段的生活。

content: Life is a long lesson in humility.
author: James M. Barrie
translation: 人生是一门漫长的学习谦卑的课。

content: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
author: Alan Kay
translation: 预知未来的最好方式是创造未来。

content: Even if you're on the right track, you'll get run over if you just sit there.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 即使你处在正轨上，但如果你只是坐在原地，也会被别人碾过去。

content: Never judge a book by its movie.
author: J. W. Eagan
translation: 永远不要通过由书改编的电影来评判这本书。

content: Education is a progressive discovery of our own ignorance.
author: Will Durant
translation: 教育是一个逐步发现自己无知的过程。

content: It's kind of fun to do the impossible.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 做不可能的事还挺有趣的。

content: The public is wonderfully tolerant. It forgives everything except genius.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 公众是非常宽容的，他们能够原谅一切，除了天才以外。

content: A bank is a place that will lend you money if you can prove that you don't need it.
author: Bob Hope
translation: 银行是如果你能证明你不需要钱，它才会借钱给你的地方。

content: Man invented language to satisfy his deep need to complain.
author: Lily Tomlin
translation: 人类发明语言是为了满足他们内心深处对抱怨的需求。

content: Marriage is a great institution, but I'm not ready for an institution yet.
author: Mae West
translation: 婚姻是一所良好的大学，但我还没准备好上学呢。

content: The only way to discover the limits of the possible is to go beyond them into the impossible.
author: Arthur C. Clarke
translation: 发现可能的极限只有一种方法，那就是超越可能，挑战不可能。

content: Never, never, never give up.
author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
translation: 不，绝不，永不放弃。

content: The secret of staying young is to live honestly, eat slowly, and lie about your age.
author: Lucille Ball
translation: 保持年轻的秘诀是诚实生活、细嚼慢咽，以及谎报你的年龄。

content: A person who trusts no one can't be trusted.
author: Jerome Blattner
translation: 不信人者不可信。

content: A successful marriage requires falling in love many times, always with the same person.
author: Mignon McLaughlin
translation: 成功的婚姻就是多次坠入爱河，但每次爱上的都是同一个人。

content: Opera is when a guy gets stabbed in the back and, instead of bleeding, he sings.
author: Ed Gardner
translation: 歌剧就是当一个人后背挨了一刀，他没有流血，而是开始唱歌。

content: I'm not smart, but I like to observe. Millions saw the apple fall, but Newton was the one who asked why.
author: William Hazlitt
translation: 我并不聪明，但我喜欢观察。看到苹果落下来的人不计其数，但只有牛顿问了为什么。

content: Although the world is full of suffering, it is full also of the overcoming of it.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 虽然世界充满苦难，但是苦难总是可以战胜的。

content: The cure for boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
author: Dorothy Parker
translation: 无聊的解药是好奇心，但好奇心没有解药。

content: The face of a child can say it all, especially the mouth part of the face.
author: Jack Handey
translation: 从孩子的脸上你就能看出一切，特别是脸上那张嘴。

content: The important thing is not to stop questioning.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 重要的是不要停止提问。

content: Night gets darkest right before dawn. What doesn't kill you makes you more strong.
author: Linkin Park
translation: 最黑暗的夜晚永远在破晓之前，未曾击败你的会让你更加强大。

content: A man who doesn't spend time with his family can never be a real man.
author: 电影《教父》
translation: 男人若不懂得花时间陪家人，就绝不是一个真正的男人。

content: Nothing endures but personal qualities.
author: Walt Whitman
translation: 除了个人品质，没有什么是持久不变的。

content: I've never known any trouble that an hour's reading didn't assuage.
author: Charles De Secondat
translation: 世间纵有万般扰，读书片刻皆可消。

content: The world stands aside to let anyone pass who knows where he is going.
author: David Starr Jordan
translation: 如果一个人知道自己要去哪儿，全世界都会为他让路。

content: A ship in port is safe, but that's not what ships are built for.
author: Grace Murray Hopper
translation: 船停在港口就是安全的，但它不是为停在港口而造的。

content: My favorite thing is to go where I've never been.
author: Diane Arbus
translation: 我最爱的就是去往那些不曾去过的地方。

content: Every artist was first an amateur.
author: 爱默生
translation: 每个艺术家在一开始都是外行。

content: It usually takes more than three weeks to prepare a good impromptu speech.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 准备好一段优秀的即兴演讲通常得花三个多星期。

content: The happiness of this life depends less on what befalls you than the way in which you take it.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 生活中的快乐不在于发生在你身上的事，而在于你应对的方式。

content: Deeds, not stones, are the true monuments of the great.
author: John L. Motley
translation: 伟人真正的纪念碑，不是由石头筑成的，而是由他们的行为铸就的。

content: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
author: 乔治·桑塔亚那
translation: 不能铭记过去的人注定要重蹈覆辙。

content: He who laughs, lasts!
author: Mary Pettibone Poole
translation: 笑口常开的人会更长寿。

content: Learn as much by writing as by reading.
author: Lord Acton
translation: 既要靠阅读来学习，也要靠写作来学习。

content: Never help a child with a task at which he feels he can succeed.
author: Maria Montessori
translation: 当一个孩子觉得自己能成功完成一项任务时，千万别去帮他。

content: Never despair; but if you do, work on in despair.
author: Edmund Burke
translation: 永远不要绝望。但如果你真感到绝望，就要在绝望中进步。

content: I disapprove of what you say, but I will defend to the death your right to say it.
author: Evelyn Beatrice Hall
translation: 我不同意你说的话，但我会誓死捍卫你说话的权利。

content: What may be done at any time will be done at no time.
author: Scottish Proverb
translation: 常将今日推明日，推到后来无影踪。

content: Variety is the soul of pleasure.
author: Aphra Behn
translation: 丰富多样是快乐的精髓。

content: Reprove thy friend privately; commend him publicly.
author: Solon
translation: 在私下批评你的朋友，在公开场合赞扬他。

content: Just think of the tragedy of teaching children not to doubt.
author: Clarence Darrow
translation: 教一个孩子别去质疑，想想这是多么可悲的事情。

content: The wisest mind has something yet to learn.
author: George Santayana
translation: 就连最智慧的人也有东西要学。

content: Victory belongs to the most persevering.
author: 拿破仑·波拿巴
translation: 胜利属于最坚持不懈的人。

content: Memory feeds imagination.
author: Amy Tan
translation: 回忆是想象力的源泉。

content: Discovery consists of seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought.
author: Albert Szent-Gyorgyi
translation: 所谓发现，就是看见别人所看过的，而想到别人不曾想到过的。

content: We go where our vision is.
author: Joseph Murphy
translation: 我们的视野有多远，就能走多远。

content: Everyone should carefully observe which way his heart draws him, and then choose that way with all his strength.
author: Hasidic Saying
translation: 每个人都应该仔细留心内心引领的是哪一条路，然后尽全力选择那条路。

content: Think not those faithful who praise all thy words and actions; but those who kindly reprove thy faults.
author: 苏格拉底
translation: 别去想那些对你的一切所言所行都大加赞赏的人；需要在乎的是那些友善地批评你过错的人。

content: Do not consider painful what is good for you.
author: Euripides
translation: 对你有益的东西，不要觉得痛苦。

content: Shallow men believe in luck. Strong men believe in cause and effect.
author: 爱默生
translation: 浅薄者相信运气；有能力的人相信因果。

content: Every sweet has its sour; every evil its good.
author: 爱默生
translation: 甘饴有其酸涩，恶人亦有善行。

content: The knowledge of the world is only to be acquired in the world, and not in a closet.
author: Lord Chesterfield
translation: 对世界的了解是在世界中获得的，而不是在储物间里。

content: The best way to cheer yourself is to try to cheer someone else up.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 让自己开心起来的最好的方法，是试着让别人开心。

content: All that is necessary for the triumph of evil is that good men do nothing.
author: Edmund Burke
translation: 欲使恶人得胜，只需好人袖手旁观。

content: A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is braver five minutes longer.
author: 爱默生
translation: 英雄和普通人一样，并没有多勇敢，只是比普通人多勇敢五分钟而已。

content: Do something every day that you don't want to do; this is the golden rule for acquiring the habit of doing your duty without pain.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 每天都做自己不想做的事，这是学会不带痛苦地做好本职工作的黄金准则。

content: Courage is doing what you're afraid to do. There can be no courage unless you're scared.
author: Eddie Rickenbacker
translation: 行畏惧之事可谓勇；无畏则无勇。

content: There is no remedy for love but to love more.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 爱情没有解药，只有爱得更深。

content: The fragrance always remains in the hand that gives the rose.
author: Heda Bejar
translation: 赠支玫瑰予人，手中余香永存。

content: We turn not older with years, but newer every day.
author: Emily Dickinson
translation: 我们并非在年复一年地变老，而是日复一日地焕然一新。

content: What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
author: 爱默生
translation: 和我们的内心世界相比，我们将要面对的和曾经经历的简直不值一提。

content: The eyes are blind. One must look with the heart.
author: 《小王子》
translation: 眼睛是看不见的。应该用心去寻找。

content: If you love a flower on a star, it is sweet at night to gaze at the sky.
author: 《小王子》
translation: 如果你爱上一颗星星上的一朵花，那么，夜晚仰望星空就是一件开心的事。

content: You become responsible, forever, for what you have tamed.
author: 《小王子》
translation: 你要永远对你已驯服的一切承担起责任。

content: Everything's got a moral, if only you can find it.
author: 《爱丽丝漫游奇境记》
translation: 每件事都是有道理的，就看你找不找得到。

content: It’s no use going back to yesterday, because I was a different person then.
author: 《爱丽丝漫游奇境记》
translation: 昨天的事就不用说了，因为我昨天和现在不一样。

content: Laugh at yourself first, before anyone else can.
author: Elsa Maxwell
translation: 在别人能够嘲笑你之前，先自嘲吧。

content: I shall take the heart, for brains do not make one happy, and happiness is the best thing in the world.
author: 《绿野仙踪》
translation: 我要心，因为脑子不能使人幸福，而幸福是世界上最重要的事。

content: Spend more time smiling than frowning and more time praising than criticizing.
author: Richard Branson
translation: 多花时间微笑，少花时间蹙眉，多花时间表扬，少花时间批评。

content: The true courage is in facing danger when you are afraid.
author: 《绿野仙踪》
translation: 真正的胆量是，尽管害怕，你仍然面对危险。

content: The mediocre teacher tells. The good teacher explains. The superior teacher demonstrates. The great teacher inspires.
author: William Ward
translation: 平庸的老师向人告知，不错的老师向人解释，优秀的老师向人演示，伟大的老师给人启迪。

content: Experience is the only thing that brings knowledge.
author: 《绿野仙踪》
translation: 经验是带来知识的唯一的好东西。

content: I have decided not to grow up tame like the others who lay their necks on the threshold waiting for the ball and chain.
author: 《芒果街上的小屋》
translation: 可我决定不要长大变成像别人那么温顺的样子，把脖子搁在门槛上等待甜蜜的枷链。

content: We can draw lessons from the past, but we cannot live in it.
author: Lyndon B. Johnson
translation: 我们可以从过去学些什么，但不能活在过去。

content: We take what we can get and make the best of it.
author: 《芒果街上的小屋》
translation: 我们取我们所能取，好好地享用。

content: We need to be true to who we are and remember what's really important to us.
author: Steve Jobs
translation: 我们要坦诚面对自己，谨记什么才是对我们是真正重要的。

content: One never notices what has been done; one can only see what remains to be done.
author: 玛丽·居里
translation: 人们从不会看到自己已经完成了什么；他们只看到自己还没有完成什么。

content: Wish not so much to live long as to live well.
author: 本杰明·富兰克林
translation: 与其希望活得久，不如祈盼过得好。

content: I love being married. It's so great to find that one special person you want to annoy for the rest of your life.
author: Rita Rudner
translation: 我喜欢婚姻生活。找一个与众不同的人让你烦一辈子，简直是太棒了。

content: Hope I have not strayed too far to reclaim my lost time.
author: 《曹禺致黄永玉的信》
translation: 但愿迷途未远，还能追回已逝的光阴。

content: We have too many high-sounding words, and too few actions that correspond with them.
author: Abigail Adams
translation: 我们有太多豪言壮语，却鲜有行动将其付诸实践。

content: Promote yourself, but do not demote another.
author: Israel Salanter
translation: 提升自己，但不要贬低他人。

content: The good or ill of a man lies within his own will.
author: Epictetus
translation: 人的善恶取决于自己的意愿。

content: Autumn is a second spring when every leaf is a flower.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 秋天是第二个春天，每片树叶都是花朵。

content: Man is what he believes.
author: 契诃夫
translation: 一个人相信什么，他就是什么样的人。

content: The ornament of a house is the friends who frequent it.
author: 爱默生
translation: 一座房子最好的装饰品，是常来光顾的朋友们。

content: A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and goes to bed at night and in between does what he wants to do.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 成功的生活就是早上起床，晚上睡觉，白天做自己想做的事。

content: When you fish for love, bait with your heart, not your brain.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 求爱时，以真心为诱饵，而不是智谋。

content: Where is there dignity unless there is honesty?
author: Cicero
translation: 若无诚实，谈何自尊？

content: Nothing is a waste of time if you use the experience wisely.
author: Auguste Rodin
translation: 没有什么事情是浪费时间的，只要你明智地利用这段经历。

content: Experience is a hard teacher because she gives the test first, the lesson afterwards.
author: Vernon Sanders Law
translation: 经验就像一个很严格的老师，因为她总是先给我们以考验，然后再给我们上课。

content: The motherland is not a mere lump of earth. When we desire her progress, we have to promote the progress of the people who dwell therein.
author: Sri Sathya Sai Baba
translation: 祖国不仅仅是一方土地。若要祖国进步，我们必须要让生活在这片土地上的人进步。

content: A man can do all things if he but wills them.
author: Leon Battista Alberti
translation: 有志者，事竟成。

content: If you want to see what children can do, you must stop giving them things.
author: Norman Douglas
translation: 你如果想见识孩子们的能耐，就千万别直接把东西给他们。

content: It didn't matter how big our house was; it mattered that there was love in it.
author: Peter Buffett
translation: 我们的房子有多大并不重要，重要的是家中有爱。

content: Real glory springs from the silent conquest of ourselves.
author: Joseph P. Thompson
translation: 真正的荣耀发端于埋头苦干征服自己。

content: A sailor without a destination cannot hope for a favorable wind.
author: Leon Tec
translation: 没有目的地的水手别指望遇到顺风。

content: A minute's success pays the failure of years.
author: Robert Browning
translation: 一分钟的成功足以回报多年的失败。

content: One should count each day a separate life.
author: Seneca
translation: 要把每天都过成新生活。

content: If a writer wrote merely for his time, I would have to break my pen and throw it away.
author: 维克多·雨果
translation: 如果一位作家只为自己所处的时代而写作，那我只得把我的笔掰断再扔掉了。

content: Be a first rate version of yourself, not a second rate version of someone else.
author: Judy Garland
translation: 做一流的自己，不做二流的别人。

content: The reward of one duty is the power to fulfill another.
author: George Eliot
translation: 完成一个任务的奖励是完成下一个任务的动力。

content: The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
author: 甘地
translation: 弱者永远不懂宽恕，宽恕是强者的品质。

content: To be mature means to face, and not evade, every fresh crisis that comes.
author: Fritz Kunkel
translation: 成熟意味着去面对任何来临的危机，而不是逃避。

content: What people say you cannot do, you try and find that you can.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 大家都说你做不到，你尝试了，结果发现你其实能做到。

content: Never trouble another for what you can do for yourself.
author: Thomas Jefferson
translation: 自己能做的事，不要麻烦别人。

content: Absorb what is useful. Discard what is not. Add what is uniquely your own.
author: 李小龙
translation: 吸收有用的，摒弃无用的，再加点你自己独特的东西进去。

content: Enjoy when you can, and endure when you must.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
translation: 有福享受时，尽情享受；必须承受时，默默忍受。

content: Enjoy present pleasures in such a way as not to injure future ones.
author: Seneca
translation: 享受当下的快乐，但别因此损害未来的快乐。

content: Depend not on fortune, but on conduct.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 别依赖运气，要靠自己的行动。

content: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
author: Epictetus
translation: 尽全力做到最好，接受接下来会发生的。

content: If you reveal your secrets to the wind you should not blame the wind for revealing them to the trees.
author: Kahlil Gibran
translation: 你若将秘密说给风听，那就别怪风说给树听。

content: As long as you're being a copycat, you will never be the best copycat.
author: Eric Thomas
translation: 你只要在模仿他人，就做不到最好。

content: Doubt whom you will, but never yourself.
author: Christine Bovee
translation: 你想质疑谁就质疑谁，但别怀疑自己。

content: A misery is not to be measured from the nature of the evil, but from the temper of the sufferer.
author: Joseph Addison
translation: 苦难的大小不是由罪恶本身来衡量的，而是由受苦者自己的秉性来衡量的。

content: A tough lesson in life that one has to learn is that not everybody wishes you well.
author: Dan Rather
translation: 我们必须从生活中吸取的惨痛教训是：不是所有人都希望你过得好。

content: Keep your fears to yourself, but share your courage with others.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 把恐惧留在自己心里，把勇气给大家分享。

content: We are made to persist. That's how we find out who we are.
author: Tobias Wolff
translation: 我们生来就是为了坚持，这样我们才能明白自己是谁。

content: Light travels faster than sound. This is why some people appear bright until they speak.
author: Steven Wright
translation: 光传播得比声音快，因此有些人一开始看上去光鲜亮丽，一直到他开口为止。

content: Whatever you are, be a good one.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 不管你是什么样的人，都要善良。

content: You desire to know the art of living, my friend? It is contained in one phrase: Make use of suffering.
author: Henri-Frédéric Amiel
translation: 朋友，你想明白生活之道吗？它就在这么一句话里：好好利用你的不幸。

content: He can run, but he can't hide.
author: Joe Louis
translation: 人可以躲开，但不能藏起来。

content: If you're naturally kind, you attract a lot of people you don't like.
author: William Feather
translation: 如果你天生就是老好人，就会招来一群你不喜欢的人。

content: A child becomes an adult when he realizes that he has a right not only to be right but also to be wrong.
author: Thomas Szasz
translation: 当一个孩子知道自己既有权对，也有权错，也就长大了。

content: Love truth, and pardon error.
author: Voltaire
translation: 爱上真理，原谅错误。

content: Discovery consists of seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought.
author: Albert Szent-Gyorgyi
translation: 要有所发现，就要见别人见过的，想没人想过的。

content: Any man whose errors take ten years to correct is quite a man.
author: J. Robert Oppenheimer
translation: 能花十年时间去纠正错误，真可谓人。

content: When people talk, listen completely. Most people never listen.
author: Ernest Hemingway
translation: 别人说话时，就听完。大多数人根本不懂得倾听。

content: Winter is coming.
author: 《冰与火之歌》
translation: 凛冬将至。

content: My mother had a great deal of trouble with me, but I think she enjoyed it.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 我给我的母亲带来了很多麻烦，但我觉得她乐在其中。

content: I am not in this world to live up to other people's expectations, nor do I feel that the world must live up to mine.
author: Fritz Perls
translation: 我来到这个世界，不是来满足他人的期望的，也不觉得这个世界必须要满足我的期望。

content: The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, but wiser people so full of doubts.
author: Bertrand Russell
translation: 这个世界的问题在于，傻子和疯子过于信得过自己，聪明人却对自己充满怀疑。

content: Even in the loneliest moments, I have been there for myself.
author: Sanober Khan
translation: 任时光再寂寥，也有自己作伴。

content: There's no point in being grown up if you can't be childish sometimes.
author: 《神秘博士》
translation: 如果不能偶尔孩子气一下，那长大就没有意义了。

content: The brain is a wonderful organ. It starts working the moment you get up in the morning and does not stop until you get into the office.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 脑子这个器官真神奇，从你早上起床就开始工作，但一进办公室它就不转了。

content: A wise man gets more use from his enemies than a fool from his friends.
author: Baltasar Gracian
translation: 智者从敌人身上学到的，多过愚者从朋友身上学到的。

content: Life begins at the end of your comfort zone.
author: Neale Donald Walsch
translation: 走出舒适区，生活才算开始。

content: People throw stones at you and you convert them into milestones.
author: Sachin Tendulkar
translation: 有人朝你扔石头，你却可以把石头变成纪念碑。

content: Do not let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
author: John Wooden
translation: 别让你做不到的事干扰你能做到的。

content: Efficiency is intelligent laziness.
author: David Dunham
translation: 高效才是机智的偷懒方式。

content: Be more prompt to go to a friend in adversity than in prosperity.
author: Chilo
translation: 要及时帮助身处逆境的朋友，而不是急着攀附飞黄腾达的朋友。

content: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
author: Soren Kierkegaard
translation: 回首才能理解生活，但要继续生活，你必须 前行。

content: Never promise more than you can perform.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 不要许下你无法兑现的承诺。

content: Laughter is the sun that drives winter from the human face.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 笑是太阳，驱散人脸上的寒冬。

content: Let us be grateful to the people who make us happy; they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
author: Marcel Proust
translation: 感谢那些带给我们欢乐的人吧，他们是可爱的园丁，让我们的灵魂绽放。

content: I don't want any yes-men around me. I want everybody to tell me the truth even if it costs them their jobs.
author: Samuel Goldwyn
translation: 我不想身边有任何只会说“是”的人。我想所有人都跟我说实话，哪怕他们会因此丢掉饭碗。

content: I don't know the key to success, but the key to failure is trying to please everybody.
author: Bill Cosby
translation: 我不知道成功的关键，但失败的关键在于想取悦所有人。

content: Never stand begging for that which you have the power to earn.
author: Miguel de Cervantes
translation: 自己能挣到的，就别去乞求。

content: 'Tis better to be silent and be thought a fool, than to speak and remove all doubt.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 宁愿保持沉默让人以为是个傻子， 也不要一开口就证明自己确实如此。

content: Yield to temptation. It may not pass your way again.
author: Robert A. Heinlein
translation: 在诱惑前屈服吧，说不定你再也没机会遇到了。

content: Lack of money is the root of all evil.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 缺钱是万恶之源。

content: Some people like my advice so much that they frame it upon the wall instead of using it.
author: Gordon R. Dickson
translation: 有些人实在太喜欢我的建议了，甚至裱起来挂在墙上，但就是不用。

content: Life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans.
author: John Lennon
translation: 当你忙着做计划，却又有事突然降临，这就是生活。

content: There are lots of people who mistake their imagination for their memory.
author: Josh Billings
translation: 错把想象力当记忆力的人太多了。

content: I have learned to use the word 'impossible' with the greatest caution.
author: Wernher von Braun
translation: 我已经学会尽可能慎用“不可能”这个词。

content: To love what you do and feel that it matters — how could anything be more fun?
author: Katharine Graham
translation: 热爱自己的事业，感受到它的重要，还有什么比这更有乐趣的事吗？

content: There is no love sincerer than the love of food.
author: 萧伯纳
translation: 没有哪种爱比爱吃更真诚。

content: Make sure you have finished speaking before your audience has finished listening.
author: Dorothy Sarnoff
translation: 确保在别人不想再听之前把话说完。

content: Kindness is like snow—It beautifies everything it covers.
author: Kahlil Gibran
translation: 善意如雪，装点一切。

content: I love deadlines. I like the whooshing sound they make as they fly by.
author: Douglas Adams
translation: 我就喜欢最后期限，喜欢它飞驰而过时发出的嗖嗖声。

content: Travel is more than the seeing of sights; it is a change that goes on, deep and permanent, in the ideas of living.
author: Mary Ritter Beard
translation: 旅行不仅仅是看风景，还能给人生观念带来深远的改变。

content: It is not worth an intelligent man's time to be in the majority.
author: G. H. Hardy
translation: 聪明人不值得把时间花在随大流上。

content: Try the most outrageous things you can — shock yourself. You have at your power the ability to do anything.
author: Sol LeWitt
translation: 尽你所能，尝试最离谱的事，让你自己都震惊。你无所不能。

content: Only the shallow know themselves.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 只有浅薄的人才了解自己。

content: Imagination is more important than knowledge.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 想象力比知识更重要。

content: It's a rare person who wants to hear what he doesn't want to hear.
author: Dick Cavett
translation: 愿意听逆耳之言的人十分难得。

content: You will do foolish things, but do them with enthusiasm.
author: Sidonie-Gabrielle Colette
translation: 你难免会做傻事，但要做，就做得满怀激情。

content: When you are in any contest you should work as if there were — to the very last minute — a chance to lose it.
author: Dwight D. Eisenhower
translation: 比赛就应当拼尽全力，坚持到最后一分钟，以免功败垂成。

content: The heights by great men reached and kept were not attained by sudden flight, but they, while their companions slept, were toiling upward in the night.
author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
translation: 伟人成就之大，并非一蹴而就，而是每夜他人酣睡时，自己苦苦耕耘。

content: The secret of joy in work is contained in one word — excellence. To know how to do something well is to enjoy it.
author: Pearl S. Buck
translation: 快乐地工作的秘诀在于追求卓越，了解如何把事情做好本身就是享受。

content: The great thing in this world is not so much where you stand, as in what direction you are moving.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes
translation: 世界上美好的事物，不在原地，而在你前进的方向。

content: When love and skill work together, expect a masterpiece.
author: John Ruskin
translation: 热爱与能力结合，自然会出杰作。

content: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
author: Anais Nin
translation: 生命格局的大小取决于你的勇气。

content: No winter lasts forever, no spring skips its turn.
author: Hal Borland
translation: 没有永留不去的冬天，也没有届时不至的春天。

content: Gratitude also opens your eyes to the limitless potential of the universe, while dissatisfaction closes your eyes to it.
author: Stephen Richards
translation: 感恩让你开眼领略宇宙无穷的可能，不知足却会遮蔽你的双眼。

content: Flowers never emit so sweet and strong a fragrance as before a storm.
author: Jean Paul Richter
translation: 花朵的芬芳，在暴雨将至时最为强烈。

content: The best way to spread Christmas cheer is singing loud for all to hear.
author: Will Ferrell
translation: 要传播圣诞的欢乐，为大家高声歌唱是最好不过的。

content: Better to do something imperfectly than to do nothing flawlessly.
author: Robert H. Schuller
translation: 做些不够尽善尽美的事，总好过不犯错误的无所事事。

content: It's choice—not chance—that determines your destiny.
author: Jean Nidetch
translation: 决定你命运的不是运气，而是你的选择。

content: It is better to wear out than to rust out.
author: Bishop Richard Cumberland
translation: 与其生锈发霉，不如物尽其用。

content: Never stop smiling not even when you're sad. Someone might fall in love with your smile.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
translation: 保持微笑，就算悲伤也依然要微笑。或许有人会爱上你的笑容。

content: If you don't run your own life, somebody else will.
author: John Atkinson
translation: 如果你不掌控自己的生活，生活就会被他人掌控。

content: Year's end is neither an end nor a beginning but a going on.
author: Hal Borland
translation: 一年的尾声，既不是结局，也不是开端，而是继续前行。

content: Every time you tear a leaf off a calendar, you present a new place for new ideas.
author: Charles Kettering
translation: 每撕下一页日历，你就又有了地方装新想法。

content: When you play, play hard; when you work, don't play at all.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 玩耍须尽兴，工作勿儿戏。

content: You can't turn back the clock. But you can wind it up again.
author: Bonnie Prudden
translation: 你无法让时钟反转，但你能重新上发条。

content: We may lay in a stock of pleasures, as we would lay in a stock of wine; but if we defer tasting them too long, we shall find that both are soured by age.
author: Charles Caleb Colton
translation: 储藏快乐，如同储藏美酒，若是耽搁太久才去品尝，就会发现它们早就变了质。

content: The only people with whom you should try to get even are those who have helped you.
author: John E. Southard
translation: 要说你该跟谁互不相欠的话，那只该是帮助过你的人。

content: The world is moving so fast these days that the man who says it can't be done is generally interrupted by someone doing it.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 世界变得太快了，常常有人“做不成”还没说完，就有别人在做了。

content: To make pleasures pleasant, shorten them.
author: Charles Buxton
translation: 要想真正享受快乐，就要懂得节制。

content: To be yourself in a world that is constantly trying to make you something else is the greatest accomplishment.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 在一个不断想改变你的世界里坚持做自己，就是最伟大的成就。

content: Work and struggle and never accept an evil that you can change.
author: Andre Gide
translation: 努力奋斗，坏事若是有改变的可能，就绝对不要认命。

content: Say not, when I have leisure I will study; you may not have leisure.
author: The Mishnah
translation: 可别说你有空了就去学习，你可能根本不会有空。

content: Hide not your talents, they for use were made. What's a sun-dial in the shade?
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 不要掩盖才华，才华本该施展。日晷若置于阴影之中，便百无一用。

content: Love should give a sense of freedom, not of prison.
author: D. H. Lawrence
translation: 爱情应该给人自由感，而非囚禁感。

content: Success is waking up in the morning, so excited about what you have to do.
author: 《名扬四海》
translation: 成功就是清晨醒来，对自己的人生充满期待。

content: Do not, for one repulse, forego the purpose that you resolved to effect.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 不要因为一次挫折，就放弃曾立志为之奋斗的目标。

content: You are not responsible for the world — you are only responsible for your work — so DO IT.
author: Sol LeWitt
translation: 你不必对世界负责，你只需对自己的工作负责。尽管去做吧。

content: Hope you never grow old.
author: The Cranberries, "Never Grow Old"
translation: 愿你青春永驻。

content: There will be an answer. Let it be.
author: Beatles, "Let It Be"
translation: 顺其自然吧，一切终会有答案。

content: Human beings are not born once and for all on the day their mothers give birth to them, but life obliges them over and over again to give birth to themselves.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
translation: 人不是生下来后就一成不变的，生活会逼迫他一次又一次地脱胎换骨。

content: Sin bravely… We will never have all the facts to make a perfect judgement.
author: Russell R. McIntyre
translation: 要勇于犯错，我们永远不可能了解全部事实，作出完美判断。

content: People don't notice whether it's winter or summer when they're happy.
author: Anton Chekhov
translation: 人只要开心，就无所谓酷暑还是寒冬。

content: There is some good in this world, and it's worth fighting for.
author: 《指环王：双塔奇兵》
translation: 这世界一定有美好的东西，值得我们为之奋斗到底。

content: Don't wait for inspiration. It comes while one is working.
author: Henri Martisse
translation: 别干等着灵感，它在人工作时才会到来。

content: It's just a spark but it's enough to keep me going.
author: Paramore, "Last Hope"
translation: 火光虽微弱，但足以照亮我的前行之路。

content: Dream big and dare to fail.
author: Norman Vaughan
translation: 敢于梦想，不畏失败。

content: Better shun the bait, than struggle in the snare.
author: John Dryden
translation: 抵制鱼饵的诱惑，总好过上钩后的挣扎。

content: Do what is right, not what is easy nor what is popular.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 做事就要做对的，不挑易事，不随大流。

content: The real voyage of discovery consists not in seeking new landscapes but in having new eyes.
author: Marcel Proust
translation: 真正的探索之旅并不在于寻找新的风景，而是要有新的眼光。

content: Quarrel not at all. No man resolved to make the most of himself can spare time for personal contention.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 别去争吵，人若决定活得充实，就不会浪费时间跟人较劲。

content: Travel far enough, you meet yourself.
author: 《云图》
translation: 当你走的足够远，就会最终遇见真实的自己。

content: Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear — not absence of fear.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 勇敢并非毫无畏惧，而是克服恐惧，战胜恐惧。

content: Talk sense to a fool and he calls you foolish.
author: Euripides
translation: 你跟傻瓜讲道理，会被他说成傻。

content: Reach for the stars so if you fall you land on a cloud.
author: Kanye West, "Homecoming"
translation: 飞向星空吧，就算坠落，接住你的也是云彩。

content: You do ill if you praise, but worse if you censure, what you do not understand.
author: Leonardo da Vinci
translation: 对于你不了解的事物，你或许不太会赞许，但总好过谴责。

content: The heart of man is very much like the sea, it has its storms, it has its tides and in its depths it has its pearls too.
author: 梵高
translation: 人心如海，包容万象，有暴风雨，有惊涛骇浪，但在最深处也有璀璨的珍珠。

content: It is not true that people stop pursuing dreams because they grow old, they grow old because they stop pursuing dreams.
author: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
translation: 人不是因为老了而放弃追逐梦想，而是因为放弃追逐梦想才变老。

content: Anyone who ever gave you confidence, you owe them a lot.
author: 《蒂凡尼早餐》
translation: 感激那些给予你信心的人。

content: To invent, you need a good imagination and a pile of junk.
author: Thomas A. Edison
translation: 想要发明东西，你需要卓越的想象力和一堆废品。

content: I must govern the clock, not be governed by it.
author: Golda Meir
translation: 我必须支配时间，而不是被时间支配。

content: Let your dreams stay big and your worries stay small.
author: Rascal Flatts, "My Wish"
translation: 放大梦想，减少忧虑。

content: You can only cure retail but you can prevent wholesale.
author: Brock Chisholm
translation: 纠正只能弥补小错，预防却能杜绝大错。

content: It is not enough to have a good mind. The main thing is to use it well.
author: Rene Descartes
translation: 头脑聪明还不够，重要的是好好运用。

content: Definiteness of purpose is the starting point of all achievement.
author: W. Clement Stone
translation: 目标明确是一切成功的起点。

content: I love you not for who you are, but for who I am with you.
author: 《剪刀手爱德华》
translation: 我爱你不是因为你是谁，而是我在你面前可以是谁。

content: Funny is always a good way to start when in doubt.
author: Ocean R Stark
translation: 如果心怀疑惑，不妨试着以幽默的方式开场。

content: I love you more than there are stars in the sky and fish in the sea.
author: Nicholas Sparks（翻译来自@haha）
translation: 星之繁，鱼之众，不及爱之深！

content: Each age has deemed the new-born year. The fittest time for festal cheer.
author: Walter Scott
translation: 岁岁皆为新生年，都值得好好庆祝。

content: Full of luck, health and cheer. We wish you a Happy Chinese New Year!
author: 扇贝＼( ^▽^ )／
translation: 春节快乐，万事如意！

content: The happiest part of a man's life is what he passes lying awake in bed in the morning.
author: Samuel Johnson
translation: 人生一大乐事莫过于早上醒来可以赖赖床。

content: The sweetness of reunion is the joy of heaven.
author: Richard Paul Evans
translation: 幸福的团聚，宛如置身天堂。

content: Idleness, like kisses, to be sweet must be stolen.
author: Jerome K. Jerome
translation: 闲散，如同接吻，必须是偷来的才够甜蜜。

content: Wealth is the ability to fully experience life.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 财富，就是能充分体验生活。

content: Only hate the road when you're missing home.
author: Passenger, "Let her go"
translation: 只有在乡愁涌动时才痛恨旅途遥远。

content: Turn the page, maybe we'll find a brand new ending.
author: Adam Levine, "Lost Stars"
translation: 翻过陈旧的昨天，或许会迎来完全不一样的结局。

content: It's your life; you don't need someone's permission to live the life you want.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 生活是你自己的，想过什么样的生活，不需要别人的许可。

content: Those are my principles, and if you don't like them… well, I have others.
author: Groucho Marx
translation: 那是我的原则，要是你不喜欢……那我还有其他原则。

content: Life is about making an impact, not making an income.
author: Kevin Kruse
translation: 生命在于影响他人，而非赚钱糊口。

content: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
author: 《肖申克的救赎》
translation: 懦怯囚禁人的灵魂，希望可以令你感受自由。

content: Humanity is won by continuing to play in face of certain defeat.
author: Ralph Ellison
translation: 就算可能失败，也要继续前行，可谓是真正的人。

content: When someone loves you, the way they talk about you is different. You feel safe and comfortable.
author: Jess C. Scott
translation: 爱你的人谈起你的方式是不一样的，你会觉得安全又舒服。

content: Every day women and men become legends.
author: Common, "Glory"
translation: 每天都有人书写不朽的传奇诗篇。

content: A lantern can give you light only when you light it.
author: Munia Khan
translation: 灯笼若要闪亮，需要你去点亮。

content: It's not what you say out of your mouth that determines your life; it's what you whisper to yourself that has the most power!
author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
translation: 你嘴上说什么决定不了你的生活，起决定作用的是你在心里告诉自己什么！

content: Unable to perceive the shape of you, I find you all around me. Your presence fills my eyes with your love.
author: 《水形物语》
translation: 无法感知你的形状，但我能感到你就在我的四周。在我眼里，你的存在就是爱。

content: Go after what you really love and find a way to make that work for you, and then you'll be a happy person.
author: Tom Petty
translation: 追求你真正热爱的，并能充分利用，你就是幸福的。

content: You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.
author: Beverly Sills
translation: 失败可能会让你失望，但若不去尝试，就必定会失败。

content: Who can say where the road goes? Where the day flows? Only time.
author: Enya,  "Only Time"
translation: 谁能说得清道路向何方漫延，岁月向何方流逝？唯有时光。

content: Women are the largest untapped reservoir of talent in the world.
author: Hillary Clinton（翻译来自@【兰芷】柚子_茶）
translation: 女性是世界上未经开发过的最大人才库。

content: Love is when the other person's happiness is more important than your own.
author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.（翻译来自@烟雨清词）
translation: 情是君喜胜于己欢。

content: You cannot let your father's actions define your life. You get to decide what kind of king you want to be.
author: 《黑豹》
translation: 你的生活不是追随父亲的脚步，而是要做自己的国王。

content: Our lives are defined by opportunities, even the ones we miss.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
translation: 我们的生命取决于机遇，包括那些错过的机遇。

content: You've got to try first before you say it's impossible.
author: 《半泽直树》
translation: 在说不可能之前，你得先试一试。

content: Change your life today. Don't gamble on the future, act now, without delay.
author: Simone de Beauvoir（翻译来自@妮妮）
translation: 从今天起，改变生活；立即行动，拒绝拖延，别把希望押在未来。

content: Although I cannot move and I have to speak through a computer, in my mind I am free.
author: Stephen Hawking
translation: 尽管我不能动，说话要借助电脑，但我的思想却无限自由。

content: Keep integrity at every cost.
author: Nas, "Bridging The Gap"
translation: 要正直，不惜一切代价。

content: There are no great limits to growth because there are no limits of human intelligence, imagination, and wonder.
author: Ronald Reagan
translation: 成长的路途，没有尽头，因为我们拥有无限的智慧、想象力和好奇心。

content: Through love comes calm, and through calm comes thought.
author: 《三块广告牌》
translation: 爱使人内心宁静，而后才会有思考。

content: Make sure you marry someone who laughs at the same things you do.
author: 《麦田里的守望者》（翻译来自@厉害的三三）
translation: 确保与你白头的是志趣相投的人。

content: Fortune sides with him who dares.
author: Virgil
translation: 好运垂青有胆识的人。

content: The only reward of virtue is virtue; the only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 对美德的回报是美德，获得友谊的唯一途径是给人以友谊。

content: I'm sure we'll meet in the spring. And catch up on everything.
author: Troye Sivan, "The Good Side"
translation: 我们一定会在春天相见，好好聊个天。

content: Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.
author: Babe Ruth
translation: 永远不要因为害怕被淘汰而不去争取。

content: The truth is, I'm in love and there's nothing I can do about it.
author: 《真爱至上》
translation: 事实是，爱情来的时候，挡也挡不住。

content: One hour without electricity isn't much to ask to save the world.
author: Earth Hour 地球一小时
translation: 熄灯一小时不过是举手之劳，但对于地球却意义非凡。

content: The problems of your past are your business. The problems of your future are my privilege.
author: 《神探夏洛克》（翻译来自@々&々）
translation: 你的过去我不会追问，你的未来我希望有幸参与。

content: Make improvements, not excuses. Seek respect, not attention.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 要追求进步，而不是一味地寻找借口，要寻求尊重，而不是一味地博取关注。

content: The goal isn't to live forever; the goal is to create something that will.
author: Chuck Palahniuk
translation: 人生的目标不是要获得永生，而是要创造永恒。

content: The noblest art is that of making others happy.
author: 《马戏之王》
translation: 最高贵的艺术是使人快乐的艺术。

content: We are what we repeatedly do; excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.
author: Aristotle
translation: 每天反复做的事情造就了我们，然后你会发现，优秀不是一种行为，而是一种习惯。

content: And if there's love in this life, there's no obstacle. That can't be defeated.
author: Avicii, "Waiting For Love"
translation: 如果生活充满爱，世界将不再有阻碍，爱可以战胜一切。

content: It takes a great deal of bravery to stand up to our enemies, but just as much to stand up to our friends.
author: 《哈利波特与魔法石》
translation: 抗拒敌人需要巨大的勇气，但是抗拒朋友也需要同样巨大的勇气。

content: When in doubt, make a fool of yourself.
author: Cynthia Heimel
translation: 糊涂时，不如自愚自乐一把。

content: April hath put a spirit of youth in everything.
author: 莎士比亚
translation: 四月将勃勃生机注入万物。

content: I've been on the block I'm trying to build with you like Tetris.
author: 吴亦凡《Deserve》（翻译来自@扎铁了老兴）
translation: 看尽世间繁华，只愿与你细水长流。

content: Success is connecting with the world and making people feel.
author: 《名扬四海》
translation: 成功就是与世界为伴，并感染周围的人。

content: Where can a wineshop be found to drown his sad hours? A cowherd points to a cot 'mid apricot flowers.
author: 杜牧《清明》（许渊冲 译）
translation: 借问酒家何处有？牧童遥指杏花村。

content: If life were predictable it would cease to be life, and be without flavor.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 生活如果能预知就不再是生活，会变得索然无味。

content: Take me into your loving arms, kiss me under the light of a thousand stars.
author: Ed Sheeran（翻译来自@一梦入伽蓝）
translation: 拥在爱浓时，吻于星汉下。

content: Ask yourself, are you willing to fight?
author: 《头号玩家》
translation: 问问自己，你愿意去奋战吗？

content: Doing the best at this moment puts you in the best place for the next moment.
author: Oprah Winfrey
translation: 这一刻全力以赴，下一刻成就最佳。

content: Love is an irresistible desire to be irresistibly desired.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 爱就是种无法抗拒的欲望——想要被他人无法抗拒地渴望。

content: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
author: Samuel Beckett
translation: 努力过，失败过，没关系，屡战屡败，屡败屡战，失败得再漂亮些。

content: I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
author: Thomas A. Edison（翻译来自@susie）
translation: 我没有失败，只是证明了这10000种方法行不通。

content: Celebrate endings for they precede new beginnings.
author: Jonathan Lockwood Huie
translation: 要为结束而庆祝，因为这是新的开始。

content: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
author: David Viscott
translation: 爱与被爱就像是从正反两面去感受太阳。

content: There's a light inside of all of us. It's never hiding. You just have to light it.
author: Avril Lavigne, "Fly"
translation: 我们内心深处都有一束光芒，无法隐藏，尽管去大放异彩吧。

content: Life is not a problem to be solved, but a reality to be experienced.
author: Soren Kierkegaard
translation: 人生不是待解决的难题，而是一种真实，等着我们去体验。

content: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any one thing.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 时刻牢记，渴望成功的决心比任何事情都重要。

content: Don't give up. Never give up until the fight is over.
author: 《触不可及》
translation: 别放弃，坚持直至胜利。

content: The thing about romance is people only get together right at the very end.
author: 《真爱至上》
translation: 所谓浪漫就是有情人通常是到最后的最后才成眷属。

content: We are still kids but we're so in love. Fighting against all odds.
author: Ed Sheeran（翻译来自@抠抠唐小可）
translation: 我们虽然年少，但却如此相爱。让我们披荆斩棘，跨越所有障碍。

content: Challenges are what make life interesting and overcoming them is what makes life meaningful.
author: Joshua J. Marine
translation: 挑战让生活趣味盎然，战胜挑战让生活意义非凡。

content: Three cobblers with their wits combined equal the mastermind.
author: 《三宝大战诸葛亮》
translation: 三个臭皮匠，顶个诸葛亮。

content: No man is an island; every book is a world.
author: Gabrielle Zevin
translation: 没有谁是一座孤岛，每本书都是一个世界。

content: There's a time for daring and there's a time for caution, and a wise man understands which is called for.
author: 《死亡诗社》
translation: 人生既要大胆放手，也需小心谨慎，聪明人在这二者之间收放自如。

content: In this world, he who stops, won't get anything he wants.
author: Gavin Degraw, "Fire"
translation: 人生在世若不奋力争取，就算满心渴望也终将一无所获。

content: None of us really changes over time. We only become more fully what we are.
author: Anne Rice
translation: 没有人能真正随着时间的推移而改变， 我们只是在逐渐成为更加圆满的自己。

content: The sun goes down, the stars come out. And all that counts, is here and now.
author: The Wanted（翻译来自@lu彩燕）
translation: 夕阳西下，繁星闪现。此时此刻，最是重要。

content: Sometimes we depend on other people as a mirror to define us and tell us who we are.
author: 《蓝莓之夜》
translation: 有时我们会以他人为镜来定义自我、认识自我。

content: Better to have loved and lost, than to have never loved at all.
author: St. Augustine
translation: 宁愿爱过失去过，也不愿从未爱过。

content: For what it's worth, it's never too late.
author: 《返老还童》
translation: 有意义的事，何时去做都不会太晚。

content: The end of labour is to gain leisure.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 劳动是为了更好地享受生活。

content: If you look for it, I've got a sneaky feeling you'll find that love actually is all around.
author: 《真爱至上》
translation: 如果你肯留意，你会发现爱其实无处不在。

content: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 生命的意义不在于发现你自己，而在于创造你自己。

content: We are young. So let's set the world on fire. We can burn brighter than the sun.
author: Fun., "We Are Young"
translation: 我们是青年，让我们点亮世界，释放生命，胜过太阳。

content: If there's one thing to be taught, it's dreams are made to be caught.
author: Gavin Degraw, "Fire"
translation: 唯有一事值得谨记，有梦想就要奋力追逐。

content: We're losing all this daylight but soon the moon's gonna rise.
author: Young Rising Sons, “Turnin'”
translation: 虽然白日将尽，但有一轮新月正冉冉高升。

content: The whole secret of a successful life is to find out what is one's destiny to do, and then do it.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 拥有成功的人生，秘诀在于发现自己此生该做什么，然后付诸行动。

content: I took my bruises, took my lumps. Fell down and I got right back up.
author: Eminem, "Beautiful"
translation: 身上带着淤青和肿块，摔倒了也立刻爬起来。

content: In any case you mustn't confuse a single failure with a final defeat.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald, "Tender Is the Night"
translation: 永远不要把一次失败与最终失败混为一谈。

content: Reading gives us someplace to go when we have to stay where we are.
author: Mason Cooley
translation: 当我们困在原地时，阅读可以带我们去遨游。

content: I assure you, brother, the sun will shine on us again.
author: 《复仇者联盟3：无限战争》
translation: 兄弟，我向你保证，我们还会重见阳光的。

content: No matter what anybody tells you, words and ideas can change the world.
author: 《死亡诗社》
translation: 不管别人怎么说，文字和思想的确能改变世界。

content: When you are looking at your mother, you are looking at the purest love you will ever know.
author: Charley Benetto
translation: 当你看着母亲时，你凝视的是此生最纯洁的爱。

content: Do not go where the path may lead; go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 别沿着别人的路走，要去开辟自己的路，留下自己的足迹。

content: A life spent making mistakes is not only more honorable, but more useful than a life spent doing nothing.
author: 萧伯纳
translation: 比起无所事事，会犯错的人生不仅更光荣，也更有意义。

content: You're not obligated to win. You're obligated to keep trying.
author: Jason Mraz
translation: 你不一定要获胜，但你必须不断尝试。

content: Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
author: 斯蒂芬·霍金
translation: 智慧就是适应变化的能力。
