content: It isn't where you came from. It's where you're going that counts.
author: Ella Fitzgerald
translation: 起点并不重要，重要的是，你要去往何方。

content: Let us make our future now, and let us make our dreams tomorrow's reality.
author: Malala Yousafzai
translation: 即刻起，为未来奋斗，要让今天的梦想成为明天的现实。

content: If I know what love is, it is because of you.
author: Hermann Hesse
translation: 因为你，我才懂得什么是爱。

content: Forgiveness is the fragrance that the violet sheds on the heel that has crushed it.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 你一脚踩在紫罗兰上，它却把香味留在了你的脚上，这便是宽恕。

content: Motivation comes from working on things we care about.
author: Sheryl Sandberg（翻译来自@yoyo嘘嘘！）
translation: 为在意的事付出努力，动力随之而来。

content: You should love and take care of yourself because after all, it's your own life.
author: 《恋恋笔记本》
translation: 要学会爱自己，照顾自己，毕竟生活是你自己的。

content: You must do the things you think you cannot do.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 务必要去尝试你认为不可能的事。

content: Give every day the chance to become the most beautiful day of your life.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 把每天都过成你生命中最美好的一天。

content: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
author: 海明威
translation: 确认一个人是否可信，最好的办法就是信任他们。

content: Love gives one a kind of goodness.
author: 《茶花女》（翻译来自@Tarny）
translation: 爱使人向善。

content: Be determined. Instead of intending to just try, do it.
author: 《星球大战》
translation: 要坚定，凡事要抱着拼一把而非试一下的心态。

content: You do not find the happy life. You make it.
author: Camilla Eyring Kimball
translation: 幸福不是刻意的寻找，而是用心的经营。

content: Wrinkles should merely indicate where smiles have been.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 皱纹只是微笑留下的痕迹。

content: Each time you happen to me all over again.
author: "The Age of Innocence"（翻译来自@lola）
translation: 你的每次出现，都在我脑海里浮现千遍。

content: All grown-ups were once children... but only few of them remember it.
author: 《小王子》
translation: 成年人都曾是孩子，可只有少数人记得这点。

content: Believe in every dream that you got, you only living once.
author: Nickelback
translation: 你只活一次，要相信属于自己的每一个梦想

content: You only get one shot; do not miss your chance to blow.
author: Eminem, "Lose Yourself"
translation: 机会只有一次，不要错过。

content: Don't criticize what you can't understand.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 不懂的，不要随意批判。

content: Learn to let go and be clear of where you really want to head for.
author: "Kissing a Fool"
translation: 学会放手，同时也要弄清楚自己的真正所爱。

content: The human race has one really effective weapon, and that is laughter.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 欢笑是人类强而有力的武器。

content: It is your determination and persistence that will make you a successful person.
author: Kenneth J Hutchins
translation: 让你成功的，是决心，以及毅力。

content: Patience is the companion of wisdom.
author: Saint Augustine
translation: 耐心总是与智慧相伴。

content: You have every right to a beautiful life.
author: Selena Gomez
translation: 你值得拥有属于你的美丽人生。

content: There is no friend as loyal as a book.
author: 海明威（翻译来自@【兰芷】婧子昕）
translation: 好书如挚友，情谊永不渝。

content: Love is the beauty of the soul.
author: Saint Augustine
translation: 爱是灵魂之美。

content: Just be yourself because you're unique and you'll shine.
author: "What a Girl Wants"
translation: 每个人都是独一无二的，做好你自己，你也能够光芒四射。

content: Life's too short to miss out anything; try to take it slowly.
author: "Ferris Bueller's Day Off"
translation: 生命短暂，放慢脚步，别错过任何沿途的风景。

content: Good friends, good books and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 拥有益友、良书和一颗宁静的内心：这就是理想的生活。

content: If at first you don't succeed, then dust yourself off and try again.
author: Aaliyah, "Try Again"
translation: 失败了没关系，重振旗鼓，从头再来。

content: With the right kind of coaching and determination you can accomplish anything.
author: Reese Witherspoon
translation: 正确的训练加上坚定的决心，你将攻无不克。

content: Dad is and always will be my living, breathing superhero.
author: Bindi Irwin
translation: 在我眼里，爸爸是现实版超级英雄，现在、以后，永远都是。

content: Health and cheerfulness naturally beget each other.
author: Joseph Addison
translation: 安康喜乐，相生相成。

content: What is a friend? A single soul dwelling in two bodies.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 何谓朋友？一个灵魂孕育在两个躯体里。

content: Be brave. Take risks. Nothing can substitute experience.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 要敢于冒险，你的经历是无可替代的。

content: Summertime is always the best of what might be.
author: Charles Bowden
translation: 万物最美一面，总在夏季展现。

content: Where words fail, music speaks.
author: 安徒生
translation: 言语无法表达时，音乐就会响起。

content: We are who we choose to be.
author: Barry Manilow
translation: 要成为怎样的人，选择在于你自己。

content: Beautiful things don't ask for attention.
author: 《白日梦想家》
translation: 真正美丽的东西， 并不会刻意寻求别人的注目。

content: Change in all things is sweet.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 有改变就会有美好。

content: No affection but interests can be found in the world of animals.
author: 电影《动物世界》
translation: 在动物的世界里，只有利益，没有感情。

content: To be great, truly great, you have to be the kind of person who makes the others around you great.
author: 马克·吐温

content: You cannot change the circumstances but you can change yourself.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 既然改变不了环境，那就改变自己。

content: Real love is always worth waiting for.
author: 《西部世界》
translation: 真爱永远值得等待。

content: Curiosity is the wick in the candle of learning.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 如果学习是一根蜡烛，那好奇心就是烛芯。

content: Empty your cup so that it may be filled.
author: 李小龙
translation: 清空杯子，方能再装满。

content: For Azeroth.
author: 《魔兽世界》
translation: 为了艾泽拉斯。

content: I don't know anything with certainty, but seeing the stars makes me dream.
author: 《至爱梵高·星空之谜》
translation: 我不知道世间有什么事是确定不变的，但只要一看到星星，我就会开始做梦。

content: And if you really want to see what people are, all you have to do is look.
author: 《奇迹男孩》
translation: 想真正了解他人，只需要用心去看。

content: Pleasure in the job puts perfection in the work.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 乐于工作才有完美表现。

content: Life has no limitations, except the ones you make.
author: Les Brown
translation: 生命无限，除非你自我设限。

content: Soon is not as good as now.
author: Seth Godin
translation: 别谈未来，现在就行动。

content: Make each day your masterpiece.
author: John Wooden
translation: 让你生命中的每一天都成为杰作。

content: Happiness is an inside job.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 向内寻找，才能找到幸福。

content: Winning isn't everything, but wanting it is.
author: Arnold Palmer
translation: 胜利并不能代表一切，而求胜心可以。

content: It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 越是在艰难的时候就越要守住光明。

content: People love what other people are passionate about.
author: 《爱乐之城》
translation: 人总是会爱上别人倾注热情的事物。

content: Don't let the mistakes and disappointments of the past control and direct your future.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 不要让未来的你被过去的错误与失望所掌控。

content: Don't be pushed by your problems. Be led by your dreams.
author: 爱默生
translation: 别为困难所迫，要以梦想为引。

content: Champions keep playing until they get it right.
author: Billie Jean King
translation: 冠军属于那些为目标勇往直前直至胜利的人。

content: Don't allow your rituals to become ruts.
author: Todd Henry
translation: 切忌墨守成规。

content: If you can imagine it, you can achieve it. If you can dream it, you can become it.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 凡是能想象到的，就能被实现，能够成为梦想的，就能够成真。

content: A winner never stops trying.
author: Tom Landry
translation: 胜者永不停止尝试。

content: The most difficult thing is the decision to act; the rest is merely tenacity.
author: Amelia Earhart
translation: 最困难的是下定决心去做，剩下的只是坚持而已。

content: Life is not only merriment. It is desire and determination.
author: 纪伯伦
translation: 生活并不只有欢声笑语，还得要有抱负和决心。

content: What you seek is seeking you.
author: Rumi
translation: 你正在寻找的东西也在找寻你。

content: It is the power of thought that gives man power over nature.
author: 安徒生
translation: 人类之所以能够驾驭自然，是因为思想的力量。

content: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
author: Seneca
translation: 并不是因为事情难我们才不敢去做，而是因为我们不敢做事情才难。

content: There is nothing so useless as doing efficiently that which should not be done at all.
author: Peter Drucker
translation: 最没用的，莫过于有效地做那些根本没必要做的事。

content: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
translation: 我们需要决定的是，如何利用好上天赋予我们的时间。

content: The more you know who you are, and what you want, the less you let things upset you.
author: 《迷失东京》
translation: 你越了解自己，越知道自己追求的是什么，就越不会为外物所扰。

content: If you focus on what you left behind you will never see what lies ahead.
author: 《料理鼠王》
translation: 只顾回头看，就永远也看不到前面的风景。

content: Happiness is the meaning and the purpose of life, the whole aim and end of human existence.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 幸福，是生活的意义和目的，是生存的目标和终点。

content: Don't let anyone ever make you feel like you don't deserve what you want.
author: 《我恨你的十件事》
translation: 别让任何人使你觉得自己不配拥有梦想。

content: When you're curious, you find lots of interesting things to do.
author: 华特·迪士尼
translation: 当你富有好奇心时，你会发现有很多有趣的事情可以去做。

content: It matters not what someone is born, but what they grow to be.
author: 《哈利波特与火焰杯》
translation: 一个人的出身并不重要，重要的是他会成长为什么样的人。

content: Great things are done by a series of small things brought together.
author: 梵高
translation: 成就大事，源于点滴的积累。

content: However bad life may seem, there is always something you can do, and succeed at.
author: 霍金
translation: 无论生活多么艰辛，你总会有自己的方式发光。

content: It's a beautiful day. Don't let it get away.
author: U2, "Beautiful Day"
translation: 今天如此美好，不要白白浪费。

content: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 自律是连接目标与成功的桥梁。

content: He who spends time regretting the past loses the present and risks the future.
author: Francisco de Quevedo（翻译@抠抠唐小可）
translation: 追悔过往的人，丢失了现在，赌上了未来。

content: You are confined only by the walls you build yourself.
author: Andrew Murphy
translation: 限制你的只有你自己筑起的墙。

content: Half is worse than none at all.
author: 《西部世界》
translation: 一知半解比一无所知更痛苦。

content: You'll have bad times, but it'll always wake you up to the good stuff you weren't paying attention to.
author: 《心灵捕手》
translation: 每个人都会经历低谷，但也正是这些低谷会让你注意到平时注意不到的东西。

content: There is just one life for each of us: our own.
author: Euripides
translation: 我们都只有一种生活可以过：自己的生活。

content: Above us all the stars are watching. There's no place I'd rather be in this world.
author: Bruno Mars（翻译@伊川洛雪 鹿怜莲）
translation: 我们之上，繁星守望；世界之大，唯伴你侧。

content: In love, one and one are one.
author: 萨特
translation: 爱情里，一加一等于一。

content: You'll have bad times, but it'll always wake you up to the good stuff you weren't paying attention to.
author: 《心灵捕手》
translation: 每个人都会经历低谷，但也正是这些低谷会让你注意到平时注意不到的东西。

content: Without self-discipline, success is impossible, period.
author: Lou Holtz
translation: 无自律，不成功，就这样。

content: Dare, and the world always yields.
author: 威廉·梅克比斯·萨克雷
translation: 大胆挑战，世界总会让步。

content: When given the choice between being right or being kind, choose kind.
author: 《奇迹男孩》
translation: 如果要在“正确”和“善良”之间做选择，请选择“善良”。

content: When we strive to become better than we are, everything around us becomes better too.
author: 《牧羊少年奇幻之旅》
translation: 当我们努力变得更好时，周围的一切也会变得更美好。

content: They wish lovers may unite, every year as this night, on earth as in the sky.
author: 《二郎神·七夕》，柳永（许渊冲译）
translation: 愿天上人间，占得欢娱，年年今夜。

content: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
author: 维克多·雨果
translation: 生命如花，爱情是蜜。

content: Had I not seen the Sun, I could have borne the shade.
author: Emily Dickinson
translation: 我本可以忍受黑暗，如果我不曾见过太阳。

content: It is up to you to give life a meaning.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre
translation: 生命的意义由你自己来赋予。

content: My heart, the bird of the wilderness, has found its sky in your eyes.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 我的心是旷野的鸟，在你的双眼中找到了天空。

content: The wiser a man becomes, the more he will read, and those who are wisest read most.
author: 安徒生
translation: 越是睿智的人，越愿意读书，最有智慧的人读的书也最多。

content: Win or lose, do it fairly.
author: Knute Rockne
translation: 不管是赢还是输，但求公正。

content: Commitment is an act, not a word.
author: 萨特
translation: 承诺，需要付出行动，而不是说说而已。

content: Tomorrow is always fresh, with no mistakes in it yet.
author: 《绿山墙的安妮》
translation: 明日永远新鲜如初，纤尘不染。

content: Any time spent being unhappy is wasted.
author: Ruth E. Renkl
translation: 任何不快乐的时光都是浪费。

content: Like so many things, it is not what's outside, but what is inside that counts.
author: 《阿拉丁》
translation: 许多事物都是如此，外表看起来虽不起眼，但是内在却惊为天人。

content: Today's special moments are tomorrow's memories.
author: 《贾方复仇记》
translation: 今日的特別时刻，将会成为明天的美好回忆。

content: Creativity is intelligence having fun.
author: 爱因斯坦
translation: 创意是智慧在找乐子。

content: You are strong because you are imperfect. You are wise because you have doubts.
author: 《至暗时刻》
translation: 因为不完美，所以才强大。因为有疑虑，所以才睿智。

content: We can be anyone. We can do anything.
author: Mission: Impossible
translation: 我们可以成为任何人，也可以做任何事。

content: Try to remember the kind of September, when you were a tender and callow fellow.
author: "Try to Remember", The Brothers Four
translation: 追忆那醉人的九月，曾经的年幼温柔。

content: Just because someone stumbles and loses their path, doesn't mean they're lost forever.
author: 《X战警：逆转未来》
translation: 人偶尔会失足、迷失方向，但不等于会永远迷失下去。

content: Without new experiences, something inside of us sleeps.
author: Frank Herbert
translation: 没有新鲜的经历，我们内心的某些东西就会沉睡。

content: What's coming will come, and we'll meet it when it does.
author: 《哈利·波特与火焰杯》
translation: 该来的总会来，我们只要迎接即可。

content: Beauty is how you feel inside, and it reflects in your eyes.
author: Sophia Loren
translation: 美是一种内心的感觉，并反映在你的眼睛里。

content: I love you because the entire universe conspired to help me find you.
author: 《牧羊少年奇幻之旅》
translation: 我爱你是因为整个宇宙都合力助我来到你的身边 。

content: The key to winning is poise under stress.
author: Paul Brown
translation: 获胜的关键是在压力下依旧保持镇静。

content: Our fate lives within us. You only have to be brave enough to see it.
author: 《勇敢传说》
translation: 命运在我们自己手中，只要足够勇敢，就能掌握它。

content: The very essence of romance is uncertainty.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 浪漫的精髓就在于它充满种种可能。

content: A teacher affects eternity; he can never tell where his influence stops.
author: 亨利·亚当斯
translation: 老师的影响力极其深远，他永远不知道这种影响会止步何处。

content: You still have a lot of time to make yourself be what you want.
author: S.E. Hinton
translation: 你还有大把的时间去成为自己想要的样子。

content: Success is not forever and failure isn't fatal.
author: Don Shula
translation: 没有永远的成功，亦无致命的失败。

content: Great men are not born great; they grow great.
author: 《教父》
translation: 伟大的人并非生来如此，是经历造就了他们的伟大。

content: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
author: Suzy Kassem
translation: 比起失败，怀疑自己会扼杀更多的梦想。

content: Never look back unless you are planning to go that way.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 永远不要回头，除非你想走回头路。

content: Beauty is found within.
author: 《美女与野兽》
translation: 美，源自内心。

content: We grow fearless when we do the things we fear.
author: Robin S. Sharma
translation: 做自己畏惧之事，会让我们变得无所畏惧。

content: The best teachers are those who show you where to look, but don't tell you what to see.
author: Alexandra K. Trenfor
translation: 最好的老师，授人以渔，而非授人以鱼。

content: I love you as no love on earth is wrought; I love you now and love you evermore.
author: 安徒生
translation: 世间的爱有千千万，也不及我爱你，从今往后，有增无减。

content: We think that we are invincible because we are.
author: 《寻找阿拉斯加》
translation: 我们认为自己所向无敌，那是因为的确如此。

content: For being different, it's easy. But to be unique, it's a complicated thing.
author: Lady Gaga
translation: 与众不同很简单，独一无二却不容易。

content: I wish somebody would have told me, that someday these will be the good old days.
author: Macklemore, "Good Old Days"
translation: 真希望有人能提早告诉我，这岁月有天会变成回忆中的美好时光。

content: Who could retain the autumn light fading away? At dusk the marble steps are strewn with withered leaves.
author: 《谢新恩》，李煜（许渊冲译）
translation: 冉冉秋光留不住，满阶红叶暮。

content: I only pray our life be long, and our souls together heavenward fly!
author: 《水调歌头》，苏轼（林语堂译）
translation: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。

content: May the best of your todays be the worst of your tomorrows.
author: Jason Mraz, "Have It All"
translation: 愿你的明天只会过得比今天更好。

content: Knowing is not enough, we must apply. Willing is not enough, we must do.
author: 歌德
translation: 光知道不够，得学会运用。光有决心不行，得付出行动。

content: I have a love in my life. It makes me stronger than anything you can imagine.
author: 《狂野之爱》
translation: 我已经有了人生中的挚爱，你无法想象我现在有多强大。

content: Don't let yesterday take up too much of today.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 别让昨日之事占据今日的太多时间。

content: We will glow in the dark turning dust to gold. And we'll dream it possible.
author: Delacey, "Dream It Possible"
translation: 我们点石成金，在黑暗中闪耀，梦想终将成真。

content: The cure to boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
author: Dorothy Parker
translation: 无聊的解药是好奇心，但好奇心没有解药。

content: The more you praise and celebrate your life, the more there is in life to celebrate.
author: 奥普拉·温弗瑞
translation: 越是赞颂与庆祝生活，生活中就越会有值得庆祝的事。

content: Be happy now. Don't wait for something outside of yourself to make you happy in the future.
author: Earl Nightingale
translation: 现在就开心起来，别把快乐寄托在外在的事物上。

content: When the night is overcome, you may rise to find the sun.
author: Enya, "May It Be"
translation: 当黑夜逝去，愿你起身迎接朝阳。

content: Success is the sum of small efforts — repeated day in and day out.
author: Robert Collier
translation: 成功就是日复一日那一点点小小努力的积累。

content: Freedom is what you do with what's been done to you.
author: 萨特
translation: 自由就是你如何应对自己所经历的一切。

content: Working hard is important. But there is something that matters even more: believing in yourself.
author: 《哈利·波特与凤凰社》
translation: 努力很重要，然而更重要的是：相信自己。

content: Do what you do so well that they will want to see it again and bring their friends.
author: 华特·迪士尼
translation: 做事就要做到让人想带着朋友再来看一次。

content: I never looked back. It distracts from the now.
author: 《超人特工队》
translation: 我从来不回头看，因为那样会让我对现在分心。

content: The greatest weapon against stress is our ability to choose one thought over another.
author: William James
translation: 应对压力最强大的武器，是你有能力换个想法。

content: I play to win.
author: 守望先锋
translation: 玩游戏就是要赢。

content: Living might mean taking chances, but they're worth taking.
author: Lee Ann Womack, "I Hope You Dance"
translation: 生活也许意味着冒险，但值得一试。

content: It doesn't matter where you are, you are nowhere compared to where you can go.
author: Bob Proctor
translation: 跟你可以去到的地方相比，你身处何处并不重要。

content: To infinity and beyond!
author: 《玩具总动员》
translation: 飞向宇宙，浩瀚无垠！

content: You're the song my heart is beating to.
author: Ed Sheeran, "All of the Stars"
translation: 你是一支歌，我以心跳和声。

content: Remember, you're the one who can fill the world with sunshine.
author: 《白雪公主与七个小矮人》
translation: 记住，你可以让世界充满阳光。

content: Don't find a fault. Find a remedy.
author: 亨利·福特
translation: 别纠缠于谁对谁错，重要的是找到解决办法。

content: You don't know about real loss, because that only occurs when you love something more than you love yourself.
author: 《心灵捕手》
translation: 你不了解失去的真正感觉，唯有爱别人胜于自己时才能体会。

content: We awaken in others the same attitude of mind we hold toward them.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 我们如何对待他人，他人就如何对待我们。

content: Look inside you and be strong. And you'll finally see the truth that a hero lies in you.
author: Mariah Carey, "Hero"
translation: 注视自己的内心，学会坚强，你终将发现你就是自己的英雄。

content: Hard work beats talent when talent fails to work hard.
author: 凯文·杜兰特
translation: 有天分却不努力，就会被努力的人击败。

content: Sometimes the right path is not the easiest one.
author: 《风中奇缘》
translation: 有时候，正确的道路并不是最好走的那条。

content: Magic is believing in yourself; if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
author: 歌德
translation: 相信自己是种魔法，能做到这一点，就可以实现任何事。

content: There's the whole world at your feet.
author: 《欢乐满人间》
translation: 全世界都在你的脚下。

content: I hope you can hold on to whatever you've chosen.
author: 《昨日青空》
translation: 无论你选择了什么我都希望你能坚持下去。

content: There is no pressure when you are making a dream come true.
author: 内马尔
translation: 在实现梦想的路上，是不存在压力的。

content: The very things that hold you down are going to lift you up.
author: 《小飞象》
translation: 什么让你摔倒，什么就能让你翱翔。

content: Kindness is more important than wisdom, and the recognition of this is the beginning of wisdom.
author: Theodore Isaac Rubin
translation: 善良比智慧重要，承认这一点，才是智慧的开始。

content: Mortal body; timeless souls.
author: Troye Sivan, "YOUTH"
translation: 肉体可以老去，但灵魂不朽。

content: Whatever you believe with feeling becomes your reality.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 无论什么，只要发自心底地坚信，都能成真。

content: To laugh at yourself is to love yourself.
author: 《米老鼠》
translation: 学会自嘲也是爱自己的一种表现。

content: Halloween will always leave an empty feeling in my stomach that only candy can fill.
author: Anthony T. Hincks
translation: 一到万圣夜，我的肚子就会空虚，只有糖果可以填补。

content: The very best thing you can do for the whole world is to make the most of yourself.
author: Wallace Wattles
translation: 你能为这个世界做的最好的事，就是充分发挥自己的才能。

content: I'll face it with a grin. I'm never giving in.
author: Queen, "The Show Must Go On"
translation: 我会微笑面对，永不放弃。

content: The crisis of today is the joke of tomorrow.
author: H.G.Wells
translation: 今天的危机将成为明天的笑谈。

content: Why do we fall sir? So that we can learn to pick ourselves up.
author: 《蝙蝠侠：侠影之谜》
translation: 我们为什么会摔倒？为了能学会自己站起来。

content: Either write something worth reading or do something worth writing.
author: 本杰明·富兰克林
translation: 要么写值得读的书， 要么就做值得写的事。

content: Whatever our souls are made of, his and mine are the same.
author: 《呼啸山庄》
translation: 不论我们的灵魂是什么做成的，他的和我的是一模一样的。

content: Lights will guide you home. And ignite your bones.
author: Coldplay, "Fix You"
translation: 光芒会指引你回家，点燃你的希望与勇气。

content: Let our advance worrying become advance thinking and planning.
author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
translation: 把事前忧虑的时间，花在事前的思索与准备上。

content: Keep love in your heart. A life without it is like a sunless garden when the flowers are dead.
author: 奥斯卡·王尔德
translation: 让爱长存心间，少了爱，生命就像暗无天日的花园，百花凋零。

content: Venture outside your comfort zone. The rewards are worth it.
author: 《魔发奇缘》
translation: 踏出你的舒适圈去冒险，你会发现所有的回报都是值得的。

content: When I shop, the world gets better.
author: 《一个购物狂的自白》
translation: 剁手的时候，整个世界都变好了。

content: Until you make peace with who you are, you'll never be content with what you have.
author: Doris Mortman
translation: 只有与真实的自己和平相处，才能对自己所拥有的感到满足。

content: Keep moving forward, and if it's time to go, it's time.
author: Stan Lee
translation: 保持前进，步履不停，如果是时候该走了，那就顺其自然。

content: I am beautiful no matter what they say. Words can't bring me down.
author: Christina Aguilera, "Beautiful"
translation: 流言蜚语那又如何，他们无法将我击倒，我活得照样精彩。

content: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 你不必生而伟大，但要开始变得伟大。

content: There are far, far better things ahead than any we leave behind.
author: C.S. Lewis
translation: 比起遗落在过去的，未来还有更加美好的在等待着我们。

content: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 善良的话语或许很简短，很简单，但产生的回响却是无穷止尽。

content: The most important kind of freedom is to be what you really are.
author: Jim Morrison
translation: 论自由，最重要的就是做你自己。

content: The only way to get what you want in this world is through hard work.
author: 《公主与青蛙》
translation: 在世上想求有所得，必须拼命努力。

content: A book should serve as the ax for the frozen sea within us.
author: 弗兰兹·卡夫卡
translation: 书籍是一把利斧，凿开我们内心冰封的海洋。

content: If you really want to do something, you'll find a way. If you don't, you'll find an excuse.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 只要想做，就能找到办法；如果不想，找到的便只是借口。

content: The thankful receiver bears a plentiful harvest.
author: William Blake
translation: 懂得感恩的人，收获的也不会少。

content: The greater the obstacle, the more glory in overcoming it.
author: 莫里哀
translation: 阻碍越大，逾越过去就越光荣。

content: Leave your broken windows open. And in the light just streams. And you get a head, a head full of dreams.
author: Coldplay, "A Head Full of Dreams"
translation: 开启你破碎的心窗，任希望的光影淌过心扉。你就会有，满心梦想。

content: A true hero isn't measured by the size of his strength, but by the strength of his heart.
author: 《大力士》
translation: 真正的英雄凭借的不是蛮力，而是强大的内心。

content: Courage isn't having the strength to go on. It's going on when you don't have strength.
author: 拿破仑·波拿巴
translation: 勇气不是有力气坚持下去，而是即使没有力气依旧能够坚持。

content: Guard well your thoughts when alone and your words when accompanied.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 独处守住心，群处守住嘴。

content: Believe and act as if it were impossible to fail.
author: Charles F. Kettering
translation: 抱着必胜的信念行动。

content: You're the first, the last, my everything.
author: Barry White
translation: 对你，我从一而终，你是我的所有。

content: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
author: 西塞罗
translation: 居无书，犹如人无魂。

content: If you are always trying to be normal, you will never know how amazing you can be.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 你若总想平平凡凡，就永远不知道自己能有多出色。

content: In all of living, have much fun and laughter. Life is to be enjoyed, not just endured.
author: Gordon B. Hinckley
translation: 不管是什么样的生活，都要开心快乐。生活是用来享受的，而不是用来忍受的。

content: Never frown, even when you're sad because you never know who may be falling in love with your smile.
author: Christina Phan
translation: 纵然伤心，也不要愁眉不展，因为你不知是谁会爱上你的笑容。

content: If a man does his best, what else is there?
author: George S. Patton
translation: 如果尽了最大的努力，那还有什么可奢求的呢？

content: Always let your conscience be your guide.
author: 《木偶奇遇记》
translation: 永远要让良知指引你。

content: He who is not everyday conquering some fear has not learned the secret of life.
author: 爱默生
translation: 若不能每天都克服一点恐惧，就无法了解人生的奥秘。

content: How you think about a problem is more important than the problem itself, so always think positively.
author: Norman Vincent Peale
translation: 如何看待问题远比问题本身来得重要，所以永远要正向思考。

content: All the trees are losing their leaves, and not one of them is worried.
author: Donald Miller
translation: 每棵树的树叶都在凋零，却没有一棵树为此而忧心忡忡。

content: There can be miracles when you believe.
author: "When You Believe"
translation: 只要你相信，奇迹就会出现。

content: You've got to get up every morning with determination if you're going to go to bed with satisfaction.
author: George Horace Lorimer
translation: 若想要伴着满足入睡，就必须每天带着决心起床。

content: Love is the one thing we're capable of perceiving that transcends dimensions of time and space.
author: 《星际穿越》
translation: 爱超越时空的维度，能够为我们所感知。

content: Freedom lies in being bold.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 自由源于勇敢。

content: I won't just survive. Oh, you will see me thrive.
author: Katy Perry, "Rise"
translation: 我不会只是艰难苟活，你会见证我冉冉直指蓝天。

content: If you wish to reach the highest, begin at the lowest.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 若想到达最高处，先从最低处做起。

content: Laughter brings out the child in all of us.
author: Bill Cosby
translation: 欢笑激发出我们内心童真的一面。

content: Dreams are the touchstones of our characters.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 梦想是检验我们个性的试金石。

content: Real generosity toward the future lies in giving all to the present.
author: 阿尔贝·加缪
translation: 将一切奉献给当下，就是对未来的真正慷慨。

content: It's up to you how far you go. If you don't try, you'll never know.
author: 《石中剑》
translation: 你想走多远就能走多远，如果连试都不试，又怎么会知道结果呢？

content: Love lives on inside our hearts and always will.
author: 《美女与野兽》
translation: 我们心中，爱仍在，永不渝。

content: Listen to what you know instead of what you fear.
author: Richard Bach
translation: 听从你所了解的，而非你所害怕的。

content: Blessed is the man who expects nothing, for he shall never be disappointed.
author: Alexander Pope
translation: 不去有所期望的人是幸福的，因为他永远不会失望。

content: Regret for the things we did can be tempered by time; it is regret for the things we did not do that is inconsolable.
author: Sydney J. Harris
translation: 若后悔既成之事，时间方可平抚，但若懊悔未竟之事，则永远无法缓和。

content: If I fail, if I succeed, at least I live as I believe.
author: Whitney Houston, "Greatest Love of All"
translation: 失败也好，成功也罢，最起码我坚持自己的信仰。

content: Christmas Eve was a night of song that wrapped itself about you like a shawl.
author: Bess Streeter Aldrich
translation: 平安夜是一个歌唱的夜晚，歌声像围巾一样将你包裹。

content: What is Christmas? It is tenderness for the past, courage for the present, hope for the future.
author: Agnes M. Pahro
translation: 何谓圣诞？是温情脉脉地回首往昔，是坚定勇敢地面对当下，是充满希冀地展望未来。

content: Handwriting is more connected to the movement of the heart.
author: Natalie Goldberg
translation: 书写让我们更能触碰到心灵的律动。

content: The best colour in the whole world is the one that looks good on you.
author: 可可·香奈儿
translation: 和你最搭的颜色，才是世界上最美的颜色。

content: Sometimes when grownups say "forever", they mean "a very long time".
author: 《查理和巧克力工厂》
translation: 有时候大人说的“永远”，只是指“很长一段时间”而已。

content: Courage is fear holding on a minute longer.
author: George S. Patton
translation: 勇气，不过是多坚持了一分钟的恐惧。

content: You can't be paralyzed by fear of failure or you will never push yourself.
author: 阿诺·施瓦辛格
translation: 你绝不能为失败的恐惧所吓倒，否则你将永远不会前进。

content: Every new beginning comes from some other beginning's end.
author: Semisonic, "Closing Time"
translation: 每个终点都会伴随着另一个新的起点。

content: The new year stands before us, like a chapter in a book, waiting to be written.
author: Melody Beattie
translation: 新年就像书里的一个章节，等待着我们去书写。

content: You cannot create experience. You must undergo it.
author: 阿尔贝·加缪
translation: 经验不是凭空造出来的，必须自己去经历。

content: If you walk the footsteps of a stranger, you'll learn things you never knew.
author: 《风中奇缘》
translation: 迈出追寻未知的脚步，你会学到之前你从未了解过的事。

content: Look at the stars; look how they shine for you and everything you do.
author: Coldplay, "Yellow"
translation: 仰望星空，看那满天繁星如何为你、为你所做的一切而闪耀。

content: Keep holding on, 'cause you know we'll make it through.
author: Avril Lavigne, "Keep Holding On"
translation: 坚持下去，因为你清楚我们定会撑过难关。

content: I don't know how I'm going to live with myself if I don't stay true to what I believe.
author: 《血战钢锯岭》
translation: 如果我连自己的信念都无法坚持，我又该如何面对自己？

content: You don't have time to be timid. You must be bold, daring.
author: 《美女与野兽》
translation: 人生没有时间胆怯，你必须勇敢起來。

content: Life doesn't get easier or more forgiving; we get stronger and more resilient.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 生活从未变得更加轻松或宽容，是我们在一点一点变强、变坚韧。

content: Sometimes your whole life boils down to one insane move.
author: 《阿凡达》
translation: 人这一辈子，有时就得靠一次疯狂的举动才能扭转乾坤。

content: The best way out is always through.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 找到出口的最好方式就是一路走到底。

content: Ideas shape the course of history.
author: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯
translation: 想法影响着历史进程。

content: It's supposed to be hard. If it wasn't hard, everyone would do it.
author: 《红粉联盟》
translation: 要做成一件事情本来就不容易，要是不难，岂不是谁都会去做？

content: Give light and people will find the way.
author: Ella Baker
translation: 给予光亮，人们就能找到前方的路。

content: All your lights are red, but I'm green to go.
author: Troye Sivan, "BLUE"（翻译来自@君兮长致亦枯荣）
translation: 你哪怕示以红灯拒我前行，我也会心向绿灯一刻不停。

content: Do not linger to gather flowers to keep them, but walk on, for flowers will keep themselves blooming all your way.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 不要流连于采集花朵，只管向前走，一路上自会有百花盛开。

content: People grow through experience if they meet life honestly and courageously.
author: 埃莉诺·罗斯福
translation: 如果人诚实、勇敢地面对生活，就能从经历中获得成长。

content: You can't sweep other people off their feet, if you can't be swept off your own.
author: Clarence Day
translation: 如果你自己都不欣赏自己，别人也不会为你倾倒。

content: Not having the best situation, but seeing the best in your situation is the key to happiness.
author: Marie Forleo
translation: 快乐的关键在于，即便境遇不是最佳，但依然能看到处境中最好的一面。

content: Never does nature say one thing and wisdom another.
author: Juvenal
translation: 自然与智慧永不相悖。

content: Why are you trying so hard to fit in when you are born to stand out？
author: 《水瓶座女孩》
translation: 你本就生而不凡，为何还要拼命去融入大众呢？

content: Do you know that there's still a chance for you？Cause there's a spark in you.
author: Katy Perry, "Firework"
translation: 你知道吗？你还有机会，因为你心中藏有火花。

content: It is by acts and not by ideas that people live.
author: Anatole France
translation: 人依靠行动而活，而非想法。

content: Even the darkest night will end, and the sun will rise.
author: 《悲惨世界》
translation: 即使再黑暗的夜也会走到尽头，旭日终将升起。

content: Feel the fear and do it anyway.
author: Susan Jeffers
translation: 感受恐惧，放胆去做。

content: Remember there's no such thing as a small act of kindness. Every act creates a ripple with no logical end.
author: Scott Adams
translation: 记住没有小善之举这回事，每一次善行都会激起无穷尽的连锁反应。

content: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.
author: 《春天不是读书天》
translation: 人生匆匆，如果不时常停下脚步四处瞧瞧，你可能就会错过它。

content: You don't have to bend until you break. You just have to get up.
author: Colbie Caillat, "Try"
translation: 你不必一味屈服，让自己受伤，你只需打起精神做自己。

content: We live in the world when we love it.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 我们只有热爱这个世界，才算真正地活着。

content: Catch the moments of your life. Catch them while you're young and quick.
author: 《我们这一天》
translation: 趁你还年轻利落，把握住生命中的每一个瞬间吧。

content: Only one thing can make a soul complete, and that thing is love.
author: 《朗读者》
translation: 只有一样东西可以让灵魂完整，那就是爱。

content: In any given moment we have two options: to step forward into growth or to step back into safety.
author: Abraham Maslow
translation: 任何时刻我们都有两个选择：往前走向成长，或退后走向安全。

content: Life is a collection of moments. The idea is to have as many good ones as you can.
author: 《爱情限时恋未尽》
translation: 生命由一个个瞬间组成，宗旨就是尽可能多地拥抱美好瞬间。

content: Don't let other people get in the way of what you really want.
author: 《伦敦生活》
translation: 不要让别人妨碍你追求你真正想要的。

content: I have crossed oceans of time to find you.
author: 《惊情四百年》
translation: 我跨越了时间的瀚海来把你寻找。

content: Amid the boom of firecrackers a year has come to an end, and the spring wind has wafted warm breath to the wine.
author: 《元日》，王安石（黄新渠译）
translation: 爆竹声中一岁除，春风送暖入屠苏。

content: Hope smiles from the threshold of the year to come, whispering "it will be happier".
author: Alfred Lord Tennyson
translation: 在新年到来之际，希望微笑着轻声低语，“一切会更好”。

content: It's been my experience that you can nearly always enjoy something if you make up your mind firmly that you will.
author: 《小小安妮》
translation: 我的经验是，事情只要下定决心去享受，就基本都能享受。

content: When I am with you, there's no place I'd rather be.
author: Clean Bandit, "Rather Be"
translation: 只要有你相伴，便无他处可比拟。

content: May your past be the sound of your feet upon the ground. Carry on.
author: Fun., "Carry On"
translation: 愿你的过去只是你前进步伐所踏出的声响，继续前行吧。

content: If you believe in yourself enough and know what you want, you're gonna make it happen.
author: Mariah Carey, "Make It Happen"
translation: 如果你足够自信，也知道自己想要什么，就一定会实现心中所想。

content: You will never be able to escape from your heart. So it's better to listen to what it has to say.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 既然无法逃避自己的心，不如就好好地听听它在说些什么。

content: Challenges make you discover things about yourself that you never really knew.
author: Cicely Tyson
translation: 挑战能让你发现自己都不曾了解过的一面。

content: Life is only interesting if life is wide.
author: 《杀死汝爱》
translation: 生活只有变得宽广，才会有趣。

content: Years may wrinkle the skin, but to give up enthusiasm wrinkles the soul.
author: Samuel Ullman
translation: 岁月留痕，只及肌肤；激情不再，皱起心灵。

content: What we have is timeless. My love is endless.
author: Shane Filan, "Beautiful In White"
translation: 你我拥有的，是天长地久；我对你的爱意，无穷无尽。

content: If you don't imagine, nothing ever happens at all.
author: John Green
translation: 想象都不去想象，就什么都不会发生。

content: Hope, it is the only thing stronger than fear.
author: 《饥饿游戏》
translation: 比恐惧更具威力的，只有希望。

content: I see that I am a little piece of a big, big universe, and that makes things right.
author: 《南国野兽》
translation: 我知道我只是这浩瀚宇宙的一粒尘埃，但却是不可或缺的一份子。

content: I'll spend forever wondering if you knew I was enchanted to meet you.
author: Taylor Swift, "Enchanted"
translation: 遇见你，我心花怒放，愿用一生去猜你是否明了。

content: The thoroughfares covered with snow slight. From door to door the moon sheds a pale light. Near is the Lantern Day.
author: 《水龙吟》，晁端礼（许渊冲译）
translation: 九衢雪小，千门月淡，元宵灯近。

content: The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.
author: 李小龙
translation: 成功的勇士也是普通人，但却具有激光般的专注力。

content: The art of love is largely the art of persistence.
author: Albert Ellis
translation: 爱的艺术在很大程度上就是坚持的艺术。

content: No one ever made a difference by being like everyone else.
author: 《马戏之王》
translation: 只想模仿别人，那可做不成什么。

content: If you are not willing to risk the unusual, you will have to settle for the ordinary.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 若不愿冒险去做不寻常之事，你就只能沦为平凡之人。

content: Do I not destroy my enemies when I make them my friends?
author: 林肯
translation: 我化敌为友的同时不正也消灭了敌人吗？

content: The world's full of lonely people afraid to make the first move.
author: 2019奥斯卡最佳影片《绿皮书》
translation: 世界上那么多孤独的人，都害怕迈出第一步。

content: Spectacular achievement is always preceded by unspectacular preparation.
author: Robert H. Schuller
translation: 耀眼的成就往往源自默默地耕耘。

content: Luck is not chance, it's toil; fortune's expensive smile is earned.
author: Emily Dickinson
translation: 幸运不是偶然，靠的是努力。命运之神昂贵的微笑是靠努力赢来的。

content: Build your own dreams, or someone else will hire you to build theirs.
author: Farrah Gray
translation: 筑造你自己的梦想吧，否则别人就会雇佣你去建造他们的。

content: The only unbearable thing is that nothing is unbearable.
author: 《心之全蚀》
translation: 唯一让人无法忍受的事，即事事皆可忍受。

content: If you want to conquer fear, don't sit home and think about it. Go out and get busy.
author: Dale Carnegie
translation: 若想要战胜恐惧，不要只是坐在家里胡思乱想，走出去让自己忙起来。

content: The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love and be loved in return.
author: Nat King Cole, "Nature Boy"
translation: 你会明白，人生中最美好的事，莫过于爱的同时也被爱。

content: Whoever wants to understand much must play much.
author: Gottfried Benn
translation: 玩得多才懂得多。

content: Our greatest enemies, the ones we must fight most often, are within.
author: Thomas Paine
translation: 我们最大的敌人，也是我们最常遇到的敌人，就藏在我们的心里。

content: The night is darkest just before the dawn. And I promise you, the dawn is coming.
author: 《蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士》
translation: 黎明前的夜最黑暗。我向你们保证，黎明就要来到。

content: Never give up on a dream just because of the time it will take to accomplish it. The time will pass anyway.
author: Earl Nightingale
translation: 永远不要因为怕费时间而放弃梦想，无论怎样，时间都会流逝的。

content: A charming woman doesn't follow the crowd. She is herself.
author: Loretta Young
translation: 充满魅力的女人不会随波逐流，她只做她自己。

content: Some love stories aren't epic novels. Some are short stories, but that doesn't make them any less filled with love.
author: 《欲望都市》
translation: 有些爱情故事不会成为史诗，有些只是短篇小说，但同样都满溢着爱。

content: Difficulties are meant to rouse, not discourage. The human spirit is to grow strong by conflict.
author: William Ellery Channing
translation: 困难是用来激励人心的，而不是使人气馁的。挫折使人的心灵日益强大。

content: Appreciation is a wonderful thing. It makes what is excellent in others belong to us as well.
author: 伏尔泰
translation: 欣赏是一件美妙的事，它让别人的优点也成为我们自己的。

content: Study nature, love nature, stay close to nature. It will never fail you.
author: Frank Lloyd Wright
translation: 探究自然，热爱自然，靠近自然，它一定不会辜负你。

content: Failure is the fog through which we glimpse triumph.
author: 《钢铁侠3》
translation: 失败是迷雾，穿过它，我们就可以瞥见光明。

content: The hours we pass with happy prospects in view are more pleasing than those crowned with fruition.
author: Oliver Goldsmith
translation: 比起收获丰硕成果，预期美好前景的时光要来得更加令人快乐。

content: Down by the riverside, I laid my burdens down. Now I'm traveling light.
author: Joel Hanson & Sara Groves, "Traveling Light"
translation: 漫步河畔，卸下满身重负，现在我将轻装前行。

content: Sunlight still prevails above the clouds while a storm is raging below.
author: 阿狸
translation: 就算狂风暴雨，云层之上还是晴空万里。

content: True love cannot be found where it does not truly exist, nor can it be hidden where it truly does.
author: 《亲吻傻瓜》
translation: 真爱不存在的地方，怎么找也找不到，而当真爱到来时，想藏也藏不住。

content: Sometimes we stare so long at a door that is closing that we see too late the one that is open.
author: Alexander Graham Bell
translation: 有时候我们只顾盯着要关上的门，等看到敞开的门时已为时太晚。

content: Success is a state of mind. If you want success, start thinking of yourself as a success.
author: Joyce Brothers
translation: 成功是一种心态。要想成功，就先把自己看作是一个成功者吧。

content: As a rule, men worry more about what they can't see than about what they can.
author: Julius Caesar
translation: 比起看得到的东西，人们通常更担心看不到的。

content: Let your life lightly dance on the edges of Time like dew on the tip of a leaf.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 让你的生命在时间的边缘上翩翩起舞吧，就像露珠在叶尖上那样。

content: What makes you different or weird, that's your strength.
author: Meryl Streep
translation: 那些让你显得与众不同或不寻常的地方，就是你的长处。

content: Some of us may just have to find meaning in the little moments that make up life.
author: 《生活大爆炸》
translation: 我们中的有些人，注定要在日常生活的点滴中去寻找生命的意义。

content: The world is full of magical things patiently waiting for our wits to grow sharper.
author: Bertrand Russell
translation: 大千世界充满神奇，耐心地等着我们变得更加心智敏锐。

content: Success isn't about how your life looks to others. It's about how it feels to you.
author: 米歇尔·奥巴马
translation: 成功无关乎别人眼中你的生活是什么样子，而在于你自己是如何感受的。

content: All things are difficult before they are easy.
author: Thomas Fuller
translation: 凡事必先难后易。

content: It is always the simple that produces the marvelous.
author: Amelia Barr
translation: 非凡皆源于至简。

content: When the sun is shining I can do anything; no mountain is too high, no trouble too difficult to overcome.
author: Wilma Rudolph
translation: 只要阳光普照，没有什么是我做不到的，没有翻不过的高山，也没有战胜不了的困难。

content: It's amazing how you can speak right to my heart. Without saying a word, you can light up the dark.
author: Ronan Keating, "When You Say Nothing At All"
translation: 你一开口就能契合我的心意，这何等的神奇；不言一语，就足以把黑暗驱离。

content: Victory is sweetest when you've known defeat.
author: Malcolm Forbes
translation: 经历失败后品尝到的成功才是最甜的。

content: The more sand that has escaped from the hourglass of our life, the clearer we should see through it.
author: 让-保罗·萨特
translation: 人生如沙漏，流逝的沙越多，越能让我们看清生命的本质。

content: Humor is mankind's greatest blessing.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 人类最大的福分就是会幽默。

content: There's always gonna be another mountain. I'm always gonna wanna make it move.
author: Miley Cyrus, "The Climb"
translation: 人生中总会有一座又一座的山头，而我也会一座一座将其征服。

content: You must not let anyone define your limits because of where you come from. Your only limit is your soul.
author: 《美食总动员》
translation: 不要让别人以出身判断你的能力。唯一能限制你的只有你的内心。

content: The simplest and most effective way for creation is to observe people and matters around you.
author: 娄烨
translation: 最好的工作就是从身边开始，看你身边的人和事，对创作来说最简单有效。

content: The swallows return on New Communal Day; clear and bright follows, after pear blossoms fade.
author: 《破阵子·春景》，晏殊（龚景浩译）
translation: 燕子来时新社，梨花落后清明。

content: Follow your bliss and the universe will open doors for you where there were only walls.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 追随快乐吧，宇宙会在原本只有墙的地方为你敞开大门。

content: The glow of one warm thought is to me worth more than money.
author: Thomas Jefferson
translation: 温暖的想法散发出的光辉，对我的价值胜过金钱。

content: I'll be the one, if you want me to. Anywhere, I would've followed you.
author: A Great Big World, "Say Something"
translation: 只要你愿意，我就是你的唯一；不论去往何处，我都愿跟随你。

content: Act as if what you do makes a difference. It does.
author: William James
translation: 行事当以有用自许，就自然会行之有效。

content: Everything that you always wished for could be yours, should be yours, would be yours.
author: Jordin Sparks, "One Step at a Time"
translation: 你梦想的一切可以属于你，应该属于你，也终将属于你。

content: All you need is the plan, the road map, and the courage to press on to your destination.
author: Earl Nightingale
translation: 你需要做的只有订好计划，准备好地图，鼓起勇气向目的地前进。

content: If I see you next to never, how can we say forever?
author: Richard Marx, "Right Here Waiting"
translation: 倘若此生不能相见，如何誓说海枯石烂。

content: I believe that if one always looked at the skies, one would end up with wings.
author: Gustave Flaubert
translation: 我坚信，总是仰望天空的人，最终一定会展翅高飞。

content: How you live your life is your business; just remember, our hearts and our bodies are given to us only once.
author: 《请以你的名字呼唤我》
translation: 怎样度过你的一生是你自己的事，但请谨记，身体和灵魂只赋予你一次。

content: I arise full of eagerness and energy, knowing well what achievement lies ahead of me.
author: Zane Grey
translation: 我站起身来，满怀期盼，振奋不已，因为我很明白，成功就在前方。

content: We all help each other stay strong. No one is strong alone.
author: 《房间》
translation: 我们都是互相帮助，让彼此坚强有力。没有人可以独自坚强。

content: We must act out passion before we can feel it.
author: 让-保罗·萨特
translation: 要感受热情，须先表达热情。

content: The best thing you can do is know yourself, and feel yourself, and be yourself.
author: 《成为邦德》
translation: 你所能做的事中，最好的就是了解自己，感受自己，并成为自己。

content: You use a glass mirror to see your face; you use works of art to see your soul.
author: 萧伯纳
translation: 你在镜中看到自己的容貌，在艺术作品中见到自己的灵魂。

content: It is the set of the sails, not the direction of the wind that determines which way we will go.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 决定我们去向的不是风的方向，而是如何去架起船帆。

content: Where flowers bloom, so does hope.
author: Lady Bird Johnson
translation: 有鲜花盛开的地方，就有希望。

content: Love yourself. It is important to stay positive because beauty comes from the inside out.
author: Jenn Proske
translation: 要爱你自己，积极向上很重要，因为美丽是由内而外散发出来的。

content: Reading brings us unknown friends.
author: 巴尔扎克
translation: 阅读能让我们结交未知的朋友。

content: You can't be a friendly neighborhood Spider-Man if there's no neighborhood.
author: 《复仇者联盟3：无限战争》
translation: 如果左邻右舍空无一人，你也成不了大家的好邻居蜘蛛侠了。

content: Never forget that it is the spirit with which you endow your work that makes it useful or futile.
author: Adelaide Hasse
translation: 永远记住，你的工作是有效还是徒劳，取决于你工作时投入的心力。

content: The world spins. We stumble on. It is enough.
author: Colum McCann
translation: 世界快速旋转，我们踉跄前行，就已足够。

content: Don't just sit at home, or the life of your dreams will sail right past you.
author: 《华尔街之狼》
translation: 别光待在家里无所事事，否则你梦想的生活将会与你失之交臂。

content: Only when we are no longer afraid do we begin to live.
author: Dorothy Thompson
translation: 我们只有不再有所恐惧，才能真正地开始生活。

content: A good goal is like a strenuous exercise — it makes you stretch.
author: Mary Kay Ash
translation: 好目标就像费力的运动，会拓展你的潜能。

content: We get to decide what our story is. Nobody else gets to tell you what your story is.
author: 《马男波杰克》
translation: 自己的故事自己演绎，别人给不了我们剧本。

content: Without labor nothing prospers.
author: Sophocles
translation: 没有辛勤劳动，就不会有欣欣向荣的一切。

content: Let us always meet each other with smile, for the smile is the beginning of love.
author: Mother Theresa
translation: 让我们永远以微笑示人吧，因为微笑是爱的开始。

content: You can be my safety zone, somewhere I can go when I feel alone.
author: Mike Perry, "The Ocean"
translation: 你可以做我避风的港湾，孤单时我可以去投奔。

content: Sometimes the only way to ward off the darkness is to shine the light of compassion.
author: 《绝望主妇》
translation: 有时，抵挡黑暗的唯一办法就是散发仁慈的光芒。

content: If you wish to survive, you need to cultivate a strong mental attitude.
author: 《阿凡达》
translation: 若想生存下去，就得培养坚强的意志。

content: I love you three thousand.
author: 《复仇者联盟》
translation: 我爱你三千遍。

content: You're the coffee that I need in the morning. You're my sunshine in the rain when it's pouring.
author: Daniel Caesar, "Best Part"
translation: 你是我清晨不可少的咖啡，是瓢泼大雨中的那一抹暖阳。

content: Just so you know, with us, it's never off the table.
author: 《老友记》
translation: 你要知道，我们之间永远都有可能。

content: To me the meanest flower that blows can give thoughts that do often lie too deep for tears.
author: 华兹华斯
translation: 在我看来，最卑微的花朵都有思想， 深藏在眼泪达不到的地方。

content: Most people have the will to win; few have the will to prepare to win.
author: Bobby Knight
translation: 几乎人人都渴望成功，作准备的却寥寥无几。

content: Fear cuts deeper than swords.
author: 《权力的游戏》
translation: 恐惧比利剑更伤人。

content: A mother's arms are more comforting than anyone else's.
author: Princess Diana
translation: 母亲的臂弯最能给人以宽慰。

content: Find a group of people who challenge and inspire you, spend a lot of time with them, and it will change your life.
author: Amy Poehler
translation: 寻找会挑战并鼓舞你的人，多花时间跟他们待在一起，这将改变你的人生。

content: Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world, she walks into mine.
author: 《卡萨布兰卡》
translation: 世界上有那么多的城镇，城镇中有那么多的酒馆，她却走进了我的酒馆。

content: In every person who comes near you look for what is good and strong.
author: John Ruskin
translation: 对于你遇见的每一个人，要寻找他的优点和强项。

content: If there's any kind of magic in this world, it must be in the attempt of understanding someone, sharing something.
author: 《爱在黎明破晓前》
translation: 如果世上真的有什么奇迹，那么一定是去理解他人、与他人分享。

content: Until one has loved an animal, a part of one's soul remains unawakened.
author: Anatole France
translation: 只有爱过动物，我们灵魂的某一部分才能得以苏醒。

content: In a world where you can't fight back, superheroes provide meaningful wish-fulfillment.
author: 《生活大爆炸》
translation: 当一个人身处无力反抗的境地时，超级英雄能满足其心中的愿望。

content: The greatest of faults, I should say, is to be conscious of none.
author: Thomas Carlyle
translation: 我必须得说，最大的过错，莫过于看不到任何过错。

content: Love cures people, both the ones who give it and the ones who receive it.
author: Karl Menninger
translation: 爱给人以疗愈，对给予者与接受者来说皆是如此。

content: When I look back on these days, I'll look and see your face. You were right there for me.
author: Faith Hill, "There You'll Be"
translation: 当我回忆过去，眼前就会浮现你的脸庞，你总会在那守候着我。

content: Great edifices, like great mountains, are the work of the ages.
author: 《巴黎圣母院》
translation: 雄伟的建筑如同巍峨山峦，都是时光的作品。

content: A goal is not always meant to be reached; it often serves simply as something to aim at.
author: 李小龙
translation: 目标不一定永远都要达到，但可以用来帮助我们瞄准方向。

content: To understand the heart and mind of a person, look not at what he has already achieved, but at what he aspires to.
author: 卡里·纪伯伦
translation: 若想了解一个人的内心世界，不要看他过去的成就，而要看他向往什么。

content: Keep your friends close and your enemies closer.
author: 《我为喜剧狂》
translation: 亲近你的朋友，更要亲近你的敌人。

content: The rational and the irrational complement each other. Individually they're far less powerful.
author: 《纸牌屋》
translation: 理性和非理性是互补的。两者分开的话，力量就会小很多。

content: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy, not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
author: Dan Millman
translation: 改变的秘诀，是集中所有精力去建造新的东西，而非与过去抗衡。

content: It's tempting to want to live in the past. It's familiar. It's comfortable, but it's where fossils come from.
author: Mark Waid
translation: 活在过去是一件很诱人的事，因为它既熟悉又舒适。但是化石就是这么来的。

content: In every living thing there is the desire for love.
author: D. H. Lawrence
translation: 每个生命都渴望得到爱。

content: Do not despise the bottom rungs in the ascent to greatness.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 莫要小瞧通往伟大之路的最底层阶梯。

content: Don't give me excuses. Give me results!
author: 《马达加斯加》
translation: 我要的不是借口，而是结果！

content: It is the childlike mind that finds the kingdom.
author: Charles Fillmore
translation: 正是你的童心帮你找到属于自己的王国。

content: Before you find your soul mate, you must first discover your soul.
author: Charles F. Glassman
translation: 在找到灵魂伴侣之前，你得先找到自己的灵魂。

content: I just wanna be myself, and I want you to love me for who I am.
author: Lady Gaga, "Hair"
translation: 我只想做我自己，也希望你能喜欢我本来的样子。

content: Worrying is like a rocking chair; it gives you something to do, but doesn't get you anywhere.
author: 《留级之王》
translation: 担心如同一把摇椅，它让你有事可做，却无法带你去到任何地方。

content: Working hard for something we don't care about is called stress; working hard for something we love is called passion.
author: Simon Sinek
translation: 努力做自己不在乎的事叫做压力；努力做自己喜爱的事叫做激情。

content: Sometimes the most scenic roads in life are the detours you didn't mean to take.
author: Angela N. Blount
translation: 有时，你在人生旅途中无意中绕道而行的沿途风景最是优美。

content: Health is the thing that makes you feel that now is the best time of the year.
author: Franklin Pierce Adams
translation: 身体安康会让人觉得一年之中，此时此刻，最是美好。

content: Don't get so busy making a living that you forget to make a life.
author: Dolly Parton
translation: 千万别为忙着营生而忘了享受人生。

content: The beauty you see in me is a reflection of you.
author: Jalaluddin Rumi
translation: 你在我身上看到的美，正是你的倒影。

content: If you are not willing to learn, no one can help you. If you are determined to learn, no one can stop you.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 不想学习，谁都帮不了你；决计要学，谁也阻止不了你。

content: Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 幸福靠的不是运气，而是选择。

content: To forgive is to set a prisoner free and discover that the prisoner was you.
author: Lewis B. Smedes
translation: 宽恕就是释放囚徒，而你会发现，那个囚徒正是你自己。

content: Don't get all sad-faced about what happened and scrunchy-faced about what could. Just be here now.
author: 《一条狗的使命》
translation: 不必为过去闷闷不乐，也不必为将来眉头紧锁，活在当下就好。

content: The successful man will profit from his mistakes and try again in a different way.
author: Dale Carnegie
translation: 成功人士会从其错误中获益，然后另辟蹊径再做尝试。

content: The trick is that as long as you know who you are and what makes you happy, it doesn't matter how others see you.
author: Wendy Mass
translation: 诀窍是，只要你知道自己是谁，什么能够让你快乐，别人如何看你就无足轻重了。

content: The older I get, the smarter my father seems to get.
author: Tim Russert
translation: 年龄愈长，父亲在我眼里就愈显睿智。

content: If you don't like how things are, change it! You're not a tree.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 如果对现状不满，那就做出改变吧！你又不是一棵树。

content: We've had some tough times, but we've hung in there.
author: Paul Allen
translation: 我们经历过困难时期，但都坚持了下来。

content: Grown-ups work for things. Grown-ups pay. Grown-ups suffer consequences.
author: 《消失的爱人》
translation: 成年人会努力争取，会付出代价，也会承担后果。

content: The more we do, the more we can do.
author: William Hazlitt
translation: 我们做的越多，能做的也就越多。

content: Let's finish what we started.
author: 《末日孤舰》
translation: 有始也要有终。

content: The world of reality has its limits; the world of imagination is boundless.
author: 卢梭
translation: 现实的世界有边界的限制，想象的世界则有无限可能。

content: Every parting from you is like a little eternity.
author: 《魂断蓝桥》
translation: 每一次与你分别都有点像是永别。

content: Work hard, stay positive, and get up early. It's the best part of the day.
author: George Allen, Sr.
translation: 一天之中最美好的莫过于努力工作、积极向上、早早起床。

content: The higher I got, the more amazed I was by the view.
author: 《怦然心动》
translation: 我爬得越高，眼前的风景便愈发令我惊叹。

content: Do you want to know who you are? Don't ask. Act! Action will delineate and define you.
author: Thomas Jefferson
translation: 你想知道自己是什么样的人？不要去追问，行动起来！行动会描绘和定义你的模样。

content: Pure love and suspicion cannot dwell together: at the door where the latter enters, the former makes its exit.
author: Alexandre Dumas
translation: 纯洁的爱情和猜疑水火不容：起了疑心，就会丢了爱情。

content: Aim for the moon. If you miss, you may hit a star.
author: W. Clement Stone
translation: 瞄准月亮，若未能打中，或许还能打中星星。

content: I don't want to be someone that you're settling for. I don't want to be someone that anyone settles for.
author: 《西雅图不眠夜》
translation: 我不想要你将就，也不想成为任何人将就的对象。

content: Let no feeling of discouragement prey upon you, and in the end you are sure to succeed.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 莫让挫折感把你吞噬，最终你就一定会成功。

content: Don't judge each day by the harvest you reap but by the seeds that you plant.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 若要评价每一天，不要看收获的结果如何，而要看播种了什么。

content: None of us can vow to be perfect. In the end, all we can do is promise to love each other with everything we've got.
author: 《老爸老妈浪漫史》
translation: 没有人可以发誓做到完美，最后我们能保证的只有深爱彼此，倾尽所有。

content: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
author: Norman Vincent Peale
translation: 改变下想法，世界也会有所不同。

content: Love ceases to be a pleasure when it ceases to be a secret.
author: Aphra Behn
translation: 爱情一旦不神秘了，也就失去了它的乐趣。

content: He who has conquered doubt and fear has conquered failure.
author: James Lane Allen
translation: 战胜怀疑与恐惧的人，就已经战胜了失败。

content: Normality is a paved road: It's comfortable to walk, but no flowers grow on it.
author: 文森特·梵高
translation: 普普通通是一条铺平的道路：走起来很舒服，但却长不出鲜花。

content: We laughed and kept saying "see you soon", but inside we both knew we'd never see each other again.
author: 《海上钢琴师》
translation: 我们笑着说再见，但我们都心知肚明，再见遥遥无期。

content: There is much opportunity for anyone willing to dedicate himself to his labors.
author: 《燃情岁月》
translation: 愿意付出努力的人拥有的机会也会很多。

content: I went from zero, to my own hero.
author: Katy Perry, "Roar"
translation: 我从零开始，一路逐渐成为自己的英雄。

content: You cannot find peace by avoiding life.
author: 《时时刻刻》
translation: 你无法靠逃避生活来寻求平静。

content: If it scares you, it might be a good thing to try.
author: Seth Godin
translation: 事若让你畏惧，也许就值得你去尝试。

content: Everything you see exists together in a delicate balance.
author: 《狮子王》
translation: 你所看到的一切都在微妙的平衡中共存。

content: Sometimes it takes a wrong turn to get you to the right place.
author: Mandy Hale
translation: 有时候需要拐错个弯才能到达对的地点。

content: Everything we think and feel is creating our future.
author: Rhonda Byrne
translation: 我们的每一个想法和感觉都在塑造着我们的未来。 ​​​​

content: You get in life what you have the courage to ask for.
author: Oprah Winfrey
translation: 人生之中，只要有勇气去争取，就能得偿所愿。

content: Be slow in choosing a friend, slower in changing.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 选朋友要谨慎，换朋友更要谨慎。

content: Lock me in your heart and throw away the key.
author: Mandy Moore, "Lock Me In Your Heart"
translation: 把我锁在你的心里，然后把钥匙给扔了。

content: The two things in life you are in total control over are your attitude and your effort.
author: Billy Cox
translation: 生活中你可以全权掌控的两件事：你的态度和你付出的努力。

content: When I marry, I want it to be because I choose to spend the rest of my life with someone I love.
author: 《童话镇》
translation: 我要是结婚，那得是因为我自己选择和我所爱的人共度余生。

content: There comes a point in time that you got to take control of your own life.
author: 《无耻之徒》
translation: 总有一天你得要去掌控自己的人生。

content: You must take life the way it comes at you and make the best of it.
author: Yann Martel
translation: 要接受生活本来的样子，而后尽力而为。

content: Accept responsibility for your life. Know that it is you who will get you where you want to go, no one else.
author: Les Brown
translation: 要对自己的人生负责，要懂得能让你达成目标的只有你自己，别无他人。

content: Deep summer is when laziness finds respectability.
author: Sam Keen
translation: 盛夏时节，慵懒都变得体面起来。

content: It's not about how badly you want something. It's about what you are capable of!
author: 《疯狂动物城》
translation: 这关乎的不是你的志向有多远大，而是你的能力有多大。

content: You can always hold my hand if you need to feel steady.
author: 《唐顿庄园》
translation: 当你需要踏实感时，你总是可以来牵我的手。

content: There are many ways of going forward, but only one way of standing still.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
translation: 前进的方式有很多种，但停滞不前的方式却只有一种。

content: Don't make promises you can't keep.
author: 《初代吸血鬼》
translation: 守不住的承诺就别说。

content: Don't mistake coincidence for fate.
author: 《迷失》
translation: 不要错把巧合当成命运。

content: I am not what happened to me. I am what I choose to become.
author: Carl Gustav Jung
translation: 发生在我身上的事情定义不了我，我的样子由我自己决定。

content: Whatever the future brings, you are my light.
author: 《风中的女王》
translation: 无论未来如何，你都是我的光。

content: Fill the darkest night, with a brilliant light. Because it's time for you to shine.
author: Owl City, "Shooting Star"
translation: 是到你绽放光芒的时候了，让夺目的光彩驱散这黑夜的阴霾。

content: True happiness is of a retired nature, and an enemy to pomp and noise.
author: Joseph Addison
translation: 真正的幸福不显山不露水，它会摈弃一切浮华和喧嚣。

content: Some people are always grumbling because roses have thorns; I am thankful that thorns have roses.
author: Alphonse Karr
translation: 有些人总是抱怨玫瑰有尖刺，我却要感激尖刺上长出了玫瑰。

content: I've been distracted since the moment I met you.
author: 《生活大爆炸》
translation: 从我遇见你的那一刻起，你就让我分了心。

content: Storms make trees take deeper roots.
author: Dolly Parton
translation: 暴风雨使得树木的根扎得更深。

content: It is one thing to be clever and another to be wise.
author: George R.R. Martin
translation: 聪明和智慧是两码事。

content: The older I get, the less I listen to what people say and the more I look at what they do.
author: Andrew Carnegie
translation: 年龄越大，我越不会听人们嘴上怎么说，而是越会看他们怎么做。

content: It's an extraordinary thing to meet someone who you can bare your soul to.
author: 《暮光之城：破晓（上）》
translation: 遇见一个你能敞开心扉的人，这非比寻常。

content: The music of the far-away summer flutters around the autumn seeking its former nest.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 远去的夏日之曲，飘荡在秋间，找寻它的旧巢。

content: Enjoy the journey of life and not just the endgame.
author: Benedict Cumberbatch
translation: 要享受人生的旅途，而不只是终点。

content: Worry does not empty tomorrow of its sorrow. It empties today of its strength.
author: Corrie Ten Boom
translation: 忧虑不会消除明天的痛苦，只会削弱今天的力气。

content: Not he who has much is rich, but he who gives much.
author: Erich Fromm
translation: 富有的人不是拥有得多，而是给予得多。

content: It is very simple to be happy, but it is very difficult to be simple.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 快乐很简单，但要做到简单却很困难。

content: Love does not consist in gazing at each other, but in looking outward together in the same direction.
author: 安托万·德·圣埃克絮佩里
translation: 爱不在于相互凝望，而在于彼此望向同一个方向。

content: It's so easy to be careless. It takes courage and character to care.
author: 《超脱》
translation: 要不在乎很容易，但在乎却需要勇气和品质。

content: It's the possibility of having a dream come true that makes life interesting.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 梦想有可能成为现实，生活正是因此而有趣。

content: I have to take one thing for granted: that I will love you until the last breath leaves my body.
author: 《唐顿庄园》
translation: 有件事我会视为理所应当：我爱你，直至生命最后一刻。

content: There's no great loss without some small gain.
author: Laura Ingalls Wilder
translation: 凡重大损失都必然会有所益处。

content: Sometimes we have the dream but we are not ourselves ready for the dream. We have to grow to meet it.
author: Louis L'Amour
translation: 有时候，我们虽有梦想，但却还没准备好，我们必须不断成长才能得以企及梦想。

content: Know your strengths, use them wisely, and one man can be worth ten thousand.
author: 《权力的游戏》
translation: 认清自己的长处，并善加利用，一人便可抵万人。

content: In one kiss, you'll know all I haven't said.
author: 巴勃罗·聂鲁达
translation: 一吻之中， 你会明白所有我未说出口的话语。

content: If you focus on results, you will never change. If you focus on change, you will get results.
author: Jack Dixon
translation: 如果你专注于结果，那么你永远不会有改变。如果你专注于改变，你将自然获得结果。

content: A bird is safe in its nest, but that is not what its wings are made for.
author: Amit Ray
translation: 小鸟在巢中最安全，但翅膀可不是为此而生的。

content: Life starts all over again when it gets crisp in the fall.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
translation: 秋高气爽，生命又重新开始孕育。

content: There are no easy answers; there's only living through the questions.
author: Elizabeth George
translation: 生活没有容易的答案，只有去克服重重问题。

content: Worse than not realizing the dreams of your youth would be to have been young and never dreamed at all.
author: Jean Genet
translation: 比未能实现年轻时梦想还糟糕的是年轻时根本就没有梦想。

content: To exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.
author: Henri Bergson
translation: 生存就意味着去改变，改变就意味着成熟，而成熟就意味着孜孜不倦地创造自我。

content: I fell in love with him the way you fall asleep: slowly, and then all at once.
author: 《星运里的错》
translation: 我爱上他，就像入睡一样，渐渐地，然后突然一下子全情投入。

content: Adopting the right attitude can convert a negative stress into a positive one.
author: Hans Selye
translation: 采取正确的态度可以将负面的压力转化为积极的动力。

content: The longest way must have its close; the gloomiest night will wear on to a morning.
author: Harriet Beecher Stowe
translation: 最长的路也有尽头，最黑暗的夜晚也会迎来清晨。

content: I like the night. Without the dark, we'd never see the stars.
author: Stephenie Meyer
translation: 我喜欢夜晚。如果没有黑暗，我们就永远不会看到繁星。

content: Sometimes a problem is just an opportunity in disguise.
author: 《蛇蝎女佣》
translation: 有时候问题不过是伪装起来的机会。

content: It's what you do right now that makes a difference.
author: 《黑鹰坠落》
translation: 你现在所做的是改变现状的关键。

content: Whatever happens tomorrow, we've had today.
author: 《一天》
translation: 不管明天会发生什么，至少我们拥有今天。

content: How are you to imagine anything if the images are always provided for you?
author: 《超脱》
translation: 如果你能想到的东西都在眼前，你的思维又如何插上想象的翅膀呢？

content: It's strange. I felt less lonely when I didn't know you.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre
translation: 真是奇怪。在认识你之前，我没有感到过如此孤单。

content: Selfishness is not living as one wishes to live. It is asking others to live as one wishes to live.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 过自己想要的生活不是自私，要求别人按自己的意愿生活才是。

content: If you don't go after what you want, you'll never have it.
author: Nora Roberts
translation: 不去追逐你所渴求的，你就永远也无法拥有它。

content: Where we love is home, home that our feet may leave, but not our hearts.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
translation: 家，是爱之所在。也许我们脚步渐远，但心从未离开。

content: A heavy dew refreshed the earth at night.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 夜晚厚重的露水滋养着大地。

content: Far and away the best prize that life has to offer is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 毋庸置疑，生活赋予的最好礼物就是有机会努力去做值得做的事情。

content: Good teachers, they inspire you, they entertain you, and you end up learning a ton even when you don't know it.
author: Nicholas Sparks
translation: 好的老师会激励你，给你带来欢乐，悄然无声地教会你很多东西。

content: Keep your head up in failure, and your head down in success.
author: Jerry Seinfeld
translation: 失败时，要高昂起头；成功时，要保持谦逊。

content: Praising what is lost makes the remembrance dear.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 赞美已经失去的事物，让回忆变得惹人喜爱。

content: I think togetherness is a very important ingredient to family life.
author: Barbara Bush
translation: 在我看来，团聚于家庭生活而言不可或缺。

content: Water can carve its way even through stone and when trapped, water makes a new path.
author: 《艺伎回忆录》
translation: 水滴能穿石，即便困于一隅，也能另辟蹊径。

content: You can tell a lot about a person by what's on their playlist.
author: 《再次出发之纽约遇见你》
translation: 通过一个人的播放列表，你可以了解到很多关于他的东西。

content: Our growth depends not on how many experiences we devour, but on how many we digest.
author: Ralph W. Sockman
translation: 成长靠的不是经历有多丰富，而是对过往经历的细细品味和领会。

content: Whatever is worth doing at all is worth doing well.
author: Philip Stanhope
translation: 任何值得做的事，都值得将其做好。

content: A positive attitude will have positive results because attitudes are contagious.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 积极的态度会带来积极的结果，因为态度是具有感染力的。

content: Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom.
author: Francis Bacon
translation: 沉默，好比睡眠，会滋养出智慧。

content: I wouldn't give up being myself for even one second.
author: 《摩登家庭》
translation: 我不会放弃做自己，哪怕一秒也不行。

content: If you want the rainbow, you have to deal with the rain.
author: 《星运里的错》
translation: 想要彩虹，得先忍受雨水。

content: Neither abstinence nor excess ever renders man happy.
author: 伏尔泰
translation: 不论是节制还是过度都不能给人带来快乐。

content: Autumn is deep, alas! I stand on the grass, in the shade of the evergreen trees.
author: 《四园竹》，周邦彦（许渊冲、许明译)
translation: 秋意浓，闲伫立，庭柯影里。

content: If we're kind and polite, the world will be right.
author: 《帕丁顿熊2》
translation: 如果我们温和善良、彬彬有礼的话，世界将会变美好。

content: The only real failure is the failure to try and the measure of success is how we cope with disappointment.
author: 《涉外大饭店》
translation: 唯一真正的失败是放弃尝试；衡量成功的标准是我们如何面对失望。

content: The time spent with you allowed me to feel again.
author: 《大洋之间的灯光》
translation: 与你共度的时光，让我重新苏醒。

content: If you want the best the world has to offer, offer the world your best.
author: Neale Donald Walsch
translation: 若想得到世界上最好的东西，先向世界展现最好的你。

content: I like to feel his eyes on me when I look away.
author: 《爱在黎明破晓前》
translation: 我喜欢当我看向别处时他的目光停留在我身上的感觉。

content: You never know how far you can go unless you run.
author: 《一代骄马》
translation: 你如果不跑起来，就永远不知道自己能走多远。

content: A clear vision, backed by definite plans, gives you a tremendous feeling of confidence and personal power.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 一个清晰的愿景，加以明确计划的支持，会给你极大的信心和个人力量。

content: Never for a second will I be separated from my motherland.
author: 《我和我的祖国》
translation: 我和我的祖国，一刻也不能分割。

content: They say when you meet the love of your life, time stops, and that's true.
author: 《大鱼》
translation: 人们说当你遇上你的挚爱，时间会停止，事实的确如此。

content: When you finally go back to your old hometown, you find it wasn't the old home you missed but your childhood.
author: Sam Ewing
translation: 当你终于重归故里，你会发现自己思念的，不是故乡，而是童年。

content: Life is short; the world is wide, and I want to make some memories.
author: 《妈妈咪呀2》
translation: 生命短暂，世界广阔，我想制造些回忆。

content: It is not the destination so much as the journey, they say.
author: 《加勒比海盗4：惊涛怪浪》
translation: 人们说，旅行的目的地不如旅程来得重要。

content: It was a beautiful bright autumn day, with air like cider and a sky so blue you could drown in it.
author: Diana Gabaldon
translation: 美丽明亮的秋日里，空气闻起来像苹果酒，天空湛蓝无比，让人沉浸其中。

content: Goodness is the only investment that never fails.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 善良是唯一不会失败的投资。

content: You are the softness of the morning dew!
author: Avijeet Das
translation: 你，恰似晨露的温柔！

content: If you don't step forward, you're always in the same place.
author: Nora Roberts
translation: 不向前迈步，你将永远在原地踏步。

content: Downwards is the only way forwards.
author: 《盗梦空间》
translation: 继续下去是唯一的出路。

content: Autumn carries more gold in its pocket than all the other seasons.
author: Jim Bishop
translation: 秋天的口袋里，比其他季节收藏着更多的金黄色。

content: Wisdom is knowing what to do next; virtue is doing it.
author: David Starr Jordan
translation: 知道下一步要做什么是智慧，而行动起来才是美德。

content: In one minute you can change your attitude and in that minute you can change your entire day.
author: Spencer Johnson
translation: 改变你的态度只需一分钟，而这一分钟却能改变你的一整天。

content: A wise man will make more opportunities than he finds.
author: Francis Bacon
translation: 智者创造的机会要比发现的多。

content: Love and a cough cannot be hid.
author: George Herbert
translation: 爱与咳嗽均无法掩藏。

content: Each time dawn appears, the mystery is there in its entirety.
author: René Daumal
translation: 每当曙光出现，神秘面纱被摘下，展露一切。

content: With this hand, I will lift your sorrows.
author: 《僵尸新娘》
translation: 愿以吾手，抚尔心头之忧。

content: The world is more malleable than you think, and it's waiting for you to hammer it into shape.
author: Bono
translation: 这个世界的可塑性比你想的还要大，而它正等着你去将其敲打成形。

content: In matters of healing the body or the mind, vacation is a true genius!
author: Mehmet Murat Ildan
translation: 不论是疗愈身体还是心灵，假期可谓是一个真正的天才！

content: Character is what you know you are, not what others think you have.
author: Marva Collins
translation: 个性是你所了解的自己，而不是别人眼中的你。

content: Today I will do what others won't, so tomorrow I can accomplish what others can't.
author: Jerry Rice
translation: 今日我愿做他人不愿做的，明日我会做成他人做不到的。

content: High achievement always takes place in the framework of high expectation.
author: Charles Kettering
translation: 高成就永远是在高期待的前提下产生。

content: Human beings can alter their lives by altering their attitude of mind.
author: William James
translation: 人若改变心态，便能改变生活。

content: The air was charged with silence and frost.
author: Thomas Hardy
translation: 万籁俱寂，满天霜气。

content: The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.
author: 《花木兰》
translation: 逆境中绽放的花朵才是最珍贵、最美丽的。

content: Knowledge has to be improved, challenged, and increased constantly, or it vanishes.
author: Peter Drucker
translation: 知识需要不断被改进、挑战和积累，否则将不复存在。

content: The supreme happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 人生最大的幸福，就是坚信有人爱我们。

content: All men who have achieved great things have been great dreamers.
author: Orison Swett Marden
translation: 一直以来，凡成大事者都是大梦想家。

content: Don't hide. Live. Follow the sun. You'll make it to tomorrow.
author: 《疯狂原始人》
translation: 不要躲起来，活下去，追随太阳，你就会找到明天。

content: The only safe thing is to take a chance.
author: Elaine May
translation: 唯一稳妥的事是去冒险一试。

content: Luck is the sense to recognize an opportunity and the ability to take advantage of it.
author: Samuel Goldwyn
translation: 运气就是有意识去辨别机会，并能够利用机会。

content: Don't go through life; grow through life.
author: Eric Butterworth
translation: 别只是过活，要通过生活获得成长。

content: I found a love for me. Oh darling, just dive right in and follow my lead.
author: Ed Sheeran, "Perfect"
translation: 我找到了属于我的爱，亲爱的，跟随我的脚步，与我共坠爱河。

content: The bad news is time flies. The good news is you're the pilot.
author: Michael Altshuler
translation: 坏消息是时光飞逝，好消息是时光的领航员是你。

content: This path has been placed before you. The choice is yours alone.
author: 《星球大战前传1：幽灵的威胁》
translation: 路就在你脚下，你自己决定。

content: Defeat is not the worst of failures. Not to have tried is the true failure.
author: George E. Woodberry
translation: 被击倒不是最大的失败，不曾尝试过才是真正的失败。

content: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
author: Annie Dillard
translation: 我们如何度过每一天，当然也就会如何度过一生。

content: High aims form high characters, and great objects bring out great minds.
author: Tryon Edwards
translation: 崇高的目标造就崇高的品格，伟大的志向造就伟大的头脑。

content: If we had no winter, the spring would not be so pleasant.
author: Anne Bradstreet
translation: 如果没有冬天，春天就不会如此悦人。

content: If you have good thoughts, they will shine out of your face like sunbeams and you will always look lovely.
author: Roald Dahl
translation: 你若思想美好，面容就会如阳光般灿烂，看上去永远可爱迷人。

content: In youth we learn; in age we understand.
author: Marie von Ebner-Eschenbach
translation: 少而学，长而知。

content: Buy only because something excites you, not just for the simple act of shopping.
author: Karl Lagerfeld
translation: 别光为买而买，而是要买了让自己兴奋。

content: Sloth, like rust, consumes faster than labor wears, while the used key is always bright.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 懒惰好比铁锈，比操劳更能消耗体力，而常用的钥匙，总是闪闪发亮。

content: Perfection does not exist; you can always do better and you can always grow.
author: Les Brown
translation: 完美并不存在，你永远可以做得更好，并不断获得成长。

content: The soul that sees beauty may sometimes walk alone.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
translation: 看见美的灵魂，有时只能独行。

content: Always walk through life as if you have something new to learn, and you will.
author: Vernon Howard
translation: 生活中无论何时都做好学习新事物的准备，你就能有所学。

content: I like to walk around the fields alone to keep alive the thoughts of you.
author: Ana Terra, “Walk the Road of Love”
translation: 我喜欢独自徜徉于田野，每时每刻想着你。

content: Dwell on the beauty of life. Watch the stars, and see yourself running with them.
author: Marcus Aurelius
translation: 细想生活之美，遥望星辰，想象自己在其中遨游。

content: Patience and diligence, like faith, remove mountains.
author: William Penn
translation: 如同信念一样，耐心和勤奋也可以金石为开。

content: What you do makes a difference, and you have to decide what kind of difference you want to make.
author: Jane Goodall
translation: 你的所作所为会产生影响，至于是何种影响，需要你来定。

content: Opportunities to find deeper powers within ourselves come when life seems most challenging.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 生活看起来最具挑战时，也正是我们发掘内心更大能量的时机。

content: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
author: Marcus Aurelius
translation: 别再浪费时间去争论何为好人，去成为一个好人吧。

content: Silently, like thoughts that come and go, the snowflakes fall, each one a gem.
author: William Hamilton Gibson
translation: 雪落无声，一如来去无声的思绪，每一片都是珍宝。

content: If passion drives you, let reason hold the reins.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 如果驱策你的是热情，那就让理智握住缰绳。

content: Once you replace negative thoughts with positive ones, you'll start having positive results.
author: Willie Nelson
translation: 一旦你淘汰消极思想、选择积极思想，便会开始迎来积极的结果。

content: Develop a passion for learning. If you do, you will never cease to grow.
author: Anthony J. D'Angelo
translation: 培养你对学习的热情，如此，你将永远不会停止成长。

content: I exist as I am; that is enough.
author: Walt Whitman
translation: 我以我的方式存在，这已足够。

content: Letdowns'll get you, and the critics'll test you. But the strong'll survive; another scar may bless you.
author: Sia, “The Greatest”
translation: 你虽然会经历失望，被批评考验，但强者才能生存，新添的伤疤是对你的祝福。

content: Wear gratitude like a cloak and it will feed every corner of your life.
author: Rumi
translation: 心怀感恩，就像身穿斗篷那样，它将滋养你生命的每一个角落。

content: If you have great talents, industry will improve them.
author: Joshua Reynolds
translation: 如果你很有天赋，勤勉会使其更加完善。

content: It is easier to build strong children than to repair broken men.
author: Frederick Douglass
translation: 培养强大的孩子比修复破碎的成年人要来得容易。

content: The only real security that a man can have in this world is a reserve of knowledge, experience and ability.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 在这个世界上，唯一能够给人带来真正安全的，是知识、经验和能力的储备。

content: To know yourself is the first and most important step in the process of pursuing your dreams and goals.
author: Stedman Graham
translation: 了解自己，是追求梦想及目标的第一步，也是最重要的一步。

content: Youth is the gift of nature, but age is a work of art.
author: Stanislaw Jerzy Lec
translation: 青春是自然之赐，而年老是艺术之作。

content: To be a sailor of the world, bound for all ports.
author: Walt Whitman
translation: 做世界的水手，游遍所有的港口。

content: The sun himself is weak when he first rises, and gathers strength and courage as the day gets on.
author: Charles Dickens
translation: 太阳刚升起时也是微弱的，但随着时间的推移，集聚了力量与勇气。

content: Men are disturbed not by things, but by the view which they take of them.
author: Epictetus
translation: 扰人的，不是事情本身，而是如何看待事情。

content: Snowflakes are pretty patterns etched in water's dreams.
author: Anthony T. Hincks
translation: 雪花，是水在梦中镌刻的美丽图案。

content: What drains your spirit drains your body. What fuels your spirit fuels your body.
author: Carolyn Myss
translation: 消耗心灵的也会消耗身体，滋补心灵的，也能滋补身体。

content: Don't bother just to be better than your contemporaries or predecessors. Try to be better than yourself.
author: William Faulkner
translation: 不要只是费心去超越你的同辈或前辈，要试图超越你自己。

content: Procrastination is the thief of time.
author: Edward Young
translation: 拖延是盗走光阴的贼。

content: We either make ourselves miserable, or we make ourselves strong. The amount of work is the same.
author: Carlos Castaneda
translation: 我们要么让自己痛苦，要么让自己强大，两者所需要的工作量是一样的。

content: Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
translation: 道路变黑时说再见的人，是不忠诚的。

content: If you've got a talent, protect it.
author: Jim Carrey
translation: 如果你有天赋，要去保护它。

content: You will never age for me, nor fade, nor die.
author: 《莎翁情史》
translation: 在我眼里你不会变老，不会褪色，不会消逝。

content: Some day you will be old enough to start reading fairy tales again.
author: C.S. Lewis
translation: 有一天，你会成熟到重新开始阅读童话。

content: It's not what you do once in a while; it's what you do day in and day out that makes the difference.
author: Jenny Craig
translation: 起作用的，不是你偶尔做的事，而是你日复一日做的事。

content: To do a common thing uncommonly well brings success.
author: Henry J. Heinz
translation: 将平凡的事做得不同凡响，就能带来成功。

content: If you want to be loved, you have to be worth loving.
author: 《卡萨诺瓦》
translation: 如果你希望被人爱，那你要先值得人家爱你。

content: Find something you're passionate about and keep tremendously interested in it.
author: Julia Child
translation: 找到你热衷的事物，并对它保持极大的兴趣。

content: The great use of a life is to spend it for something that outlasts it.
author: William James
translation: 好好利用人生，就是将人生花在比它更长久的事情上。

content: May the odds be ever in your favor.
author: 《饥饿游戏》
translation: 愿好运永远眷顾你。

content: What good is the warmth of summer, without the cold of winter to give it sweetness?
author: John Steinbeck
translation: 不历冬日严寒，怎知暖夏美好？

content: The ones who love us never really leave us; you can always find them in here.
author: 《哈利·波特与阿兹卡班的囚徒》
translation: 爱我们的人永远不会真正离开，他们会一直存在你的心里。

content: It's you, on your own, picking up the pieces and starting over.
author: 《他其实没那么喜欢你》
translation: 凭借你自己的力量，捡起碎片，从头再来。

content: It is Christmas in the heart that puts Christmas in the air.
author: W. T. Ellis
translation: 正因心中有圣诞，空气中才会洋溢着圣诞的氛围。

content: To be what we are, and to become what we are capable of becoming, is the only end of life.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 做我们自己，并成为我们所能成为的人，是人生唯一的目的。

content: A real loser is someone who's so afraid of not winning; they don't even try.
author: 《阳光小美女》
translation: 真正失败的人，是那种特别害怕不成功，连试都不敢试的人。

content: The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more.
author: Nicholas Sparks
translation: 最好的爱，唤醒我们的灵魂，让我们更有追求。

content: We are made to persist. That's how we find out who we are.
author: Tobias Wolff
translation: 我们生来就是为了坚持，这样我们才能弄清自己是谁。

content: If you don't have anything, you have to act like you own everything.
author: 《阿拉丁》
translation: 如果你一无所有，那就要当做无所不有。

content: If you're brave enough to say goodbye, life will reward you with a new hello.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 只要你勇敢地说再见，生活便会奖励你新的开始。

content: Cheers to a new year and another chance for us to get it right.
author: Oprah Winfrey
translation: 为新的一年，为我们又有机会走向正轨，干杯。

content: Love is that condition in which the happiness of another person is essential to your own.
author: Robert A. Heinlein
translation: 他人的幸福即是自己幸福的根本，这就是爱。

content: Your past is not your potential. In any hour you can choose to liberate the future.
author: Marilyn Ferguson
translation: 你的潜力不在于过去，你随时都可以去解放未来。

content: It is difficulties that show what men are.
author: Epictetus
translation: 困难面前方显人品质。

content: Happy is the man who can make a living by his hobby!
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 以爱好谋生的人是幸福的！

content: Withstanding the cold develops vigor for the relaxing days of spring and summer.
author: Arthur George Crandall
translation: 耐住寒冷，能生出活力，以迎接轻松的春夏时节。
