author: Billie Jean King
translation: 体育塑造你的性格，教会你遵守规则，让你体会输赢——它教会你生活。

content: Champions aren't made in the gyms. Champions are made from something they have deep inside them — a desire, a dream, a vision.
author: Muhammad Ali
translation: 冠军并不诞生于体育馆，而是由其内心深处的渴望、梦想和愿景所造就。

content: I didn't set out to beat the world; I just set out to do my absolute best.
author: Shaun White
translation: 我并没有打算打败世界，我只是全力以赴。

content: I've failed over and over and over again in my life and that is why I succeed.
author: Michael Jordan
translation: 我的人生经历了一次又一次的失败，正因为如此，我才能成功。

content: Faster, Higher, Stronger – Together
author: Olympic Motto
translation: 更快、更高、更强——更团结

content: The brightest stars are those who competed valiantly in the Olympic Games.
author: Shanbay
translation: 在奥运会上拼搏而归的你们是最闪耀的星！

content: Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 智者谈论思想；普通人谈论事情；小人谈论他人。

content: Your life does not get better by chance, it gets better by change.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 让生活变得更好的不是偶然，而是改变。

content: Sometimes the most scenic roads in life are the detours you didn't mean to take.
author: Angela N. Blount
translation: 有时候，最美的景色，就是你无意中绕行所至的沿途风景。

content: A goal is not always meant to be reached; it often serves simply as something to aim at.
author: 李小龙
translation: 目标不一定永远都要达到，但可以用来帮助我们瞄准方向。

content: The more we do, the more we can do.
author: William Hazlitt
translation: 我们做的越多，能做的也就越多。

content: Life is short. Kiss slowly, laugh insanely, love truly and forgive quickly.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 生命短暂，慢慢去吻，放声去笑，真心去爱，尽快原谅。

content: Today a reader, tomorrow a leader.
author: Margaret Fuller
translation: 今日读书人，明日领导者。

content: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 善良的话语或许很简短，很简单，但产生的回响却是无穷止尽。

content: Your present circumstances don't determine where you can go; they merely determine where you start.
author: Nido Qubein
translation: 你的现状并不决定你的终点，而是决定你的起点。

content: The crisis of today is the joke of tomorrow.
author: H. G. Wells
translation: 今天的危机将成为明天的笑谈。

content: It's not about how badly you want something. It's about what you are capable of!
author: 《疯狂动物城》
translation: 光有志向是不够的，重要的是你的能力。

content: Kindness is more important than wisdom, and the recognition of this is the beginning of wisdom.
author: Theodore Isaac Rubin
translation: 善良比智慧重要，承认这一点，才是智慧的开始。

content: People sleep peaceably in their beds at night only because rough men stand ready to do violence on their behalf.
author: George Orwell
translation: 人们能够安然入睡，只因有勇士随时待命作战。

content: Death is not the end of life, forgetting is the end of life.
author: 《寻梦环游记》
translation: 死亡并不是生命的终点，遗忘才是。

content: One that would have the fruit must climb the tree.
author: Thomas Fuller
translation: 要吃果子就得上树。

content: Never frown, even when you're sad because you never know who may be falling in love with your smile.
author: Christina Phan
translation: 纵然伤心，也不要愁眉不展，因为你不知是谁会爱上你的笑容。

content: The whole purpose of education is to turn mirrors into windows.
author: Sydney Harris
translation: 教育的目的就是把镜子变成窗户。

content: To laugh at yourself is to love yourself.
author: 《米老鼠》
translation: 学会自嘲也是爱自己的一种表现。

content: No spring nor summer beauty hath such grace as I have seen in one autumnal face.
author: John Donne
translation: 无论是春天的俏还是夏天的美，都没有秋天的这份优雅。

content: Until you make peace with who you are, you'll never be content with what you have.
author: Doris Mortman
translation: 只有与真实的自己和平相处，才能对自己所拥有的感到满足。

content: The world of reality has its limits; the world of imagination is boundless.
author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau
translation: 现实的世界有边界的限制，想象的世界则有无限可能。

content: You've got to get up every morning with determination if you're going to go to bed with satisfaction.
author: George Horace Lorimer
translation: 若想要伴着满足入睡，就必须每天带着决心起床。

content: High aims form high characters, and great objects bring out great minds.
author: Tryon Edwards
translation: 崇高的目标造就崇高的品格，伟大的志向造就伟大的头脑。

content: In youth we learn; in age we understand.
author: Marie von Ebner-Eschenbach
translation: 少而学，长而知。

content: Whoever is trying to bring you down is already below you.
author: Ziad K. Abdelnour
translation: 无论是谁想要把你打倒，他都已经低你一等了。

content: Defeat is not the worst of failures. Not to have tried is the true failure.
author: George E. Woodberry
translation: 被击倒不是最大的失败，不曾尝试过才是真正的失败。

content: Love looks through a telescope; envy, through a microscope.
author: Josh Billings
translation: 怀爱之人大处着眼，忌妒之人吹毛求疵。

content: If you have good thoughts, they will shine out of your face like sunbeams and you will always look lovely.
author: Roald Dahl
translation: 你若思想美好，面容就会如阳光般灿烂，看上去永远可爱迷人。

content: If we had no winter, the spring would not be so pleasant.
author: Anne Bradstreet
translation: 如果没有冬天，春天就不会如此悦人。

content: Drama is life with the dull bits cut out.
author: Alfred Hitchcock
translation: 戏剧就是去掉了无聊片段的生活。

content: Knowledge has to be improved, challenged, and increased constantly, or it vanishes.
author: Peter Drucker
translation: 知识需要不断被改进、挑战和积累，否则将不复存在。

content: Luck is the sense to recognize an opportunity and the ability to take advantage of it.
author: Samuel Goldwyn
translation: 运气就是有意识去辨别机会，并能够利用机会。

content: It is the supreme art of the teacher to awaken joy in creative expression and knowledge.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 在创造性表达和知识中唤醒快乐，是教师的最高艺术。

content: High achievement always takes place in the framework of high expectation.
author: Charles Kettering
translation: 高成就永远是在高期待的前提下产生。

content: Promote yourself, but do not demote another.
author: Israel Salanter
translation: 提升自己，但不要贬低他人。

content: All men who have achieved great things have been great dreamers.
author: Orison Swett Marden
translation: 一直以来，凡成大事者都是大梦想家。

content: If music be the food of love, play on.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 如果音乐是爱情的食粮，那就演奏下去吧。

content: Human beings can alter their lives by altering their attitude of mind.
author: William James
translation: 人若改变心态，便能改变生活。

content: Even the darkest night will end and the sun will rise.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 即便是漫漫长夜，太阳也终将升起。

content: Character is what you know you are, not what others think you have.
author: Marva Collins
translation: 个性是你所了解的自己，而不是别人眼中的你。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: The supreme happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 人生最大的幸福，就是坚信有人爱我们。

content: Take chances; make mistakes. That's how you grow.
author: Mary Tyler Moore
translation: 去冒险，去犯错。你就是这样成长起来的。

content: I only pray our life be long, and our souls together heavenward fly!
author: 苏轼《水调歌头》（林语堂译）
translation: 但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。

content: The bad news is time flies. The good news is you're the pilot.
author: Michael Altshuler
translation: 坏消息是时光飞逝，好消息是你是时光的领航员。

content: The only safe thing is to take a chance.
author: Elaine May
translation: 唯一稳妥的事是去冒险一试。

content: Don't go through life; grow through life.
author: Eric Butterworth
translation: 别只是过活，要通过生活获得成长。

content: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
author: Annie Dillard
translation: 我们如何度过每一天，当然也就会如何度过一生。

content: Everyone gets the experience. Some get the lesson.
author: T. S. Eliot
translation: 每个人都会有所经历，但只有一些人能从经历中得到教训。

content: A mind is like a parachute. It doesn't work if it is not open.
author: Frank Zappa
translation: 心灵好比降落伞，打开了才能发挥作用。

content: A happy marriage is the union of two good forgivers.
author: Ruth Graham
translation: 两个善解人意的人才能缔造一段幸福的婚姻。

content: Life can only be understood backwards; but it must be lived forwards.
author: Soren Kierkegaard
translation: 回首才能理解生活，但要继续生活，你必须 前行。

content: Whatever you are, be a good one.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 不管你是什么样的人，都要善良。

content: The prosperity of our country consists in everyone's brilliance.
author: Shanbay
translation: 祖国的辉煌，在于每个人都闪耀着自己的光！

content: The prosperity of our country consists in everyone's brilliance.
author: Shanbay
translation: 祖国的辉煌，在于每个人都闪耀着自己的光！

content: The prosperity of our country consists in everyone's brilliance.
author: Shanbay
translation: 祖国的辉煌，在于每个人都闪耀着自己的光！

content: Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
author: Anais Nin
translation: 生活的充实与贫乏取决于一个人的勇气。

content: Discovery consists of seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought.
author: Albert Szent-Gyorgyi
translation: 要有所发现，就要见别人见过的，想没人想过的。

content: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 借鉴昨天，活在今天，憧憬明天。

content: It's better to be a lion for a day than a sheep all your life.
author: Elizabeth Kenny
translation: 一日勇敢，胜过终生温软。

content: The one thing we can never get enough of is love. And the one thing we never give enough of is love.
author: Henry Valentine Miller
translation: 我们永远要不够的是爱，我们永远给得不够多的也是爱。

content: I'm sure we'll meet in the spring. And catch up on everything.
author: Troye Sivan
translation: 我们一定会在春天相见，好好聊个天。

content: It is our choices that show what we truly are, far more than our abilities.
author: J. K. Rowling
translation: 能展现真实的自我的，与其说是我们的能力，倒不如说我们所做的选择。

content: I walk slowly, but I never walk backward.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 我走得慢，但从不后退。

content: The art of being happy lies in the power of extracting happiness from common things.
author: Henry Ward Beecher
translation: 幸福的诀窍在于能从平凡事物中提取快乐。

content: God doesn't require us to succeed, he only requires that you try.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 上帝不要求我们必须成功，只要求我们去尝试。

content: I know my brothers would, with dogwood spray in hand, climb up mountain and miss me so far away.
author: 王维《九月九日忆山东兄弟》（许渊冲 译）
translation: 遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人。

content: Remember to keep the mind calm in difficult moments.
author: Horace
translation: 遇到困难时，记得保持冷静。

content: Friends and good manners will carry you where money won't go.
author: Margaret Walker
translation: 朋友和教养带给你的世界，是金钱所不能及的。

content: Love looks not with the eyes, but with the mind, and therefore is winged Cupid painted blind.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 爱，不是用眼睛看的，而是用心体会的，所以爱神丘比特的眼睛总是蒙着的。

content: Curiosity is the wick in the candle of learning.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 如果学习是一根蜡烛，那好奇心就是烛芯。

content: Spend more time smiling than frowning and more time praising than criticizing.
author: Richard Branson
translation: 多花时间微笑，少花时间蹙眉，多花时间表扬，少花时间批评。

content: Jumping from failure to failure with undiminished enthusiasm is the big secret to success.
author: Savas Dimopoulos
translation: 越过一次次失败，却不丧失热情，才是成功的伟大秘诀。

content: Always seek out the seed of triumph in every adversity.
author: Og Mandino
translation: 在每一次困境中都要寻找胜利的希望。

content: Life begins at the end of your comfort zone.
author: Neale Donald Walsch
translation: 走出舒适区，生活才算开始。

content: Our attitude toward life determines life's attitude towards us.
author: John N. Mitchell
translation: 我们对生活的态度决定了生活对我们的态度。

content: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
author: Winston Churchill
translation: 成功不是终点，失败也不足以致命，最可贵的是继续前进的勇气。

content: The only thing worse than being blind is having sight but no vision.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 没有远见卓识是比失明更糟糕的事情。

content: A fool sees not the same tree that a wise man sees.
author: William Blake
translation: 同一棵树，在愚者和智者的眼中却有所不同。

content: Don't compare your life to others. You have no idea what they have been through.
author: Sam Cawthorn
translation: 不要和别人比生活，你不知道他们经历了什么。

content: Be faithful in small things because it is in them that your strength lies.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 要对微小的事物怀有信念，因为真正的力量存乎其中。

content: The deepest principle in human nature is the craving to be appreciated.
author: William James
translation: 人性中最深刻的本能就是渴望被欣赏。

content: Vitality shows in not only the ability to persist but the ability to start over.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
translation: 顽强的生命力不仅仅体现在坚持的力量，还有重新来过的能力。

content: A heavy dew refreshed the earth at night.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 夜晚厚重的露水滋养着大地。

content: It's the possibility of having a dream come true that makes life interesting.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 梦想有可能成为现实，生活正是因此而有趣。

content: If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door.
author: Milton Berle
translation: 如果机会没有来敲门，那就自己盖个门。

content: Our growth depends not on how many experiences we devour, but on how many we digest.
author: Ralph W. Sockman
translation: 成长靠的不是经历有多丰富，而是对过往经历的细细品味和领会。

content: Adopting the right attitude can convert a negative stress into a positive one.
author: Hans Selye
translation: 采取正确的态度可以将负面的压力转化为积极的动力。

content: Try a little harder to be a little better.
author: Gordon B. Hinckley
translation: 多做点努力，让自己变得更好一点。

content: The older I get, the less I listen to what people say and the more I look at what they do.
author: Andrew Carnegie
translation: 年龄越大，我越不会听人们嘴上怎么说，而是越会看他们怎么做。

content: If winter comes, can spring be far behind?
author: Shelley
translation: 冬天来了，春天还会远吗？

content: Neither abstinence nor excess ever renders man happy.
author: Voltaire
translation: 不论是节制还是过度都不能给人带来快乐。

content: Great minds discuss ideas; average minds discuss events; small minds discuss people.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 智者谈论思想；普通人谈论事情；小人谈论他人。

content: Selfishness is not living as one wishes to live. It is asking others to live as one wishes to live.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 过自己想要的生活不是自私，要求别人按自己的意愿生活才是。

content: We love the things we love for what they are.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 我们热爱那些事物，是因为热爱它们原本的样子。

content: Whatever is worth doing at all is worth doing well.
author: Philip Stanhope
translation: 任何值得做的事，都值得将其做好。

content: Great achievement is usually born of great sacrifice, and is never the result of selfishness.
author: Napoleon Hill
translation: 伟大的成就大多来自于伟大的牺牲，决不是来自于自私自利。

content: To exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.
author: Henri Bergson
translation: 生存就意味着去改变，改变就意味着成熟，而成熟就意味着孜孜不倦地创造自我。

content: Within our dreams and aspirations we find our opportunities.
author: Sugar Ray Leonard
translation: 我们会在梦想和抱负里找到机会。

content: Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom.
author: Francis Bacon
translation: 沉默，好比睡眠，会滋养出智慧。

content: To avoid criticism, do nothing, say nothing and be nothing.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 避免受到批评，只需要不做事，不说话，不成器。

content: The longest way must have its close; the gloomiest night will wear on to a morning.
author: Harriet Beecher Stowe
translation: 最长的路也有尽头，最黑暗的夜晚也会迎来清晨。

content: There is only one success — to be able to spend your life in your own way.
author: Christopher Morley
translation: 能用自己的方式度过一生，只有这样才是成功。

content: It is often easier to ask for forgiveness than to ask for permission.
author: Grace Hopper
translation: 寻求谅解常常比寻求许可更简单。

content: Keep your head up in failure, and your head down in success.
author: Jerry Seinfeld
translation: 失败时，要高昂起头；成功时，要保持谦逊。

content: Love is the master key that opens the gates of happiness.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
translation: 爱是打开幸福之门的万能钥匙。

content: You have not failed until you quit trying.
author: Gordon B. Hinckley
translation: 放弃尝试之时才是失败到来之日。

content: Where we love is home, home that our feet may leave, but not our hearts.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
translation: 家，是爱之所在。也许我们脚步渐远，但心从未离开。

content: If you focus on results, you will never change. If you focus on change, you will get results.
author: Jack Dixon
translation: 如果你专注于结果，那么你永远不会有改变。如果你专注于改变，你将自然获得结果。

content: There are no easy answers; there's only living through the questions.
author: Elizabeth George
translation: 生活没有容易的答案，只有去克服重重问题。

content: Success is achieved by developing our strengths, not by eliminating our weaknesses.
author: Marilyn vos Savant
translation: 获得成功的方式是发挥自己的优点，而不是剔除自己的弱点。

content: Life is about making an impact, not making an income.
author: Kevin Kruse
translation: 生命在于影响他人，而非赚钱糊口。

content: Things do not change. We change.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 万物并没有改变，变的是我们。

content: The wisest mind has something yet to learn.
author: George Santayana
translation: 就算最聪明的头脑也需要学习。

content: Nothing happens until something moves.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 无为必将无获。

content: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 当一切于你皆不利时，请记住，飞机也是逆风起飞的。

content: Judge a man by his questions rather than his answers.
author: Voltaire
translation: 评判一个人的依据是他所提的问题，而非他给出的答案。

content: Never promise more than you can perform.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 不要许下你无法兑现的承诺。

content: He who controls others may be powerful, but he who has mastered himself is mightier still.
author: 老子
translation: 胜人者有力，自胜者强。

content: To be mature means to face, and not evade, every fresh crisis that comes.
author: Fritz Kunkel
translation: 成熟意味着去面对任何来临的危机，而不是逃避。

content: The only source of knowledge is experience.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 经验是知识的唯一来源。

content: Never stand begging for that which you have the power to earn.
author: Miguel de Cervantes
translation: 自己能挣到的，就别去乞求。

content: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
author: Gandhi
translation: 珍惜生活，就像死神即将来临；热爱学习，就像生命能够永恒。

content: Keep your fears to yourself, but share your courage with others.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 把恐惧留在自己心里，把勇气给大家分享。

content: Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 成功往往会降临在那些忙得没空寻找它的人身上。

content: Be true to your word and your work and your friend.
author: John Boyle O'Reilly
translation: 对诺言要信守，对工作要尽责，对朋友要忠诚。

content: While there's life, there is hope.
author: Stephen Hawking
translation: 生命不息，希望不止。

content: Enjoy when you can, and endure when you must.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
translation: 有福享受时，尽情享受；必须承受时，默默忍受。

content: We must be willing to get rid of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 我们必须放下规划好的人生，才能拥抱正在等待我们的生活。

content: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
author: Epictetus
translation: 尽全力做到最好，接受接下来会发生的。

content: We are made wise not by the recollection of our past, but by the responsibility for our future.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 使我们明智的不是对过去的回忆，而是对未来的责任。

content: Problems are not stop signs; they are guidelines.
author: Robert Schuller
translation: 问题的出现不是让你止步，而是给你指路。

content: Once you make a decision, the universe conspires to make it happen.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 一旦你下定决心，整个宇宙都会来帮你实现它。

content: Gratitude is not only the greatest of virtues, but the parent of all others.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
translation: 感恩不仅是最伟大的美德，而且是所有美德之母。

content: No winter lasts forever; no spring skips its turn.
author: Hal Borland
translation: 没有一个冬天不可逾越，没有一个春天不可来临。

content: Pessimism leads to weakness, optimism to power.
author: William James
translation: 悲观导致软弱，乐观带来力量。

content: It is not beauty that endears, it’s love that makes us see beauty.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 并非美丽招人爱，而是爱让我们看到了美丽。

content: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy, not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
author: Dan Millman
translation: 改变的秘诀，是集中所有精力去建造新的东西，而非与过去抗衡。

content: A warm smile is the universal language of kindness.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 温暖的笑容是放之四海皆准的善意表达。

content: Build your own dreams, or someone else will hire you to build theirs.
author: Farrah Gray
translation: 筑造你自己的梦想吧，否则别人会雇你去建造他们的梦想。

content: Life is a dream. Realize it.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 生活是一个梦想，实现它。

content: With self-discipline most anything is possible.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 只要严于自律，大部分事情都可能做成。

content: It’s not so much how busy you are, but why you are busy.
author: Mary Flannery O'Connor
translation: 重要的不是你有多忙，而是你为何而忙。

content: Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
author: Sean Patrick Flanery
translation: 你今天做的事要让未来的你心存感激。

content: What is past is prologue.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 凡为过往，皆为序章。

content: Be at war with your vices, at peace with your neighbors, and let every new year find you a better man.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 与恶癖作战，与邻里为友，新的一年成为更好的人。

content: To know yourself is the first and most important step in pursuing your dreams and goals.
author: Stedman Graham
translation: 了解自己是追求梦想和目标的第一步，也是最重要的一步。

content: The more things you do, the more you can do.
author: Lucille Ball
translation: 你做的事情越多，能做到的事情就越多。

content: All achievements, all earned riches, have their beginning in an idea.
author: Napolean Hill
translation: 所有的成就和财富都是从一个想法开始的。

content: The power of imagination makes us infinite.
author: John Muir
translation: 想象力让我们突破极限。

content: Where there is ruin, there is hope for a treasure.
author: Jalaluddin Rumi
translation: 凡是有废墟的地方，就有可能藏着宝藏。

content: In the middle of every difficulty comes opportunity.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 每一个困境中都会出现机会。

content: Respect other people's feelings. It might mean nothing to you, but it could mean everything to them.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 尊重他人的感受。这对你可能无关紧要，但可能对他人十分重要。

content: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
author: Norman Vincent Peale
translation: 改变你的想法，就是改变了你的世界。

content: Skill and confidence are an unconquered army.
author: George Herbert
translation: 技能和信心是一支不可战胜的军队。

content: And so rock bottom became the solid foundation on which I rebuilt my life.
author: J. K. Rowling
translation: 人生的低谷成为了我重建生活的坚实基础。

content: Life is the sum of all your choices.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 你做的所有抉择造就了你的人生。

content: You are not beaten until you admit it.
author: George Patton
translation: 在你承认之前，你尚未失败。

content: In the end, life teaches us what is important, and that is family.
author: Stephen Covey
translation: 生活最终会让我们明白什么最重要，那就是家庭。

content: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any other one thing.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 牢记一点，你想要成功的决心比其他任何事情都重要。

content: Happiness is the natural flower of duty.
author: Phillips Brooks
translation: 幸福是责任自然而然生出的花朵。

content: The greatest test of courage is to bear defeat without losing heart.
author: Robert Ingersoll
translation: 接受失败而不气馁是对勇气最大的考验。

content: No matter how many goals you have achieved, you must set your sights on a higher one.
author: Jessica Henwick
translation: 不管你实现了多少目标，总要定睛于下一个更远大的。

content: Deciding what not to do is as important as deciding what to do.
author: Steve Jobs
translation: 决定不做什么同决定做什么一样重要。

content: They invented hugs to let people know you love them without saying anything.
author: Bil Keane
translation: 拥抱，是让你一句话也不用说，就让别人知道你爱他们。

content: No amount of anxiety makes any difference to anything that is going to happen.
author: Alan Watts
translation: 再焦虑也不能改变即将要发生的事。

content: Don't be afraid of your fears. They're there to let you know that something is worth it.
author: C. JoyBell C.
translation: 别害怕自己的恐惧，它让你知道有些事情值得去做。

content: If I have seen further, it is by standing on the shoulders of giants.
author: Isaac Newton
translation: 如果我看得更远，那是因为我站在巨人的肩膀上。

content: An ounce of action is worth a ton of theory.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 一盎司的行动，价值相当于一吨的理论。

content: To do nothing is the way to be nothing.
author: Nathaniel Hawthorne
translation: 无所事事终将一事无成。

content: One’s life has value so long as one attributes value to the life of others, by means of love, friendship, indignation and compassion.
author: Simone de Beauvoir
translation: 只要一个人透过爱、友谊、义愤或怜悯，使他人的生活变美好，他的生命就有价值。

content: Don't be pushed around by the fears in your mind. Be led by the dreams in your heart.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 不要被头脑中的恐惧牵制，让心中的梦想指引着你。

content: Only those who risk going too far can possibly find out how far they can go.
author: T. S. Eliot
translation: 唯有那些敢于冒险大步向前的人，才能够了解自己能走多远。

content: You can't help getting older, but you don't have to get old.
author: George Burns
translation: 你无法阻止衰老，但你不一定要变老。

content: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
author: E. E. Cummings
translation: 没有欢笑的一天便最是虚度。

content: Ring out the old, ring in the new.
author: Alfred Tennyson
translation: 辞旧迎新。

content: A happy family is but an earlier heaven.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 幸福的家庭犹如人间天堂。

content: Happiness is not a station you arrive at, but a manner of traveling.
author: Margaret Lee Runbeck
translation: 幸福并不是你所抵达的站点，而是一种旅行的方式。

content: Health and cheerfulness naturally beget each other.
author: Joseph Addison
translation: 安康喜乐，相生相成。

content: The most important thing in life is to learn how to give out love, and to let it come in.
author: Mitch Albom
translation: 生命中最重要的是学会给予爱，同时也要学会接纳爱。

content: Anything looked at closely becomes wonderful.
author: A. R. Ammons
translation: 在近距离的观察下，任何事物都会显得美妙无比。

content: Love is when you are as concerned about someone else's situation as you are about your own.
author: Mitch Albom
translation: 爱就是像关心自己一样去关心别人。

content: The most wasted day of all is that on which we have not laughed.
author: Nicolas Chamfort
translation: 没有笑声的一天就是最虚度的一天。

content: Only an open heart will allow you to float equally between everyone.
author: Mitch Albom
translation: 唯有一颗坦诚的心才能使你平等地对待每个人。

content: The farther behind I leave the past, the closer I am to forging my own character.
author: Isabelle Eberhardt
translation: 我把过去抛得越远，便越接近于我自己锻造的自我。

content: Ill habits gather unseen degrees, as brooks make rivers, rivers run to seas.
author: John Dryden
translation: 正如小溪汇聚成河流，河流汇入大海，坏习惯也会不知不觉积重难返。

content: Don't cry when the sun is gone, because the tears won't let you see the stars.
author: Violeta Parra
translation: 不要在太阳落下时哭泣，因为泪水会让你错过星星。

content: Success is not how high you have climbed, but how you make a positive difference to the world.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 成功不是你爬了多高，而是你如何为这个世界带来积极的影响。

content: Not life, but good life, is to be chiefly valued.
author: Socrates
translation: 最重要的不是生命，而是美好的生命。

content: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 生命如花，爱情是蜜。

content: I'm not telling you it is going to be easy, I'm telling you it's going to be worth it.
author: Art Williams
translation: 我不会告诉你这个过程很容易。我只会说，这一切都是值得的。

content: All of us, at certain moments of our lives, need to take advice and to receive help from other people.
author: Alexis Carrel
translation: 在生命的某些时刻，我们每个人都需要听取他人的意见，接受他人的帮助。

content: Plans to protect air and water, wilderness and wildlife are in fact plans to protect man.
author: Stewart Udall
translation: 那些保护空气、水和野生动物的计划，实际上是为了保护人类自己。

content: If one does not know to which port one is sailing, no wind is favorable.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
translation: 如果你不知道要驶向哪个港口，任何风向都毫无助益。

content: Dads are most ordinary men turned by love into heroes, adventurers, story-tellers, and singers of songs.
author: Pam Brown
translation: 父亲们不过是群普通人，但爱让他们化身英雄、探险家、说书人和歌者。

content: The sun always has ways to reach us.
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
translation: 太阳总有办法照到我们，不管我们在哪里。

content: Whomever you become, whatever you make yourself into, that is who you always were.
author: Tara Westover
translation: 无论你成为谁，无论你把自己变成了什么，那就是你本来的样子。

content: Love is what you've been through with somebody.
author: James Thurber
translation: 爱，就是你和某个人一起经历的一切。

content: You must remember what you are and what you have chosen to become, and the significance of what you are doing.
author: John Williams
translation: 你必须记着自己是什么人，你选择要成为什么人，记住你正在从事的东西的重要意义。

content: First find out what you are capable of, then decide who you are.
author: Tara Westover
translation: 先找出你的能力所在，然后再决定你是谁。

content: Difficulties increase the nearer we get to the goal.
author: Goethe
translation: 我们越接近目标，就会遇到越多困难。

content: True life is lived when tiny changes occur.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 生命中有了细小的变化，才算是真正地活着。

content: Faith doesn’t mean you never doubt. It only means you never act upon your doubts.
author: Orson Scott Card
translation: 拥有信念并不代表毫无疑虑，它只意味着你从不带着疑虑行事。

content: Every sweet has its sour; every evil its good.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 甘饴有其酸涩，恶人亦有善行。

content: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 世界上任何伟业的成就都离不开热情。

content: Courage is doing what you're afraid to do. There can be no courage unless you're scared.
author: Eddie Rickenbacker
translation: 行畏惧之事可谓勇；无畏则无勇。

content: All great achievements require time.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 所有伟大的成就都需要时间的历练。

content: We go where our vision is.
author: Joseph Murphy
translation: 我们的视野有多远，就能走多远。

content: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
author: Plato
translation: 工作中最重要的部分是开始阶段。

content: Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
author: Ovid
translation: 水滴石穿非力之所能为，乃能持之以恒也。

content: If you do not believe you can do it, then you have no chance at all.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 如果你不相信自己能做到，你就永远没有机会做到。

content: Above all, be the heroine of your life, not the victim.
author: Nora Ephron
translation: 成为人生的女主角，而不是受害者，这才是最重要的。

content: Change, like healing, takes time.
author: Veronica Roth
translation: 改变犹如伤口愈合，需要时间。

content: It is easy to live for others, everybody does. I call on you to live for yourself.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 为他人而活很简单，每个人都可以做到。我号召你们为自己而活。

content: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens.
author: Tony DeLiso
translation: 一直怀揣着最美的愿望，倾听内心的声音，再看看会发生什么。

content: The creation of a thousand forests is in one acorn.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 上千森林的形成都源自一颗橡木种子。

content: Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens.
author: Jimi Hendrix
translation: 知识是倾诉，但智慧是倾听。

content: Beauty begins the moment you decide to be yourself.
author: Coco Chanel
translation: 美，从你下决心做自己的那一刻开始。

content: I believe the target of anything in life should be to do it so well that it becomes an art.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 我认为，在生活中，不管做任何事，其目标都应该是将它做到艺术一般完美。

content: Spring is nature's way of saying, "Let's party!"
author: Robin Williams
translation: 春天的到来是大自然在说：“来狂欢吧！”

content: The beautiful journey of today can only begin when we learn to let go of yesterday.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 学会放过昨天，才能开启明天的美好旅程。

content: Real change, enduring change, happens one step at a time.
author: Ruth Bader Ginsburg
translation: 真正的改变，持久的变化，都是一步一步完成的。

content: I think part of my gift, or if I have one, is that I love listening.
author: Eric Clapton
translation: 我觉得我的天赋——如果我有天赋的话——就是我热爱倾听。

content: There is no time like Spring, when life’s alive in everything.
author: Christina Rossetti
translation: 再没有什么时节像春天一样，万物复苏，充满生机。

content: Sometimes if you want to see a change for the better, you have to take things into your own hands.
author: Clint Eastwoods
translation: 有时当你想看到自己变得更好的时候，你就必须自己动手付出努力。

content: Nothing is pleasanter to me than exploring in a library.
author: Walter Savage Landor
translation: 对我来说，没有什么比探索图书馆更快乐的事情了。

content: I alone cannot change the world, but I can cast a stone across the waters to create many ripples.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 我一人之力并不能改变世界，但我往水面抛一块石头，就能激起许多涟漪。

content: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
author: Marie Curie
translation: 生活中没有什么东西是可怕的，它们只是需要被理解。

content: Respond to every call that excites your spirit.
author: Rumi
translation: 回应每一个使你精神振奋的呼唤。

content: You cannot change what you are, only what you do.
author: Philip Pullman
translation: 你无法改变你是谁，只能改变你的所作所为。

content: In peace, sons bury their fathers. In war, fathers bury their sons.
author: Herodotus
translation: 和平时，黑发人送白发人。战争时，白发人送黑发人。

content: The best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas.
author: Linus Pauling
translation: 找到好点子的最佳办法就是多想点子。

content: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
author: George Addair
translation: 你想要的一切都在恐惧的背面。

content: Success is falling nine times and getting up ten.
author: Jon Bon Jovi
translation: 成功就是跌倒九次，第十次仍会站起来。

content: Genius is not that you are smarter than everyone else. It is that you are ready to receive the inspiration.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 天才并不是比其他人聪明，而是时刻准备着迎接灵感的到来。

content: Life is about making an impact, not making an income.
author: Kevin Kruse
translation: 生命在于影响他人，而非赚钱糊口。

content: It's faith that will take you through, and determination that will drive you.
author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett
translation: 信念带你渡过难关，决心为你加油鼓劲。

content: How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
author: Anne Frank
translation: 无需等待就可行动起来，让世界变得更美好——这简直妙不可言！

content: Always do your best. What you plant now, you will harvest later.
author: Og Mandino
translation: 总要竭尽全力。你播种什么，就会收获什么。

content: Why bother to sigh for my clean coat to be smeared? It’s not late to be home for Clear and Bright Festival.
author: 陆游《临安春雨初霁》
translation: 素衣莫起风尘叹，犹及清明可到家。（黄新渠译）

content: Just do the best you can. No one can do more than that.
author: John Wooden
translation: 唯有竭尽全力，此外别无他法。

content: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
author: Les Brown
translation: 我们中有太多人没有践行自己的梦想，因为我们活在担心惧怕中。

content: We can't help everyone, but everyone can help someone.
author: Ronald Reagan
translation: 我们不能帮助所有人，但每个人都能帮到别人。

content: If I am walking with two other men, each of them will serve as my teacher.
author: Confucius
translation: 三人行，必有我师焉。

content: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any one thing.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 时刻牢记，渴望成功的决心比任何事情都重要。

content: Care and diligence bring luck.
author: Thomas Fuller
translation: 细心和勤奋能带来好运。

content: It takes a great deal of courage to stand up to your enemies, but a great deal more to stand up to your friends.
author: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
translation: 要挺身而出对抗敌人的确需要很大的勇气，但要挺身而出反抗朋友却需要更大的勇气。

content: Leave nothing for tomorrow which can be done today.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 今天能做的，就不要拖到明天。

content: If you tell the truth, you don't have to remember anything.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 如果你说实话，就不必刻意记住任何事。

content: Two wrongs don't make a right, but they make a good excuse.
author: Thomas Szasz
translation: 两个人都犯了错不能把事情变成对的，但能成为一个好借口。

content: Life's most persistent and urgent question is "What are you doing for others?"
author: Martin Luther King
translation: 生命中最永恒和急迫的问题便是：你能为别人做些什么？

content: It is not beauty that endears, it's love that makes us see beauty.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 并非美丽招人爱，而是爱让我们看到了美丽。

content: I think of a hero as someone who understands the degree of responsibility that comes with his freedom.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 我认为，英雄是懂得责任和自由同在的人。

content: You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 创新取之不尽用之不竭，越用越多。

content: Every day brings new choices.
author: Martha Beck
translation: 每一天都会有新的选择。

content: It seems the harder I work, the more luck I have.
author: Thomas Jefferson
translation: 我工作愈加努力，似乎就越幸运。

content: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 独自一人，我们能做的很少；团结一心，我们能成就很多。

content: Don't watch the clock. Do what it does. Keep going.
author: Sam Levenson
translation: 不要只看时钟，要效仿时钟，一直前行。

content: We become what we think about.
author: Earl Nightingale
translation: 我们思考什么，就会变成什么。

content: Failure is success if you learn from it.
author: Malcom Forbes
translation: 只要能吸取教训，失败也是成功。

content: Look back, and smile on perils past.
author: Walter Scott
translation: 回首往事，向过去的苦难微笑。

content: When you reach the end of your rope, tie a knot in it and hang on.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
translation: 哪怕希望快要破灭，也要努力挣扎，坚持下去。

content: Success is going from failure to failure without losing enthusiasm.
author: Winston Churchill
translation: 成功是从一次失败走向另一次失败，却从不丧失热情。

content: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 未经你的许可，没人能让你妄自菲薄。

content: Without a struggle, there can be no progress.
author: Frederick Douglass
translation: 没有奋斗，就没有进步。

content: The fruit derived from labor is the sweetest of pleasures.
author: Luc de Clapiers
translation: 劳动所得的果实是最甜美的。

content: In the depth of winter I finally learned that there was in me an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 在隆冬，我终于知道，在我的身体里面，藏着一个无法战胜的夏天。

content: Growth is painful. Change is painful. But nothing is as painful as staying stuck somewhere you don't belong.
author: Mandy Hale
translation: 成长很痛苦，改变很痛苦，但是最痛苦的是卡在你本不应该在的地方。

content: Integrity is the most valuable and respected quality of leadership. Always keep your word.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 诚信是最宝贵和最受尊重的领导品质。永远要信守诺言。

content: One benefit of Summer was that each day we had more light to read by.
author: Jeannette Walls
translation: 夏天的好处之一便是我们有更多的阳光来阅读。

content: We are no longer happy so soon as we wish to be happier.
author: Walter Savage Landor
translation: 在祈求更快乐的那一刻，我们便不再真正快乐。

content: Never deprive someone of hope; it might be all they have.
author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.
translation: 千万不要剥夺别人的希望，那可能是他们所拥有的全部。

content: In fair weather prepare for foul.
author: Thomas Fuller
translation: 宜未雨绸缪。

content: There are no limits to what you can accomplish, except the limits you place on your own thinking.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 你所能完成的事情没有限制，除非你限制了自己的想法。

content: You may not control all the events that happen to you, but you can decide not to be reduced by them.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 你可能无法控制所有发生在你身上的事，但是你可以决定不被它们所累。

content: If you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change.
author: Wayne Dyer
translation: 如果你改变看事物的方式，事物也会因此而改变。

content: We do not remember days, we remember moments.
author: Cesare Pavese
translation: 我们往往记住的不是某一天，而是某个时刻。

content: Nothing is impossible, the word itself says "I'm possible"!
author: Audrey Hepburn
translation: 没有不可能，连“不可能”这个词自己都说：“不，可能！”

content: The true secret of happiness lies in taking a genuine interest in all the details of daily life.
author: William Morris
translation: 快乐的真谛在于对日常生活的点滴都发自内心地感兴趣。

content: Optimism is the one quality more associated with success and happiness than any other.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 与其他品质相比，乐观更能让你获得成功和幸福。

content: Kindness is a language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 友善是一种语言，失聪的人和失明的人也能感受。

content: What you get by achieving your goals is not as important as what you become by achieving your goals.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 你通过达成目标所得到的并不重要，重要的是你通过达成目标而成为什么样的人。

content: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 生命的意义不在于发现你自己，而在于创造你自己。

content: Never limit yourself because of others’ limited imagination; never limit others because of your own limited imagination.
author: Mae Jemison
translation: 不要被他人有限的想象力所限制，也不要用自己有限的想象力限制他人。

content: Today’s accomplishments were yesterday’s impossibilities.
author: Robert H. Schuller
translation: 今日的成就都是在昨日被认为不可能的事。

content: Speak less than you know; have more than you show.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 怀璧慎显，博识谨言。

content: Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about things that matter.
author: Martin Luther King Jr.
translation: 当我们对重要的事保持沉默时，我们人生便开始失去价值。

content: There’s nothing more inspiring than the complexity and beauty of the human heart.
author: Cynthia Hand
translation: 没有什么比人类心灵的复杂与美丽更能鼓舞人心的了。

content: I find the best way to love someone is not to change them, but instead, help them reveal the greatest version of themselves.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 我发现，爱一个人的最好方法不是去改变他们，而是帮助他们呈现最好的自己。

content: To succeed, work hard, never give up and above all, cherish a magnificent obsession.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 要成功，就要努力工作，永不放弃，最重要的是，要怀有强烈的痴迷。

content: There are many ways of going forward, but only one way of standing still.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
translation: 前进的方式有很多种，但停滞不前的方式却只有一种。

content: Happiness is a by-product of an effort to make someone else happy.
author: Gretta Brooker Palmer
translation: 幸福是努力使他人快乐的副产品。

content: Some people are always grumbling because roses have thorns; I am thankful that thorns have roses.
author: Alphonse Karr
translation: 有些人总是抱怨玫瑰有尖刺，我却要感激尖刺上长出了玫瑰。

content: It is difficult to free fools from the chains they revere.
author: Voltaire
translation: 很难使傻瓜摆脱他们所崇尚的束缚。

content: Honest disagreement is often a good sign of progress.
author: Gandhi
translation: 坦诚的分歧往往是进步的好迹象。

content: You must take life the way it comes at you and make the best of it.
author: Yann Martel
translation: 要接受生活本来的样子，而后尽力而为。

content: "There are no seven wonders of the world in the eyes of a child. There are seven million. "
author: Walt Streightiff
translation: 在孩子们眼中，这世上不是只有七大奇迹，而是有七百万种奇迹。

content: A great obstacle to happiness is to expect too much happiness.
author: Bernard de Fontenelle
translation: 获得幸福的一大障碍是对幸福期望太高。

content: The verse of Qu Ping shines as bright as sun and moon, while palaces of Chu vanish like dreams at noon.
author: 《江上吟》（许渊冲 译）
translation: 屈平辞赋悬日月，楚王台榭空山丘。

content: The two things in life you are in total control over are your attitude and your effort.
author: Billy Cox
translation: 生活中你可以全权掌控的两件事：你的态度和你付出的努力。

content: True happiness is not attained through self-gratification, but through fidelity to a worthy purpose.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 真正的幸福不是通过自我满足获得的，而是来自于对有价值目标的忠诚。

content: Love is just a word until someone comes along and gives it meaning.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 爱不过是一个词而已，直到有一个人来到你面前，赋予它意义。

content: Green was the silence, wet was the light, the month of June trembled like a butterfly.
author: Pablo Neruda
translation: 寂静生碧色，黎明露华浓，六月似蝴蝶在颤动。

content: Storms make trees take deeper roots.
author: Dolly Parton
translation: 暴风雨使得树木的根扎得更深。

content: Passion makes the world go round. Love just makes it a safer place.
author: Ice-T
translation: 热情使世界转动。爱让它成为一个更安全的地方。

content: It is very simple to be happy, but it is very difficult to be simple.
author: Tagore
translation: 快乐很简单，但要做到简单却很困难。

content: If you spend your whole life waiting for the storm, you’ll never enjoy the sunshine.
author: Morris West
translation: 如果你一生都在等待暴风雨，你就永远不会享受阳光。

content: It is one thing to be clever and another to be wise.
author: George R.R. Martin
translation: 聪明和智慧是两码事。

content: We are never really happy until we try to brighten the lives of others.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 除非我们努力照亮别人的生活，否则我们永远不会真正快乐。

content: Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for a kindness.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
translation: 哪里有人，哪里就有良善的机会。

content: The real difficulty is to overcome how you think about yourself.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 真正的困难是克服你对自己的看法。

content: The only limit to the height of your achievements is the reach of your dreams and your willingness to work hard for them.
author: Michelle Obama
translation: 唯一限制你成就高度的，是你梦想的限度，以及为之努力的意愿。

content: A loving heart is the beginning of all knowledge.
author: Thomas Carlyle
translation: 一颗充满热爱的心是一切知识的起源。

content: Neutral men are the devil's allies.
author: Edwin Hubbel Chapin
translation: 中立的人是魔鬼的盟友。

content: Culture makes all men gentle.
author: Menander
translation: 文化使人温文尔雅。

content: Good judgment comes from experience, and a lot of that comes from bad judgment.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 正确的决断源自经验，而大部分经验源自错误的决断。

content: One benefit of Summer was that each day we had more light to read by.
author: Jeannette Walls
translation: 夏天的好处之一便是我们有更多的阳光来阅读。

content: Don't go through life, grow through life.
author: Eric Butterworth
translation: 不要此生匆匆过，但求每日都成长。

content: Conformity is the jailer of freedom and the enemy of growth.
author: John F. Kennedy
translation: 从众是羁押自由的狱卒，是阻碍进步的敌人。

content: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
author: Thomas Carlyle
translation: 音乐被赞为天使的语言。

content: Weaknesses are just strengths in the wrong environment.
author: Marianne Cantwell
translation: 弱点不过是优点处在了错误的环境中。

content: If you try to be anyone but yourself, you will fail; if you are not true to your own heart, you will fail.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 如果你试图成为别人而不是你自己，你将会失败；如果你不忠于自己的内心，你也会失败。

content: How you love yourself is how you teach others to love you.
author: Rupi Kaur
translation: 你爱自己的方式教会了别人如何爱你。

content: That it will never come again is what makes life sweet.
author: Emily Dickinson
translation: 生活不会重来，这正是它美好的原因。

content: Respect for ourselves guides our morals, respect for others guides our manners.
author: Laurence Sterne
translation: 对自己的尊重引导着我们的品德，对他人的尊重指导着我们的礼仪。

content: Knowledge will give you power, but character respect.
author: Bruce Lee
translation: 知识会带给你力量，而品格会带给你他人的尊重。

content: If you have good thoughts they will shine out of your face like sunbeams and you will always look lovely.
author: Roald Dahl
translation: 你若思想美好，面容就会如阳光般灿烂，看上去永远可爱迷人。

content: One of the most sincere forms of respect is actually listening to what another has to say.
author: Bryant H. McGill
translation: 表达尊重最真诚的方式之一就是真正倾听别人说的话。

content: Gratitude makes sense of our past, brings peace for today, and creates a vision for tomorrow.
author: Melody Beattie
translation: 感恩之心赋予过去意义，为当下带来平静，为未来创造愿景。

content: There is more treasure in books than in all the pirate's loot on Treasure Island.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 书中的宝藏比海盗在金银岛上的所有战利品还要多。

content: The only thing I knew how to do was to keep on keeping on like a bird that flew.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 我唯一会的事情就是像只飞鸟一样继续前进。

content: Hope sees the invisible, feels the intangible, and achieves the impossible.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 拥有希望可以看见他人不可见的，感受他人不能觉知的，并且实现那些不可能的事。

content: A multitude of small delights constitute happiness.
author: Charles Baudelaire
translation: 幸福就是许多小确幸的总和。

content: First keep peace with yourself, then you can also bring peace to others.
author: Thomas à Kempis
translation: 首先让自己保持平和，然后你也可以给别人带来平和。

content: True love comes quietly, without banners or flashing lights.
author: Erich Segal
translation: 真爱都是悄然降临，既不旗幡招展，也不灯火辉煌。

content: Do not look for happiness outside yourself. The awakened seek happiness inside.
author: Peter Deunov
translation: 不要向外寻找快乐，开悟之人在内心寻找幸福。

content: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 一个人内心有了飞翔的冲动，就不会满足于在地上匍匐。

content: If I create from the heart, nearly everything works; if from the head, almost nothing.
author: Marc Chagall
translation: 如果我随心创作，几乎一切都很顺利；如果我靠头脑来创作，几乎什么也做不成。

content: Without the dark there isn’t light. Without the pain there is no relief.
author: Jenny Lawson
translation: 没有黑暗，也就没有光明。没有痛苦，也就没有痛苦的缓解。

content: Life is partly what we make it, and partly what it is made by the friends we choose.
author: Tennessee Williams
translation: 生活一部分是我们自己创造的，另一部分是由我们选择的朋友造就的。

content: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness, and the word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
author: Carl Jung
translation: 即使是幸福的生活也不可能没有一丝黑暗，如果没有悲伤来平衡，快乐这个词就会失去意义。

content: Nothing is so strong as gentleness, nothing so gentle as real strength.
author: Saint Francis de Sales
translation: 没有什么比温柔更有力量，也没有什么比真正的力量更温柔。

content: True friends are never apart, maybe in distance but never in heart.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 真正的朋友从不分离，也许相距甚远，但心永远相连。

content: The constant happiness is curiosity.
author: Alice Munro
translation: 求知欲是长久的快乐。

content: The hardships that I encountered in the past will help me succeed in the future.
author: Philip Emeagwali
translation: 我过去遇到的困难将帮助我在未来取得成功。

content: Dreams are like stars. You may never touch them, but if you follow them, they will lead you to your destiny.
author: Liam Payne
translation: 梦想就像星星。也许你永远无法触碰，但如果你跟随它们，它们将引领你找到人生的路。

content: All the adversity I’ve had in my life, all my troubles and obstacles, have strengthened me.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 我生命中经历的所有逆境，所有的困难和障碍，都让我变得更强大。

content: Your life is a reflection of your thoughts. If you change your thinking, you change your life.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 你的生活是你思维的反映。如果你改变了你的思维，你就改变了你的生活。

content: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.
author: Stephen Hawking
translation: 无论生活看起来多么困难，总有一些你可以做，并能获得成功的事情。

content: A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and goes to bed at night and in between does what he wants to do.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 成功的生活就是早上起床，晚上睡觉，白天做自己想做的事。

content: Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome.
author: Booker T. Washington
translation: 衡量成功的标准不是看一个人在生活中所处的地位，而是看他所克服的障碍。

content: Live your life as though your every act were to become a universal law.
author: Immanuel Kant
translation: 过好你的生活，就像你的每一个行为都将成为一个普遍规律。

content: Every artist was first an amateur.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 每个艺术家在一开始都是外行。

content: The one thing that doesn’t abide by majority rule is a person’s conscience.
author: 《杀死一只知更鸟》
translation: 世上唯一不能遵循从众原则的东西，是人的良心。

content: The knowledge of the world is only to be acquired in the world, and not in a closet.
author: Lord Chesterfield
translation: 对世界的了解是在世界中获得的，而不是在储物间里。

content: One's destination is never a place, but a new way of seeing things.
author: Henry Miller
translation: 一个人的目的地永远不是某个地方，而是一种看待事物的新方式。

content: We can draw lessons from the past, but we cannot live in it.
author: Lyndon B. Johnson
translation: 我们可以从过去学些什么，但不能活在过去。

content: The wisest mind has something yet to learn.
author: George Santayana
translation: 就连最智慧的人也有东西要学。

content: We've all got both light and dark inside us. What matters is the part we choose to act on. That's who we really are.
author: J.K. Rowling
translation: 我们心中都有光明和黑暗，但更重要的是我们选择哪一面。这才是我们真正的样子。

content: Never help a child with a task at which he feels he can succeed.
author: Maria Montessori
translation: 当一个孩子觉得自己能成功完成一项任务时，千万别去帮他。

content: I cannot give you the formula for success, but I can give you the formula for failure—which is: try to please everybody.
author: Herbert Swope
translation: 我不能给你成功的公式，但我可以给你失败的公式，那就是：试图取悦每个人。

content: Wish not so much to live long as to live well.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 与其希望活得久，不如祈盼过得好。

content: The expert in anything was once a beginner.
author: Helen Hayes
translation: 任何领域的专家也曾是一名初学者。

content: Be a first rate version of yourself, not a second rate version of someone else.
author: Judy Garland
translation: 做一流的自己，不做二流的别人。

content: You were not made to live like brute beasts, but to pursue virtue and knowledge.
author: Dante Alighieri
translation: 人不应当像走兽一样活着，而应该追求知识和美德。

content: Shallow men believe in luck. Strong men believe in cause and effect.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 浅薄者相信运气；有能力的人相信因果。

content: Things are never as bad as they seem.
author: 《杀死一只知更鸟》
translation: 事情永远不会像它看起来那样糟糕。

content: All that is necessary for the triumph of evil is that good men do nothing.
author: Edmund Burke
translation: 欲使恶人得胜，只需好人袖手旁观。

content: He who loses wealth loses much; he who loses a friend loses more; but he who loses courage loses all.
author: Cervantes
translation: 失去财产的人损失很大，失去朋友的人损失更多，而失去勇气的人则失去了一切。

content: Be patient with yourself. Self-growth is tender; it's holy ground. There's no greater investment.
author: Stephen Covey
translation: 要对自己有耐心，自我成长是温柔的过程，是神圣之地，也是最有价值的投资。

content: Reprove thy friend privately; commend him publicly.
author: Solon
translation: 在私下批评你的朋友，在公开场合赞扬他。

content: No matter how small and unimportant what we are doing may seem, if we do it well, it may soon become the step that will lead us to better things.
author: Channing Pollock
translation: 不管我们现在所做的事看起来有多么的微不足道或不重要，如果我们认真地做，它可能很快就会引领我们通向美好事物。

content: The future has several names. For the weak, it is the impossible. For the fainthearted, it is the unknown. For the thoughtful and valiant, it is the ideal.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 未来有几个名字：对软弱的人来说，它叫不可能；对胆怯懦弱的人来说，它叫未知；对于深思熟虑且有勇气的人来说，它叫理想。

content: A person can succeed at almost anything for which they have unlimited enthusiasm.
author: Charles M. Schwab
translation: 只要有无限的热情，一个人几乎可以在任何事情上取得成功。

content: You can do anything you decide to do. You can act to change and control your life; and the procedure, the process, is its own reward.
author: Amelia Earhart
translation: 你可以做任何你决定的事，你可以采取行动改变或控制你的人生；而这过程，本身就是报偿。

content: Those who bring sunshine to the lives of others cannot keep it from themselves.
author: James Barrie
translation: 为他人带来阳光的人，自己也一定会沐浴在阳光下。

content: Most of the important things in the world have been accomplished by people who have kept on trying when there seemed to be no hope at all.
author: Dale Carnegie
translation: 世界上大多数重要的事情，都是由那些在看似毫无希望时还继续努力的人完成的。

content: Many individuals have, like uncut diamonds, shining qualities beneath a rough exterior.
author: Juvenal
translation: 很多人像未经雕琢的钻石，在粗糙的表面下有发光的本质。

content: At the end of the day, let there be no excuses, no explanations, no regrets.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 在一天结束的时候，别留下任何借口、解释或悔恨。

content: The path to your success is not as fixed and inflexible as you think.
author: Misty Copeland
translation: 成功之路并非你想的那么死板和不可改变。

content: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
author: Seneca
translation: 并不是因为事情难我们才不敢去做，而是因为我们不敢做事情才难。

content: There are far, far better things ahead than any we leave behind.
author: C.S. Lewis
translation: 比起遗落在过去的，未来还有更加美好的在等着我们。

content: Without self-discipline, success is impossible, period.
author: Lou Holtz
translation: 无自律，不成功，就这样。

content: I am seeking, I am striving, I am in it with all my heart.
author: Vincent van Gogh
translation: 我在寻找，我在努力，我全身心地投入其中。

content: You are confined only by the walls you build yourself.
author: Andrew Murphy
translation: 限制你的只有你自己筑起的墙。

content: Life's great happiness is to be convinced we are loved.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 人生最大的幸福，就是确信我们是被人爱着的。

content: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
translation: 我们需要决定的是，如何利用好上天赋予我们的时间。

content: Some people could look at a mud puddle and see an ocean with ships.
author: Zora Neale Hurston
translation: 有些人眼望着泥塘，却能看见千帆竞发的海洋。

content: There is just one life for each of us: our own.
author: Euripides
translation: 我们都只有一种生活可以过：自己的生活。

content: Where you stumble and fall, there you will find gold.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 你在哪里跌倒，就会在哪里找到金子。

content: Soon is not as good as now.
author: Seth Godin
translation: 别谈未来，现在就行动。

content: A kind heart is a fountain of gladness, making everything in its vicinity freshen into smiles.
author: Washington Irving
translation: 善良的心就如一口快乐的喷泉，让附近的一切都充满欢笑。

content: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 自律是连接目标与成功的桥梁。

content: Not being heard is no reason for silence.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 没有被听见不是沉默的理由。

content: Winning isn't everything, but wanting it is.
author: Arnold Palmer
translation: 胜利并不能代表一切，而求胜心可以。

content: I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
author: Thomas Edison
translation: 我没有失败，我只是找到了10000种行不通的方法。

content: Never look back unless you are planning to go that way.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 永远不要回头，除非你想走回头路。

content: It is the supreme art of the teacher to awaken joy in creative expression and knowledge.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 在创造性表达和知识中唤醒快乐，是教师的最高艺术。

content: We ran as if to meet the moon.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 我们奔跑着，像去约见月亮。

content: The key to winning is poise under stress.
author: Paul Brown
translation: 获胜的关键是在压力下依旧保持镇静。

content: How you think when you lose determines how long it will be until you win.
author: Gilbert Chesterton
translation: 成为输家时的想法决定了你何时才能取得胜利。

content: The most difficult thing is the decision to act, the rest is merely tenacity.
author: Amelia Earhart
translation: 最困难的是下定决心去做，剩下的只是坚持而已。

content: The courage to imagine the otherwise is our greatest resource, adding color and suspense to all our life.
author: Daniel J. Boorstin
translation: 敢有不同想像的勇气，是我们最大的资产，它使我们的人生增添色彩、充满悬念。

content: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
author: Suzy Kassem
translation: 比起失败，怀疑自己会扼杀更多的梦想。

content: A single day is enough to make us a little larger or, another time, a little smaller.
author: Paul Klee
translation: 一天的时间足以使我们强大一些，也可以使我们弱小一些。

content: All my life through, the new sights of Nature made me rejoice like a child.
author: Marie Curie
translation: 在我的一生中，大自然中的新景象使我像孩子般快乐。

content: Whoever is happy will make others happy too.
author: Anne Frank
translation: 快乐的人会让他人也感到快乐。

content: You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.
author: Beverly Sills
translation: 失败可能会让你失望，但若不去尝试，就必定会失败。

content: True liberty is to have power over oneself in all things.
author: Michel de Montaigne
translation: 真正的自由是在所有时候都能控制自己。

content: People who live the most fulfilling lives are the ones who are always rejoicing at what they have.
author: Richard Carlson
translation: 永远对所拥有的一切感到欣喜的人，是生活最富足的人。

content: Dream big and dare to fail.
author: Norman Vaughan
translation: 敢于梦想，不畏失败。

content: Never be limited by other people's limited imaginations.
author: Mae Jemison
translation: 永远不要被别人有限的想象力所限制。

content: Eloquent speech is not from lip to ear, but rather from heart to heart.
author: William Jennings Bryan
translation: 有说服力的演讲并非由口传递到耳，而是由心到心。

content: When someone loves you, the way they talk about you is different. You feel safe and comfortable.
author: Jess C. Scott
translation: 爱你的人谈起你的方式是不一样的，你会觉得安全又舒服。

content: If something is important enough, even if the odds are against you, you should still do it.
author: Elon Musk
translation: 如果一件事情对你很重要，即使成功的概率很小，你也应该去做。

content: The only reward of virtue is virtue; the only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 对美德的回报是美德，获得友谊的唯一途径是给人以友谊。

content: The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
author: Thomas Edison
translation: 保证成功的要诀就是永远都再多试一次。

content: Do what is right, not what is easy nor what is popular.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 做事就要做正确的，不挑易事，不随大流。

content: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Chinese Proverb
translation: 千里之行，始于足下。

content: Before anything else, preparation is the key to success.
author: Alexander Graham Bell
translation: 准备是成功的关键，这比其他任何事情都重要。

content: Life is ours to be spent, not to be saved.
author: D. H. Lawrence
translation: 我们的生命应当物尽其用，而非固守保存。

content: An unexamined life is not worth living.
author: Socrates
translation: 浑浑噩噩的生活不值得过。

content: It's your life; you don't need someone's permission to live the life you want.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 生活是你自己的，想过什么样的生活，不需要别人的许可。

content: A reader lives a thousand lives before he dies. The man who never reads lives only one.
author: George R.R. Martin
translation: 读书者一生中可以体验一千种人生，而从不阅读的人只能活这一次。

content: The goal isn't to live forever; the goal is to create something that will.
author: Chuck Palahniuk
translation: 人生的目标不是要获得永生，而是要创造永恒。

content: Always remember that you are absolutely unique. Just like everyone else.
author: Margaret Mead
translation: 永远记住你是独一无二的，就像其他人一样。

content: It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
author: Herman Melville
translation: 宁可在创新中失败，也不要在模仿中成功。

content: Life is trying things to see if they work.
author: Ray Bradbury
translation: 生活就是尝试事物，看看它们是否奏效。

content: Make improvements, not excuses. Seek respect, not attention.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 要追求进步，而不是一味地寻找借口，要寻求尊重，而不是一味地博取关注。

content: You can neither win nor lose if you don't run the race.
author: David Bowie
translation: 如果不参加比赛，你既不会赢也不会输。

content: Humanity is won by continuing to play in face of certain defeat.
author: Ralph Ellison
translation: 就算可能失败，也要继续前行，可谓是真正的人。

content: We reform others unconsciously when we walk uprightly.
author: Sophie Swetchine
translation: 当我们行为端正，就会无意中转化他人。

content: We lost because we told ourselves we lost.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 我们失败是因为我们告诉自己失败了。

content: None of us really changes over time. We only become more fully what we are.
author: Anne Rice
translation: 没有人能真正随着时间的推移而改变， 我们只是逐渐成为更加圆满的自己。

content: You must first have a lot of patience to learn to have patience.
author: Stanislaw J. Lec
translation: 你首先得耐下心，才能学会有耐心。

content: Dreaming, after all, is a form of planning.
author: Gloria Steinem
translation: 梦想，说到底，是规划的一种形式。

content: Everyone is necessarily the hero of his own life story.
author: John Barth
translation: 每个人都必定是自己人生故事中的主角。

content: Difficult times often bring out the best in people.
author: Bernie Sanders
translation: 困境总能激发出人最好的一面。

content: No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world.
author: Robin Williams
translation: 不论别人怎么说，言语和想法能改变世界。

content: Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
author: Muhammad Ali
translation: 别放弃。现在吃点苦，然后带着冠军的荣耀度过余生。

content: Parents were invented to make children happy by giving them something to ignore.
author: Ogden Nash
translation: 父母的存在，是有意让孩子忽略一些事情，从而让他们感到欢乐。

content: Be kind, for everyone you meet is fighting a hard battle.
author: Ian Maclaren
translation: 要与人为善，因为你遇到的每个人都在艰苦奋战。

content: A problem is a chance for you to do your best.
author: Duke Ellington
translation: 问题也是机会，你得以把事情做到最好。

content: A person who trusts no one can't be trusted.
author: Jerome Blattner
translation: 不信人者不可信。

content: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
author: Alan Kay
translation: 预知未来的最好方式是创造未来。

content: I always wanted to be somebody, but now I realize I should have been more specific.
author: Lily Tomlin
translation: 过去我总是想成为大人物，但现在发现当时应该更加具体些。

content: I've never known any trouble that an hour's reading didn't assuage.
author: Charles De Secondat
translation: 世间纵有万般扰，读书片刻皆可消。

content: Life is a long lesson in humility.
author: James M. Barrie
translation: 人生是一门漫长的学习谦卑的课。

content: Find a place inside where there's joy, and the joy will burn out the pain.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 在内心找一个欢乐的角落，这欢乐可让痛苦烟消云散。

content: I have decided to stick with love. Hate is too great a burden to bear.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.
translation: 我决定持守友爱，因为仇恨实在令人不堪重负。

content: Keep your face to the sunshine and you cannot see a shadow.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 一直面向阳光，你就不会看到阴暗。

content: Integrity is doing the right thing, even when no one is watching.
author: C. S. Lewis
translation: 诚实是在没人知道的时候也坚持做对的事情。

content: Diligence is the mother of good luck.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 勤奋孕育好运。

content: There is only one happiness in this life, to love and be loved.
author: George Sand
translation: 人生只有一种幸福，爱人并且被人爱。

content: Good habits formed at youth make all the difference.
author: Aristotle
translation: 年轻时养成的良好习惯使人受益终身。

content: A room without books is like a body without a soul.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
translation: 居无书，犹如人无魂。

content: I attribute my success to this: I never gave or took any excuse.
author: Florence Nightingale
translation: 我将自己的成功归结为：我从来不找借口，也从来不接受借口。

content: Every child is an artist. The problem is how to remain an artist once he grows up.
author: Pablo Picasso
translation: 每个孩子都是艺术家，难就难在长大之后还是艺术家。

content: Life is too short to waste your time on people who don't respect, appreciate, and value you.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 人生太短，不要浪费在不尊重、不欣赏、也不珍惜你的人身上。

content: Self-confidence is the first requisite to great undertakings.
author: Samuel Johnson
translation: 自信是成大事的首要条件。

content: Instead of worrying about what you cannot control, shift your energy to what you can create.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 与其担心你无法掌控的，不如将精力花在你能创造的东西上。

content: It's kind of fun to do the impossible.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 做不可能的事还挺有趣的。

content: Intelligence without ambition is a bird without wings.
author: Salvador Dali
translation: 聪明但没有抱负，有如没有翅膀的鸟。

content: Never, never, never give up.
author: Winston Churchill
translation: 不，绝不，永不放弃。

content: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
author: Bruce Lee
translation: 如果你热爱生活，就别浪费时间，因为生活是时间组成的。

content: I am always ready to learn although I do not always like being taught.
author: Winston Churchill
translation: 虽然我并不喜欢有人教我，但我一直乐于学习。

content: Autumn leaves don’t fall; they fly. They take their time and wander on this, their only chance to soar.
author: Delia Owens
translation: 秋叶并不会坠落，它们会飞翔。它们尽情享受着这唯一一次肆意盘旋的机会。

content: It does not do well to dwell on dreams and forget to live, remember that.
author: J.K. Rowling
translation: 记住，不要依赖梦想而忘记生活。

content: I argue thee that love is life. And life hath immortality.
author: Emily Dickinson
translation: 我告诉你，爱就是生命，生命可以不朽。

content: You can overcome anything, if and only if you love something enough.
author: Lionel Messi
translation: 只要也只有你足够热爱某件事，就可以克服任何困难。

content: What seems to us as bitter trials are often blessings in disguise.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 我们看起来似乎痛苦的试炼，常常是伪装起来的好运。

content: If you judge people, you have no time to love them.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 如果你论断人，就没有时间去爱他们了。

content: Character—the willingness to accept responsibility for one's own life—is the source from which self-respect springs.
author: Joan Didion
translation: 人格力量就是愿意为自己的生活承担责任的决心，这正是自尊的来源。

content: It is said the feeling called happiness cannot be known alone.
author: Aleskei Arbusov
translation: 听说，有种叫幸福的感觉无法独享。

content: Nothing behind me, everything ahead of me, as is ever so on the road.
author: Jack Kerouac
translation: 抛开顾虑，探索未知，永远在路上。

content: Let perseverance be your engine and hope your fuel.
author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.
translation: 让坚毅成为你的发动机，让希望成为你的燃料。

content: Compassion is an unstable emotion. It needs to be translated into action, or it withers.
author: Susan Sontag
translation: 激情是一种不稳定的情感：如果不将它转化为行动，它便会枯萎。

content: Not hammer-strokes but dance of the water sings the pebbles into perfection.
author: Tagore
translation: 使卵石臻于完美的，不是锤击，而是水的且歌且舞。
