author: J. K. Rowling
translation: 人生的低谷成为了我重建生活的坚实基础。

content: Faster, Higher, Stronger – Together
author: Olympic Motto
translation: 更快、更高、更强——更团结

content: Winning medals wasn't the point of the Olympics. It's the participating that counts.
author: Pierre de Coubertin
translation: 奥运会的意义不是赢得奖牌，而是参与其中。

content: Sports teaches you character, it teaches you to play by the rules, it teaches you to know what it feels like to win and lose — it teaches you about life.
author: Billie Jean King
translation: 体育塑造你的性格，教会你遵守规则，让你体会输赢——它教会你生活。

content: I didn't set out to beat the world; I just set out to do my absolute best.
author: Shaun White
translation: 我并没有打算打败世界，我只是全力以赴。

content: I've failed over and over and over again in my life and that is why I succeed.
author: Michael Jordan
translation: 我的人生经历了一次又一次的失败，正因为如此，我才能成功。

content: You will never be able to escape from your heart. So it's better to listen to what it has to say.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 既然无法逃避自己的心，不如就好好地听听它在说些什么。

content: If you believe in yourself enough and know what you want, you're gonna make it happen.
author: Mariah Carey, "Make It Happen"
translation: 如果你足够自信，也知道自己想要什么，就一定会实现心中所想。

content: May your past be the sound of your feet upon the ground. Carry on.
author: Fun., "Carry On"
translation: 愿你的过去只是你前进步伐所踏出的声响，继续前行吧。

content: When I am with you, there's no place I'd rather be.
author: Clean Bandit, "Rather Be"
translation: 只要有你相伴，便无他处可比拟。

content: It's been my experience that you can nearly always enjoy something if you make up your mind firmly that you will.
author: 《小小安妮》
translation: 我的经验是，事情只要下定决心去享受，就基本都能享受。

content: I have crossed oceans of time to find you.
author: 《惊情四百年》
translation: 我跨越了时间的瀚海来把你寻找。

content: Life is a collection of moments. The idea is to have as many good ones as you can.
author: 《爱情限时恋未尽》
translation: 生命由一个个瞬间组成，宗旨就是尽可能多地拥抱美好瞬间。

content: In any given moment we have two options: to step forward into growth or to step back into safety.
author: Abraham Maslow
translation: 任何时刻我们都有两个选择：往前走向成长，或退后走向安全。

content: Only one thing can make a soul complete, and that thing is love.
author: 《朗读者》
translation: 只有一样东西可以让灵魂完整，那就是爱。

content: Catch the moments of your life. Catch them while you're young and quick.
author: 《我们这一天》
translation: 趁你还年轻利落，把握住生命中的每一个瞬间吧。

content: We live in the world when we love it.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 我们只有热爱这个世界，才算真正地活着。

content: You don't have to bend until you break. You just have to get up.
author: Colbie Caillat, "Try"
translation: 你不必一味屈服，让自己受伤，你只需打起精神做自己。

content: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.
author: 《春天不是读书天》
translation: 人生匆匆，如果不时常停下脚步四处瞧瞧，你可能就会错过它。

content: Remember there's no such thing as a small act of kindness. Every act creates a ripple with no logical end.
author: Scott Adams
translation: 记住没有小善之举这回事，每一次善行都会激起无穷尽的连锁反应。

content: It is by acts and not by ideas that people live.
author: Anatole France
translation: 人依靠行动而活，而非想法。

content: Do you know that there's still a chance for you？Cause there's a spark in you.
author: Katy Perry, "Firework"
translation: 你知道吗？你还有机会，因为你心中藏有火花。

content: Why are you trying so hard to fit in when you are born to stand out？
author: 《水瓶座女孩》
translation: 你本就生而不凡，为何还要拼命去融入大众呢？

content: Never does nature say one thing and wisdom another.
author: Juvenal
translation: 自然与智慧永不相悖。

content: Not having the best situation, but seeing the best in your situation is the key to happiness.
author: Marie Forleo
translation: 快乐的关键在于，即便境遇不是最佳，但依然能看到处境中最好的一面。

content: You can't sweep other people off their feet, if you can't be swept off your own.
author: Clarence Day
translation: 如果你自己都不欣赏自己，别人也不会为你倾倒。

content: People grow through experience if they meet life honestly and courageously.
author: 埃莉诺·罗斯福
translation: 如果人诚实、勇敢地面对生活，就能从经历中获得成长。

content: Do not linger to gather flowers to keep them, but walk on, for flowers will keep themselves blooming all your way.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 不要流连于采集花朵，只管向前走，一路上自会有百花盛开。

content: All your lights are red, but I'm green to go.
author: Troye Sivan, "BLUE"
translation: 你哪怕示以红灯拒我前行，我也会心向绿灯一刻不停。

content: It's supposed to be hard. If it wasn't hard, everyone would do it.
author: 《红粉联盟》
translation: 要做成一件事情本来就不容易，要是不难，岂不是谁都会去做？

content: The best way out is always through.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 找到出口的最好方式就是一路走到底。

content: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
author: Norman Vincent Peale
translation: 改变你的想法，就是改变了你的世界。

content: Respect other people's feelings. It might mean nothing to you, but it could mean everything to them.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 尊重他人的感受。这对你可能无关紧要，但可能对他人十分重要。

author: Sean Patrick Flanery
translation: 你今天做的事要让未来的你心存感激。

content: It's not so much how busy you are, but why you are busy.
author: Mary Flannery O'Connor
translation: 重要的不是你有多忙，而是你为何而忙。

content: The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.
author: 李小龙
translation: 成功的勇士也是普通人，但却具有激光般的专注力。

content: I'll spend forever wondering if you knew I was enchanted to meet you.
author: Taylor Swift, "Enchanted"
translation: 遇见你，我心花怒放，愿用一生去猜你是否明了。

content: I see that I am a little piece of a big, big universe, and that makes things right.
author: 《南国野兽》
translation: 我知道我只是这浩瀚宇宙的一粒尘埃，但却是不可或缺的一份子。

content: If you don't imagine, nothing ever happens at all.
author: John Green
translation: 想象都不去想象，就什么都不会发生。

content: Years may wrinkle the skin, but to give up enthusiasm wrinkles the soul.
author: Samuel Ullman
translation: 岁月留痕，只及肌肤；激情不再，皱起心灵。

content: Life is only interesting if life is wide.
author: 《杀死汝爱》
translation: 生活只有变得宽广，才会有趣。

content: Challenges make you discover things about yourself that you never really knew.
author: Cicely Tyson
translation: 挑战能让你发现自己都不曾了解过的一面。

content: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens.
author: Tony DeLiso
translation: 一直怀揣着最美的愿望，倾听内心的声音，再看看会发生什么。

content: It is easy to live for others, everybody does. I call on you to live for yourself.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 为他人而活很简单，每个人都可以做到。我号召你们为自己而活。

content: Change, like healing, takes time.
author: Veronica Roth
translation: 改变犹如伤口愈合，需要时间。

content: Above all, be the heroine of your life, not the victim.
author: Nora Ephron
translation: 成为人生的女主角，而不是受害者，这才是最重要的。

content: If you do not believe you can do it, then you have no chance at all.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 如果你不相信自己能做到，你就永远没有机会做到。

content: Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
author: Ovid
translation: 水滴石穿非力之所能为，乃能持之以恒也。

content: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
author: Plato
translation: 工作中最重要的部分是开始阶段。

content: We go where our vision is.
author: Joseph Murphy
translation: 我们的视野有多远，就能走多远。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: Courage is doing what you're afraid to do. There can be no courage unless you're scared.
author: Eddie Rickenbacker
translation: 行畏惧之事可谓勇；无畏则无勇。

content: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 世界上任何伟业的成就都离不开热情。

content: Every sweet has its sour; every evil its good.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 甘饴有其酸涩，恶人亦有善行。

content: Faith doesn't mean you never doubt. It only means you never act upon your doubts.
author: Orson Scott Card
translation: 拥有信念并不代表毫无疑虑，它只意味着你从不带着疑虑行事。

content: True life is lived when tiny changes occur.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 生命中有了细小的变化，才算是真正地活着。

content: Difficulties increase the nearer we get to the goal.
author: Goethe
translation: 我们越接近目标，就会遇到越多困难。

content: First find out what you are capable of, then decide who you are.
author: Tara Westover
translation: 先找出你的能力所在，然后再决定你是谁。

content: You must remember what you are and what you have chosen to become, and the significance of what you are doing.
author: John Williams
translation: 你必须记着自己是什么人，你选择要成为什么人，记住你正在从事的东西的重要意义。

content: Love is what you've been through with somebody.
author: James Thurber
translation: 爱，就是你和某个人一起经历的一切。

content: Whomever you become, whatever you make yourself into, that is who you always were.
author: Tara Westover
translation: 无论你成为谁，无论你把自己变成了什么，那就是你本来的样子。

content: The sun always has ways to reach us.
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
translation: 太阳总有办法照到我们，不管我们在哪里。

content: Dads are most ordinary men turned by love into heroes, adventurers, story-tellers, and singers of songs.
author: Pam Brown
translation: 父亲们不过是群普通人，但爱让他们化身英雄、探险家、说书人和歌者。

content: If one does not know to which port one is sailing, no wind is favorable.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
translation: 如果你不知道要驶向哪个港口，任何风向都毫无助益。

content: Plans to protect air and water, wilderness and wildlife are in fact plans to protect man.
author: Stewart Udall
translation: 那些保护空气、水和野生动物的计划，实际上是为了保护人类自己。

content: All of us, at certain moments of our lives, need to take advice and to receive help from other people.
author: Alexis Carrel
translation: 在生命的某些时刻，我们每个人都需要听取他人的意见，接受他人的帮助。

content: I'm not telling you it is going to be easy, I'm telling you it's going to be worth it.
author: Art Williams
translation: 我不会告诉你这个过程很容易。我只会说，这一切都是值得的。

content: Life is the flower for which love is the honey.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 生命如花，爱情是蜜。

content: Not life, but good life, is to be chiefly valued.
author: Socrates
translation: 最重要的不是生命，而是美好的生命。

content: Success is not how high you have climbed, but how you make a positive difference to the world.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 成功不是你爬了多高，而是你如何为这个世界带来积极的影响。

content: Don't cry when the sun is gone, because the tears won't let you see the stars.
author: Violeta Parra
translation: 不要在太阳落下时哭泣，因为泪水会让你错过星星。

content: Ill habits gather unseen degrees, as brooks make rivers, rivers run to seas.
author: John Dryden
translation: 正如小溪汇聚成河流，河流汇入大海，坏习惯也会不知不觉积重难返。

content: The farther behind I leave the past, the closer I am to forging my own character.
author: Isabelle Eberhardt
translation: 我把过去抛得越远，便越接近于我自己锻造的自我。

content: Only an open heart will allow you to float equally between everyone.
author: Mitch Albom
translation: 唯有一颗坦诚的心才能使你平等地对待每个人。

content: The most wasted day of all is that on which we have not laughed.
author: Nicolas Chamfort
translation: 没有笑声的一天就是最虚度的一天。

content: Love is when you are as concerned about someone else's situation as you are about your own.
author: Mitch Albom
translation: 爱就是像关心自己一样去关心别人。

content: Anything looked at closely becomes wonderful.
author: A. R. Ammons
translation: 在近距离的观察下，任何事物都会显得美妙无比。

content: The most important thing in life is to learn how to give out love, and to let it come in.
author: Mitch Albom
translation: 生命中最重要的是学会给予爱，同时也要学会接纳爱。

content: Health and cheerfulness naturally beget each other.
author: Joseph Addison
translation: 安康喜乐，相生相成。

content: Happiness is not a station you arrive at, but a manner of traveling.
author: Margaret Lee Runbeck
translation: 幸福并不是你所抵达的站点，而是一种旅行的方式。

content: A happy family is but an earlier heaven.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 幸福的家庭犹如人间天堂。

content: All great achievements require time.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 所有伟大的成就都需要时间的历练。

content: You do not write your life with words. You write it with actions.
author: Patrick Ness
translation: 你不是用文字来书写你的人生的，而是用行动。

content: Love recognizes no barriers. It jumps hurdles, leaps fences, penetrates walls to arrive at its destination full of hope.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 爱情不识藩篱。它将跨栏杆、越栅栏、穿围墙，满怀憧憬地抵达终点。

content: Nothing is so strong as gentleness, nothing so gentle as real strength.
author: Saint Francis de Sales
translation: 没有什么比温柔更有力量，也没有什么比真正的力量更温柔。

content: You make a life out of what you have, not what you're missing.
author: Kate Morton
translation: 你是靠自己所拥有的，而不是所缺少的来过你的人生。

content: Never regret. If it's good, it's wonderful. If it's bad, it's experience.
author: Victoria Holt
translation: 永远别去后悔。若结果美好，那很精彩。若结果糟糕，那是经历。

content: You miss 100% of the shots you don't take.
author: Wayne Gretzky
translation: 你不去射门的话，就百分之百进不了球。

content: Life's a mixed bag, no matter who you are.
author: 《时空恋旅人》
translation: 生活总是喜忧参半，无论你是谁。

content: How lucky I am to have something that makes saying goodbye so hard.
author: A.A. Milne
translation: 能拥有一些难以割舍的东西，这是多么幸运啊。

content: Dreams are like stars. You may never touch them, but if you follow them, they will lead you to your destiny.
author: Liam Payne
translation: 梦想就像星星。也许你永远无法触碰，但如果你跟随它们，它们将引领你找到人生的路。

content: Happiness adds and multiplies, as we divide it with others.
author: A. Nielsen
translation: 与他人分享快乐，我们会收获加倍的快乐。

content: That was my way of getting through difficult times of low confidence — hard work.
author: David Beckham
translation: 克服自信低潮的艰难时期，我只用一个方法：努力。

content: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
author: Rumi
translation: 昨天的我聪明，所以我想改变世界；今天的我明智，所以我选择改变自己。

content: You've always had the power my dear, you just had to learn it for yourself.
author: 《绿野仙踪》
translation: 其实你一直有那份力量，你只是需要学着去使用它。

content: You don't love someone because they're perfect. You love them in spite of the fact that they're not.
author: Jodi Picoult
translation: 不是因为一个人完美你才爱，而是即使那人不完美你也会去爱。

content: What is right is not always popular, and what is popular is not always right.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 对的事不见得都受欢迎，受欢迎的事不见得都是对的。

content: Just trust yourself, then you will know how to live.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
translation: 相信自己就对了，你将知道如何过日子。

content: Be careful how you judge people, most of all friends. You don't sum up a man's life in one moment.
author: Al Pacino
translation: 小心你是怎么评判他人的，尤其是朋友。你不能在片刻间总结一个人的一生。

content: Dew turns into frost since tonight; the moon viewed at home is more bright.
author: 杜甫《月夜忆舍弟》（许渊冲 译）
translation: 露从今夜白，月是故乡明。

content: If everything was perfect, you would never learn and you would never grow.
author: Beyonce Knowles
translation: 如果一切皆完美，你就永远不会学到东西，永远不会成长。

content: I'm not afraid of storms, for I'm learning how to sail my ship.
author: 《小妇人》
translation: 我不惧怕暴风雨，因为我正在学习如何驾驭我的船。

content: So often people are working hard at the wrong thing. Working on the right thing is probably more important than working hard.
author: Caterina Fake
translation: 很多时候人们努力错了方向，在对的事情上努力可能比努力本身还重要。

content: The minute you think, 'Oh, this is how life is', life finds a way of surprising you.
author: 《爱宠大机密2》
translation: 当你想着“哦，生活就是这样的”的时候，生活总会给你带来惊喜。

content: It took me 17 years and 114 days to become an overnight success.
author: Lionel Messi
translation: 我花了17年又114天的时间才在一夕之间成功。

content: I am not afraid of tomorrow for I have seen yesterday and I love today.
author: William Allen White
translation: 我不害怕明天，因为我经历过昨天，又热爱今天。

content: We can't all be heroes, because somebody has to sit on the curb and applaud when they go by.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 我们不可能都成为英雄，总得有人在英雄走过的时候坐在路边鼓掌。

content: Youth is happy because it has the capacity to see beauty. Anyone who keeps the ability to see beauty never grows old.
author: Franz Kafka
translation: 青春之欢愉在于发现美的能力。而所有能发现美的人，会永远年轻。

content: Don't settle for what life gives you; make life better and build something.
author: Ashton Kutcher
translation: 不要满足于生活赋予你的，要有所创造，让人生变得更好。

content: True self-discovery begins where your comfort zone ends.
author: Adam Braun
translation: 真正的自我发现，始于你踏出了你的舒适区。

content: Life isn't tied with a bow, but it's still a gift.
author: Regina Brett
translation: 生活没有打上蝴蝶结，但它仍是一份礼物。

content: We don't want to tell our dreams. We want to show them.
author: Cristiano Ronaldo
translation: 我们不想把梦想说出来，而是想展现出来。

content: The secret of discipline is motivation. When a man is sufficiently motivated, discipline will take care of itself.
author: Sir Alexander Paterson
translation: 自律的关键是动机，当一个人的动力足够时，他自然就能自律。

content: To fall in love with yourself is the first secret to happiness.
author: Robert Morley
translation: 爱上自己是通往幸福的第一条奥秘。

content: The most beautiful discovery true friends make is that they can grow separately without growing apart.
author: Elizabeth Foley
translation: 朋友间最美妙的经历，莫过于成长道路不同，却并不因此生出隔阂。

content: To accept ourselves as we are means to value our imperfections as much as our perfections.
author: Sandra Bierig
translation: 所谓接受自己，意味着既重视自己的完美，也珍视自己的不完美。

content: An animal's eyes have the power to speak a great language.
author: Martin Buber
translation: 动物的眼睛有一种神奇的力量，诉说着千言万语。

content: Let your joy be in your journey — not in some distant goal.
author: Tim Cook
translation: 让你的喜悦来自旅途中，而非一个遥远的目标。

content: A warm smile is the universal language of kindness.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 温暖的笑容是放之四海皆准的善意表达。

content: Travel and change of place impart new vigor to the mind.
author: Seneca
translation: 去新的地方旅行，能让思维焕发新的活力。

content: Do you want to meet the love of your life? Look in the mirror.
author: Byron Katie
translation: 想见见你的毕生所爱吗？看看镜中吧。

content: A poet is a man who puts up a ladder to a star and climbs it while playing a violin.
author: Edmond de Goncourt
translation: 诗人就是对着星空搭起天梯，然后边向上爬边拉小提琴的人。

content: Until you start believing in yourself, you ain't gonna have a life.
author: Rocky Balboa
translation: 直到你开始相信自己，你的人生才真正开始。

content: ㅤ
author: ㅤ
translation: ㅤ

content: Don't tell me the sky's the limit when there are footprints on the moon.
author: Paul Brandt
translation: 别对我说天空就是极限，毕竟连月球上都有了人类的脚印。

content: The best day of your life is the one on which you decide your life is your own.
author: Bob Moawad
translation: 你生命中最美好的一天，就是你决定让你的人生属于你自己的那一天。

content: You may forget with whom you laughed, but you will never forget with whom you wept.
author: Kahlil Gibran
translation: 你可能会忘记和你一同笑过的人，却会永远记得和你一同哭过的人。

content: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
author: George Addair
translation: 你想要的一切，都在恐惧的彼端。

content: Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do.
author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.
translation: 二十年后，比起你做过的事，你会更遗憾于那些你没有去做的事。

content: When life is sweet, say thank you and celebrate. And when life is bitter, say thank you and grow.
author: Shauna Niequist
translation: 日子愉快时，道声谢谢，庆贺吧；日子苦难时，道声谢谢，成长吧。

content: Speak your mind even if your voice shakes.
author: Maggie Kuhn
translation: 勇敢说出你的想法，哪怕声音会颤抖。

content: There is meaning in every journey that is unknown to the traveler.
author: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
translation: 每段旅程里都有不为旅行者所知的意义。

content: Rivers know this: there is no hurry. We shall get there some day.
author: A. A. Milne
translation: 河流知道这一点：无需匆忙。我们终有一日会到达。

content: Growth begins when we begin to accept our own weakness.
author: Jean Vanier
translation: 成长始于接受自己的弱点。

content: It is love that will heal you. It is what heals us all.
author: 《沉睡魔咒2》
translation: 爱会治愈你，会治愈我们所有人。

content: Education is not the filling of a pail, but the lighting of a fire.
author: William Butler Yeats
translation: 教育不是注满一桶水，而是点燃一把火。

content: Friendship is the breathing rose, with sweets in every fold.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
translation: 友谊是鲜活的玫瑰，每一道褶皱里都溢着甜香。

content: One never knows what each day is going to bring. The important thing is to be open and ready for it.
author: Henry Moore
translation: 谁也不知道每一天都会带来什么。重要的是要敞开心扉，做好准备。

content: One of the best things in life is seeing a smile on a person's face and knowing that you put it there.
author: Lisa Drakeford
translation: 人生最美妙的事情，莫过于看到他人脸上的笑容，是因你而起。

content: Live each day as if your life had just begun.
author: Johann Wolfgang Von Goethe
translation: 把每天，都当作生命刚开始一样去过吧！

content: Gardens are not made by sitting in the shade.
author: Rudyard Kipling
translation: 光在树荫下坐着，是建不成花园的。

content: Success is what comes after you stop making excuses.
author: Luis Galarza
translation: 当你不再找借口，成功才会到来。

content: Your relationship with yourself sets the tone for every other relationship you have.
author: Robert Holden
translation: 你和你自己的关系，会奠定你其他任何一段关系的基调。

content: Everyone shines, given the right lighting.
author: Susan Cain
translation: 在合适的光源下，每个人都会发光。

content: Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
author: Sean Patrick Flanery
translation: 你今天做的事要让未来的你心存感激。

content: It's not so much how busy you are, but why you are busy.
author: Mary Flannery O'Connor
translation: 重要的不是你有多忙，而是你为何而忙。

content: With self-discipline most anything is possible.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 只要严于自律，大部分事情都可能做成。

content: Life is a dream. Realize it.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 生活是一个梦想，实现它。

content: Build your own dreams, or someone else will hire you to build theirs.
author: Farrah Gray
translation: 筑造你自己的梦想吧，否则别人会雇你去建造他们的梦想。

content: A warm smile is the universal language of kindness.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 温暖的笑容是放之四海皆准的善意表达。

content: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy, not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
author: Dan Millman
translation: 改变的秘诀，是集中所有精力去建造新的东西，而非与过去抗衡。

content: It is not beauty that endears, it's love that makes us see beauty.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 并非美丽招人爱，而是爱让我们看到了美丽。

content: Pessimism leads to weakness, optimism to power.
author: William James
translation: 悲观导致软弱，乐观带来力量。

content: No winter lasts forever; no spring skips its turn.
author: Hal Borland
translation: 没有一个冬天不可逾越，没有一个春天不可来临。

content: Gratitude is not only the greatest of virtues, but the parent of all others.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
translation: 感恩不仅是最伟大的美德，而且是所有美德之母。

content: Once you make a decision, the universe conspires to make it happen.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 一旦你下定决心，整个宇宙都会来帮你实现它。

content: Problems are not stop signs; they are guidelines.
author: Robert Schuller
translation: 问题的出现不是让你止步，而是给你指路。

content: We are made wise not by the recollection of our past, but by the responsibility for our future.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 使我们明智的不是对过去的回忆，而是对未来的责任。

content: Make the best use of what is in your power, and take the rest as it happens.
author: Epictetus
translation: 尽全力做到最好，接受接下来会发生的。

content: We must be willing to get rid of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 我们必须放下规划好的人生，才能拥抱正在等待我们的生活。

content: Enjoy when you can, and endure when you must.
author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe
translation: 有福享受时，尽情享受；必须承受时，默默忍受。

content: While there's life, there is hope.
author: Stephen Hawking
translation: 生命不息，希望不止。

content: Be true to your word and your work and your friend.
author: John Boyle O'Reilly
translation: 对诺言要信守，对工作要尽责，对朋友要忠诚。

content: Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 成功往往会降临在那些忙得没空寻找它的人身上。

content: Keep your fears to yourself, but share your courage with others.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 把恐惧留在自己心里，把勇气给大家分享。

content: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
author: Gandhi
translation: 珍惜生活，就像死神即将来临；热爱学习，就像生命能够永恒。

content: Never stand begging for that which you have the power to earn.
author: Miguel de Cervantes
translation: 自己能挣到的，就别去乞求。

content: The only source of knowledge is experience.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 经验是知识的唯一来源。

content: To be mature means to face, and not evade, every fresh crisis that comes.
author: Fritz Kunkel
translation: 成熟意味着去面对任何来临的危机，而不是逃避。

content: He who controls others may be powerful, but he who has mastered himself is mightier still.
author: 老子
translation: 胜人者有力，自胜者强。

content: Never promise more than you can perform.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 不要许下你无法兑现的承诺。

content: Judge a man by his questions rather than his answers.
author: Voltaire
translation: 评判一个人的依据是他所提的问题，而非他给出的答案。

content: When everything seems to be going against you, remember that the airplane takes off against the wind, not with it.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 当一切于你皆不利时，请记住，飞机也是逆风起飞的。

content: Nothing happens until something moves.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 无为必将无获。

content: The wisest mind has something yet to learn.
author: George Santayana
translation: 就算最聪明的头脑也需要学习。

content: Things do not change. We change.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 万物并没有改变，变的是我们。

content: All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make the better.
author: Emerson
translation: 生活就是实验，实验的次数越多你就做得越好。

content: Life doesn't get easier or more forgiving; we get stronger and more resilient.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 生活从未变得更加轻松或宽容，是我们在一点一点变强、变坚韧。

content: You will never be able to escape from your heart. So it's better to listen to what it has to say.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 既然无法逃避自己的心，不如就好好地听听它在说些什么。

content: The best way out is always through.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 找到出口的最好方式就是一路走到底。

content: Ideas shape the course of history.
author: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯
translation: 想法影响着历史进程。

content: It's supposed to be hard. If it wasn't hard, everyone would do it.
author: 《红粉联盟》
translation: 要做成一件事情本来就不容易，要是不难，岂不是谁都会去做？

content: Give light and people will find the way.
author: Ella Baker
translation: 给予光亮，人们就能找到前方的路。

content: All your lights are red, but I'm green to go.
author: Troye Sivan
translation: 你哪怕示以红灯拒我前行，我也会心向绿灯一刻不停。

content: Do not linger to gather flowers to keep them, but walk on, for flowers will keep themselves blooming all your way.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 不要流连于采集花朵，只管向前走，一路上自会有百花盛开。

content: People grow through experience if they meet life honestly and courageously.
author: 埃莉诺·罗斯福
translation: 如果人诚实、勇敢地面对生活，就能从经历中获得成长。

content: I have crossed oceans of time to find you.
author: 《惊情四百年》
translation: 我跨越了时间的瀚海来把你寻找。

content: You can't sweep other people off their feet, if you can't be swept off your own.
author: Clarence Day
translation: 如果你自己都不欣赏自己，别人也不会为你倾倒。

content: Not having the best situation, but seeing the best in your situation is the key to happiness.
author: Marie Forleo
translation: 快乐的关键在于，即便境遇不是最佳，但依然能看到处境中最好的一面。

content: Never does nature say one thing and wisdom another.
author: Juvenal
translation: 自然与智慧永不相悖。

content: Why are you trying so hard to fit in when you are born to stand out？
author: 《水瓶座女孩》
translation: 你本就生而不凡，为何还要拼命去融入大众呢？

content: Do you know that there's still a chance for you？Cause there's a spark in you.
author: Katy Perry, "Firework"
translation: 你知道吗？你还有机会，因为你心中藏有火花。

content: It is by acts and not by ideas that people live.
author: Anatole France
translation: 人依靠行动而活，而非想法。

content: Even the darkest night will end, and the sun will rise.
author: 《悲惨世界》
translation: 即使再黑暗的夜也会走到尽头，旭日终将升起。

content: Feel the fear and do it anyway.
author: Susan Jeffers
translation: 感受恐惧，放胆去做。

content: Remember there's no such thing as a small act of kindness. Every act creates a ripple with no logical end.
author: Scott Adams
translation: 记住没有小善之举这回事，每一次善行都会激起无穷尽的连锁反应。

content: Life moves pretty fast. If you don't stop and look around once in a while, you could miss it.
author: 《春天不是读书天》
translation: 人生匆匆，如果不时常停下脚步四处瞧瞧，你可能就会错过它。

content: You don't have to bend until you break. You just have to get up.
author: Colbie Caillat, "Try"
translation: 你不必一味屈服，让自己受伤，你只需打起精神做自己。

content: We live in the world when we love it.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 我们只有热爱这个世界，才算真正地活着。

content: Catch the moments of your life. Catch them while you're young and quick.
author: 《我们这一天》
translation: 趁你还年轻利落，把握住生命中的每一个瞬间吧。

content: Only one thing can make a soul complete, and that thing is love.
author: 《朗读者》
translation: 只有一样东西可以让灵魂完整，那就是爱。

content: In any given moment we have two options: to step forward into growth or to step back into safety.
author: Abraham Maslow
translation: 任何时刻我们都有两个选择：往前走向成长，或退后走向安全。

content: Life is a collection of moments. The idea is to have as many good ones as you can.
author: 《爱情限时恋未尽》
translation: 生命由一个个瞬间组成，宗旨就是尽可能多地拥抱美好瞬间。

content: Don't let other people get in the way of what you really want.
author: 《伦敦生活》
translation: 不要让别人妨碍你追求你真正想要的。

content: It's been my experience that you can nearly always enjoy something if you make up your mind firmly that you will.
author: 《小小安妮》
translation: 我的经验是，事情只要下定决心去享受，就基本都能享受。

content: When I am with you, there's no place I'd rather be.
author: Clean Bandit, "Rather Be"
translation: 只要有你相伴，便无他处可比拟。

content: May your past be the sound of your feet upon the ground. Carry on.
author: Fun., "Carry On"
translation: 愿你的过去只是你前进步伐所踏出的声响，继续前行吧。

content: If you believe in yourself enough and know what you want, you're gonna make it happen.
author: Mariah Carey, "Make It Happen"
translation: 如果你足够自信，也知道自己想要什么，就一定会实现心中所想。

content: When you finally go back to your old hometown, you find it wasn't the old home you missed but your childhood.
author: Sam Ewing
translation: 当你终于重归故里，你会发现自己思念的，不是故乡，而是童年。

content: Sometimes a problem is just an opportunity in disguise.
author: 《蛇蝎女佣》
translation: 有时候问题不过是伪装起来的机会。

content: Life is short; the world is wide, and I want to make some memories.
author: 《妈妈咪呀2》
translation: 生命短暂，世界广阔，我想制造些回忆。

content: Whatever happens tomorrow, we've had today.
author: 《一天》
translation: 不管明天会发生什么，至少我们拥有今天。

content: How are you to imagine anything if the images are always provided for you?
author: 《超脱》
translation: 如果你能想到的东西都在眼前，你的思维又如何插上想象的翅膀呢？

content: It's strange. I felt less lonely when I didn't know you.
author: Jean-Paul Sartre
translation: 真是奇怪。在认识你之前，我没有感到过如此孤单。

content: Selfishness is not living as one wishes to live. It is asking others to live as one wishes to live.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 过自己想要的生活不是自私，要求别人按自己的意愿生活才是。

content: If you don't go after what you want, you'll never have it.
author: Nora Roberts
translation: 不去追逐你所渴求的，你就永远也无法拥有它。

content: Where we love is home, home that our feet may leave, but not our hearts.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
translation: 家，是爱之所在。也许我们脚步渐远，但心从未离开。

content: It is not the destination so much as the journey, they say.
author: 《加勒比海盗4：惊涛怪浪》
translation: 人们说，旅行的目的地不如旅程来得重要。

content: Far and away the best prize that life has to offer is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 毋庸置疑，生活赋予的最好礼物就是有机会努力去做值得做的事情。

content: Good teachers, they inspire you, they entertain you, and you end up learning a ton even when you don't know it.
author: Nicholas Sparks
translation: 好的老师会激励你，给你带来欢乐，悄然无声地教会你很多东西。

content: Keep your head up in failure, and your head down in success.
author: Jerry Seinfeld
translation: 失败时，要高昂起头；成功时，要保持谦逊。

content: Praising what is lost makes the remembrance dear.
author: William Shakespeare
translation: 赞美已经失去的事物，让回忆变得惹人喜爱。

content: I think togetherness is a very important ingredient to family life.
author: Barbara Bush
translation: 在我看来，团聚于家庭生活而言不可或缺。

content: Water can carve its way even through stone and when trapped, water makes a new path.
author: 《艺伎回忆录》
translation: 水滴能穿石，即便困于一隅，也能另辟蹊径。

content: You can tell a lot about a person by what's on their playlist.
author: 《再次出发之纽约遇见你》
translation: 通过一个人的播放列表，你可以了解到很多关于他的东西。

content: Our growth depends not on how many experiences we devour, but on how many we digest.
author: Ralph W. Sockman
translation: 成长靠的不是经历有多丰富，而是对过往经历的细细品味和领会。

content: Whatever is worth doing at all is worth doing well.
author: Philip Stanhope
translation: 任何值得做的事，都值得将其做好。

content: A positive attitude will have positive results because attitudes are contagious.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 积极的态度会带来积极的结果，因为态度是具有感染力的。

content: Silence is the sleep that nourishes wisdom.
author: Francis Bacon
translation: 沉默，好比睡眠，会滋养出智慧。

content: I wouldn't give up being myself for even one second.
author: 《摩登家庭》
translation: 我不会放弃做自己，哪怕一秒也不行。

content: Neither abstinence nor excess ever renders man happy.
author: 伏尔泰
translation: 不论是节制还是过度都不能给人带来快乐。

content: If we're kind and polite, the world will be right.
author: 《帕丁顿熊2》
translation: 如果我们温和善良、彬彬有礼的话，世界将会变美好。

content: The only real failure is the failure to try and the measure of success is how we cope with disappointment.
author: 《涉外大饭店》
translation: 唯一真正的失败是放弃尝试；衡量成功的标准是我们如何面对失望。

content: The time spent with you allowed me to feel again.
author: 《大洋之间的灯光》
translation: 与你共度的时光，让我重新苏醒。

content: If you want the best the world has to offer, offer the world your best.
author: Neale Donald Walsch
translation: 若想得到世界上最好的东西，先向世界展现最好的你。

content: I like to feel his eyes on me when I look away.
author: 《爱在黎明破晓前》
translation: 我喜欢当我看向别处时他的目光停留在我身上的感觉。

content: You never know how far you can go unless you run.
author: 《一代骄马》
translation: 你如果不跑起来，就永远不知道自己能走多远。

content: A clear vision, backed by definite plans, gives you a tremendous feeling of confidence and personal power.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 一个清晰的愿景，加以明确计划的支持，会给你极大的信心和个人力量。

content: They say when you meet the love of your life, time stops, and that's true.
author: 《大鱼》
translation: 人们说当你遇上你的挚爱，时间会停止，事实的确如此。

content: Everybody's got a job to do, and I do mine as best I can.
author: 玛丽·马特林
translation: 每个人都有自己的事情要做，我会竭尽全力把属于自己的做好。

content: Even if you're on the right track, you'll get run over if you just sit there.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 即便你刚好处于正轨，如果你只坐在那里的话，还是会被撞翻。

content: Either you run the day or the day runs you.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 要么你主宰生活，要么让生活主宰你。

content: It's good to set limits for oneself, but there comes a moment when we must destroy what we have constructed.
author: Josef Koudelka
translation: 为自己设限是不错，不过有时候我们必须打破自己一手建立的一切。

content: The morning, which is the most memorable season of the day, is the awakening hour.
author: 梭罗
translation: 在一天之中，清晨最值得怀恋和纪念，这是一段让万物醒悟的光阴。

content: Happiness lies in the joy of achievement and the thrill of creative effort.
author: 福兰克林·罗斯福
translation: 幸福来源于收获时的欢乐和创作时的激动。

content: Without deviation from the norm, progress is not possible.
author: Frank Zappa
translation: 不偏离常规，就无法取得进步。

content: Life is a sum of all your choices. So, what are you doing today?
author: Albert Camus
translation: 生活就是你所有选择的总和，那么，你今天要做什么？

content: Art doesn't have to do anything. It just has to be there for the fierce pleasure we take in doing it.
author: Raymond Carver
translation: 艺术不需要做什么。在我们从事艺术时，能让人感受到强烈的愉悦就够了。

content: Real generosity toward the future lies in giving all to the present.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 将一切奉献给当下，就是对未来的真正慷慨。

content: I am prepared for the worst, but hope for the best.
author: 班杰明‧迪斯雷利
translation: 我已做好最坏的打算，但仍期待最好的结果。

content: I believe every human has a finite number of heartbeats. I don't intend to waste any of mine.
author: 尼尔·阿姆斯特朗
translation: 我相信每个人的心跳次数有限，所以我不想浪费任何一下。

content: Most of us have far more courage than we ever dreamed we possessed.
author: 戴尔·卡内基
translation: 我们大部分人所拥有的勇气比我们梦想得到的要多得多。

content: Success is nothing more than a few simple disciplines, practiced every day.
author: 吉姆·罗恩
translation: 成功不外乎是每天对一些基本技能的操练。

content: No matter how many goals you have achieved, you must set your sights on a higher one.
author: 杰西卡·萨维奇
translation: 不管你实现了多少目标，总要定睛于下一个更远大的。

content: When there is a strong woman character in a story — that always grabs me.
author: 李安
translation: 有坚强的女性角色的故事总能抓住我的心。

content: Either move or be moved.
author: 艾泽拉·庞德
translation: 要么主动寻求改变，要么被动接受改变。

content: Do more of what makes you happy.
author: Carmel McConnell
translation: 多做些让你快乐的事。

content: When love and skill work together, expect a masterpiece.
author: 约翰·拉斯金
translation: 当热爱与技巧融为一体，就能孕育出杰作。

content: When we have become completely free of the need to judge, we will also become completely free of the fear of being judged.
author: Henri Nouwen
translation: 当我们无需评断别人时，就根本不用怕被别人评断了。

content: The more things you do, the more you can do.
author: 露西尔·鲍尔
translation: 你做的事情越多，能做到的事情就越多。

content: They invented hugs to let people know you love them without saying anything.
author: Bil Keane
translation: 拥抱，是让你一句话也不用说，就让别人知道你爱他们。

content: The best cure for the body is a quiet mind.
author: 拿破仑
translation: 对身体最好的治疗就是让头脑安静。

content: One way to keep momentum going is to have constantly greater goals.
author: 迈克尔·考达
translation: 保持前进动力的方法就是，一直拥有更远大的目标。

content: Do something today that your future self will thank you for.
author: Sean Patrick Flanery
translation: 你今天做的事要让未来的你心存感激。

content: Be strong and free from fear.
author: 莱拉·姬芙蒂·阿奇塔
translation: 要坚强，毫不惧怕。

content: There is no substitute for hard work. First in, last out.
author: Mary Callahan Erdoes
translation: 没有什么能替代努力，要最先开始，最后离开。

content: Curiosity is the lust of the mind.
author: Thomas Hobbes
translation: 好奇心是大脑的渴望。

content: Don't be afraid of your fears. They're there to let you know that something is worth it.
author: C. JoyBell C.
translation: 别害怕自己的恐惧，它让你知道有些事情值得去做。

content: A random act of kindness, no matter how small, can make a tremendous impact on someone else's life.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 你的一次无心的善举，不论多么微不足道，都可能对他人的生活产生巨大影响。

content: I hope life isn't a big joke, because I don't get it.
author: Jack Handey
translation: 希望生活不是个大笑话，因为我没抓住笑点。

content: Respect other people's feelings. It might mean nothing to you, but it could mean everything to them.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 尊重他人的感受。这对你可能无关紧要，但对他人可能就十分重要。

content: You are stronger than your challenges and your challenges are making you stronger.
author: Karen Salmansohn
translation: 你比你面对的挑战更强大，而这些挑战让你变得更加坚强。

content: What is a friend? A single soul dwelling in two bodies.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 何谓朋友？一个灵魂孕育在两个躯体里。

content: Be brave. Take risks. Nothing can substitute experience.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 要敢于冒险，你的经历是无可替代的。

content: Summertime is always the best of what might be.
author: Charles Bowden
translation: 万物最美一面，总在夏季展现。

content: Where words fail, music speaks.
author: 安徒生
translation: 言语无法表达时，音乐就会响起。

content: We are who we choose to be.
author: Barry Manilow
translation: 要成为怎样的人，选择在于你自己。

content: Beautiful things don't ask for attention.
author: 《白日梦想家》
translation: 真正美丽的东西， 并不会刻意寻求别人的注目。

content: Change in all things is sweet.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 有改变就会有美好。

content: You cannot change the circumstances but you can change yourself.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 既然改变不了环境，那就改变自己。

content: Curiosity is the wick in the candle of learning.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 如果学习是一根蜡烛，那好奇心就是烛芯。

content: Real love is always worth waiting for.
author: 《西部世界》
translation: 真爱永远值得等待。

content: Empty your cup so that it may be filled.
author: 李小龙
translation: 清空杯子，方能再装满。

content: I don't know anything with certainty, but seeing the stars makes me dream.
author: 《至爱梵高·星空之谜》
translation: 我不知道世间有什么事是确定不变的，但只要一看到星星，我就会开始做梦。

content: And if you really want to see what people are, all you have to do is look.
author: 《奇迹男孩》
translation: 想真正了解他人，只需要用心去看。

content: Pleasure in the job puts perfection in the work.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 乐于工作才有完美表现。

content: Life has no limitations, except the ones you make.
author: Les Brown
translation: 生命无限，除非你自我设限。

content: Soon is not as good as now.
author: Seth Godin
translation: 别谈未来，现在就行动。

content: Make each day your masterpiece.
author: John Wooden
translation: 让你生命中的每一天都成为杰作。

content: Happiness is an inside job.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 向内寻找，才能找到幸福。

content: Winning isn't everything, but wanting it is.
author: Arnold Palmer
translation: 胜利并不能代表一切，而求胜心可以。

content: It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 越是在艰难的时候就越要守住光明。

content: People love what other people are passionate about.
author: 《爱乐之城》
translation: 人总是会爱上别人倾注热情的事物。

content: Don't let the mistakes and disappointments of the past control and direct your future.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 不要让未来的你被过去的错误与失望所掌控。

content: Don't be pushed by your problems. Be led by your dreams.
author: 爱默生
translation: 别为困难所迫，要以梦想为引。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: A winner never stops trying.
author: Tom Landry
translation: 胜者永不停止尝试。

content: The most difficult thing is the decision to act; the rest is merely tenacity.
author: Amelia Earhart
translation: 最困难的是下定决心去做，剩下的只是坚持而已。

content: Life is not only merriment. It is desire and determination.
author: 纪伯伦
translation: 生活并不只有欢声笑语，还得要有抱负和决心。

content: What you seek is seeking you.
author: Rumi
translation: 你正在寻找的东西也在找寻你。

content: It is the power of thought that gives man power over nature.
author: 安徒生
translation: 人类之所以能够驾驭自然，是因为思想的力量。

content: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
author: Seneca
translation: 并不是因为事情难我们才不敢去做，而是因为我们不敢做事情才难。

content: There is nothing so useless as doing efficiently that which should not be done at all.
author: Peter Drucker
translation: 最没用的，莫过于有效地做那些根本没必要做的事。

content: Don't allow your rituals to become ruts.
author: Todd Henry
translation: 切忌墨守成规。

content: If you can imagine it, you can achieve it. If you can dream it, you can become it.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 凡是能想象到的，就能被实现，能够成为梦想的，就能够成真。

content: Turn the page, maybe we'll find a brand new ending.
author: Adam Levine, "Lost Stars"
translation: 翻过陈旧的昨天，或许会迎来完全不一样的结局。

content: It's your life; you don't need someone's permission to live the life you want.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 生活是你自己的，想过什么样的生活，不需要别人的许可。

content: Those are my principles, and if you don't like them… well, I have others.
author: Groucho Marx
translation: 那是我的原则，要是你不喜欢……那我还有其他原则。

content: Life is about making an impact, not making an income.
author: Kevin Kruse
translation: 生命在于影响他人，而非赚钱糊口。

content: Humanity is won by continuing to play in face of certain defeat.
author: Ralph Ellison
translation: 就算可能失败，也要继续前行，可谓是真正的人。

content: When someone loves you, the way they talk about you is different. You feel safe and comfortable.
author: Jess C. Scott
translation: 爱你的人谈起你的方式是不一样的，你会觉得安全又舒服。

content: Every day women and men become legends.
author: Common, "Glory"
translation: 每天都有人书写不朽的传奇诗篇。

content: A lantern can give you light only when you light it.
author: Munia Khan
translation: 灯笼若要闪亮，需要你去点亮。

content: It's not what you say out of your mouth that determines your life; it's what you whisper to yourself that has the most power!
author: Robert T. Kiyosaki
translation: 你嘴上说什么决定不了你的生活，起决定作用的是你在心里告诉自己什么！

content: Unable to perceive the shape of you, I find you all around me. Your presence fills my eyes with your love.
author: 《水形物语》
translation: 无法感知你的形状，但我能感到你就在我的四周。在我眼里，你的存在就是爱。

content: Go after what you really love and find a way to make that work for you, and then you'll be a happy person.
author: Tom Petty
translation: 追求你真正热爱的，并能充分利用，你就是幸福的。

content: You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.
author: Beverly Sills
translation: 失败可能会让你失望，但若不去尝试，就必定会失败。

content: Who can say where the road goes? Where the day flows? Only time.
author: Enya, "Only Time"
translation: 谁能说得清道路向何方漫延，岁月向何方流逝？唯有时光。

content: Love is when the other person's happiness is more important than your own.
author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.
translation: 情是君喜胜于己欢。

content: You cannot let your father's actions define your life. You get to decide what kind of king you want to be.
author: 《黑豹》
translation: 你的生活不是追随父亲的脚步，而是要做自己的国王。

content: Our lives are defined by opportunities, even the ones we miss.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
translation: 我们的生命取决于机遇，包括那些错过的机遇。

content: You've got to try first before you say it's impossible.
author: 《半泽直树》
translation: 在说不可能之前，你得先试一试。

content: Change your life today. Don't gamble on the future, act now, without delay.
author: Simone de Beauvoir
translation: 从今天起，改变生活；立即行动，拒绝拖延，别把希望押在未来。

content: Success is connecting with the world and making people feel.
author: 《名扬四海》
translation: 成功就是与世界为伴，并感染周围的人。

content: Keep integrity at every cost.
author: Nas, "Bridging The Gap"
translation: 要正直，不惜一切代价。

content: There are no great limits to growth because there are no limits of human intelligence, imagination, and wonder.
author: Ronald Reagan
translation: 成长的路途，没有尽头，因为我们拥有无限的智慧、想象力和好奇心。

content: Through love comes calm, and through calm comes thought.
author: 《三块广告牌》
translation: 爱使人内心宁静，而后才会有思考。

content: And if there's love in this life, there's no obstacle. That can't be defeated.
author: Avicii, "Waiting For Love"
translation: 如果生活充满爱，世界将不再有阻碍，爱可以战胜一切。

content: Fortune sides with him who dares.
author: Virgil
translation: 好运垂青有胆识的人。

content: The only reward of virtue is virtue; the only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 对美德的回报是美德，获得友谊的唯一途径是给人以友谊。

content: I'm sure we'll meet in the spring. And catch up on everything.
author: Troye Sivan, "The Good Side"
translation: 我们一定会在春天相见，好好聊个天。

content: Never let the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game.
author: Babe Ruth
translation: 永远不要因为害怕被淘汰而不去争取。

content: The truth is, I'm in love and there's nothing I can do about it.
author: 《真爱至上》
translation: 事实是，爱情来的时候，挡也挡不住。

content: Make improvements, not excuses. Seek respect, not attention.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 要追求进步，而不是一味地寻找借口，要寻求尊重，而不是一味地博取关注。

content: The goal isn't to live forever; the goal is to create something that will.
author: Chuck Palahniuk
translation: 人生的目标不是要获得永生，而是要创造永恒。

content: The noblest art is that of making others happy.
author: 《马戏之王》
translation: 最高贵的艺术是使人快乐的艺术。

content: We are what we repeatedly do; excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.
author: Aristotle
translation: 每天反复做的事情造就了我们，然后你会发现，优秀不是一种行为，而是一种习惯。

content: You can't cross the sea merely by standing and staring at the water.
author: 泰戈尔
translation: 光站在那里盯着海面，是没法穿越海洋的。

content: All human wisdom is summed up in these two words: wait and hope.
author: Alexandre Dumas
translation: 人类所有的智慧可以归结为两个词：等待和希望。

content: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you've imagined.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 自信地往梦想的方向前进吧；去过你所设想的生活。

content: Lose an hour in the morning, and you will spend all day looking for it.
author: Richard Whately
translation: 早上浪费一小时，得用一天的时间来弥补。

content: Putting off an easy thing makes it hard, and putting off a hard one makes it impossible.
author: George Horace Lorimer
translation: 简单的事，越拖越难，困难的事，越拖越不可能做。

content: Kindness is always fashionable, and always welcome.
author: Amelia Barr
translation: 善良，永不过时，也永远为人所喜闻乐见。

content: Happiness is not a station you arrive at, but a manner of traveling.
author: Margaret Lee Runbeck
translation: 幸福并不是你所抵达的站点，而是一种旅行的方式。

content: He who would travel happily must travel light.
author: 安托万·德·圣埃克苏佩里
translation: 想要快乐旅行的人必须轻装上阵。

content: When a thing is done, it's done. Don't look back. Look forward to your next objective.
author: George C. Marshall
translation: 事情做完了就是做完了。别回头，继续去寻找下一个目标吧！

content: In order to be irreplaceable one must always be different.
author: 可可·香奈儿
translation: 要想变得无可替代，就必须与众不同。

content: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams! Live the life you've imagined.
author: 亨利·戴维·梭罗
translation: 自信地朝你的梦想前进吧！去过你想要过的生活。

content: When something is important enough, you do it even if the odds are not in your favor.
author: 伊隆·马斯克
translation: 当一件事情足够重要时，即便缺乏胜算，你也会去做。

content: Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens.
author: Jimi Hendrix
translation: 知识会说话，但智慧是会倾听。

content: One doesn't discover new lands without consenting to lose sight of the shore for a very long time.
author: 安德烈·纪德
translation: 不愿在看不见海岸线的情况下久久漂流，是不会发现新大陆的。

content: Luck is what you have left over after you give 100 percent.
author: Langston Coleman
translation: 幸运，就是你付出百分之百后剩下的东西。

content: The trees that are slow to grow bear the best fruit.
author: 莫里哀
translation: 长得很慢的树，能结出最好的果子。

content: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
author: Seneca
translation: 困难能磨练心志，正如劳动能强壮体魄。

content: Kites rise highest against the wind, not with it.
author: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
translation: 风筝逆风才能高飞——而不是顺风。

content: There is an applause superior to that of the multitudes: one's own.
author: Elizabeth Elton Smith
translation: 有一种掌声，比大众的掌声更优裕：那就是你自己给自己鼓的掌。

content: Change the way you look at things and the things you look at change.
author: Wayne W. Dyer
translation: 改变你看待事物的方式，你所看到的事物也会改变。

content: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 相信自己能成功，你就已经成功了一半。

content: A clear vision, backed by definite plans, gives you a tremendous feeling of confidence and personal power.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 一个清晰的愿景，加以明确计划的支持，会给你极大的信心和个人力量。

content: When you finally go back to your old hometown, you find it wasn't the old home you missed but your childhood.
author: Sam Ewing
translation: 当你终于重归故里，你会发现自己思念的，不是故乡，而是童年。

content: Goodness is the only investment that never fails.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 善良是唯一不会失败的投资。

content: If you want the best the world has to offer, offer the world your best.
author: Neale Donald Walsch
translation: 若想得到世界上最好的东西，先向世界展现最好的你。

content: Neither abstinence nor excess ever renders man happy.
author: 伏尔泰
translation: 不论是节制还是过度都不能给人带来快乐。

content: A positive attitude will have positive results because attitudes are contagious.
author: Zig Ziglar
translation: 积极的态度会带来积极的结果，因为态度是具有感染力的。

content: Whatever is worth doing at all is worth doing well.
author: Philip Stanhope
translation: 任何值得做的事，都值得将其做好。

content: The more we do, the more we can do.
author: William Hazlitt
translation: 我们做的越多，能做的也就越多。

content: I'm not telling you it is going to be easy, I'm telling you it's going to be worth it.
author: Art Williams
translation: 我不会告诉你这个过程很容易。我只会说，这一切都是值得的。

content: Keep a little fire burning; however small, however hidden.
author: Cormac McCarthy
translation: 让心中的火苗一直燃烧吧，不管那有多微弱，不管藏得有多深。

content: Nothing you wear is more important than your smile.
author: Connie Stevens
translation: 不管如何穿戴，都不比带上你的微笑。

content: An aim in life is the only fortune worth finding.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 生活的目标，是唯一值得我们去寻找的财富。

content: Promise yourself to be so strong that nothing can disturb your peace of mind.
author: Christian D. Larson
translation: 对自己承诺：要强大到任何事情都无法破坏你内心的平和。 ​​​​

content: We are the hero of our own story.
author: Mary McCarthy
translation: 我们都是我们自己故事里的英雄。

content: I'll let you be in my dreams if I can be in yours.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 如果我能进入你的梦乡，我也会把你拥入我的梦里。

content: Money is better than poverty, if only for financial reasons.
author: Woody Allen
translation: 钱比贫穷更好，如果仅仅因为经济原因的话。

content: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth.
author: Sir Arthur Conan Doyle
translation: 当你排除掉了所有的不可能，剩下的无论多么说不通，它都一定是真相。

content: Be careful about reading health books. You may die of a misprint.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 读健康类书籍可得小心！你可能会因为一点印刷错误丢了性命。

content: Never explain — your friends do not need it and your enemies will not believe you anyway.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 不用解释——你的朋友不需要，而你的敌人如何也不相信。

content: A good novel tells us the truth about its hero; but a bad novel tells us the truth about its author.
author: G. K. Chesterton
translation: 一本好的小说告诉我们关于主角的种种真相；而一本糟糕的小说告诉我们关于作家自己的种种真相。

content: Everyone is necessarily the hero of his own life story.
author: John Barth
translation: 每个人都必定是自己人生故事中的主角。

content: Famous remarks are very seldom quoted correctly.
author: Simeon Strunsky
translation: 名言很少能被正确引用。

content: Food is the most primitive form of comfort.
author: Sheila Graham
translation: 食物是最原始的安慰人心的东西。

content: Well-timed silence has more eloquence than speech.
author: Martin Fraquhar Tupper
translation: 时机恰当的沉默比话语更有说服力。

content: The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 生命中最重要的两天，是你出生的那一天，和你弄清楚为何而生的那一天。

content: Fashion is a form of ugliness so intolerable that we have to alter it every six months.
author: Oscar Wilde
translation: 时尚是一种无法容忍的丑陋，以至于我们每六个月就得改变它一次。

content: Never eat more than you can lift.
author: Miss Piggy
translation: 吃的永远不要比能拿的多。

content: Nothing is impossible. Some things are just less likely than others.
author: Jonathan Winters
translation: 没有什么是不可能的，只是有些事可能性比其他的小一点而已。

content: Self-confidence is the first requisite to great undertakings.
author: Samuel Johnson
translation: 自信是成大事的首要条件。

content: Education's purpose is to replace an empty mind with an open one.
author: Malcolm Forbes
translation: 教育的目的是使空洞的大脑变得开放宽广。

content: Life wouldn't be worth living if I worried over the future as well as the present.
author: W. Somerset Maugham
translation: 如果我既担忧未来又担忧现在，那么这样的生活不值得我去过。

content: I often quote myself. It adds spice to my conversation.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 我常常引用自己的话，它可以为我的谈话增添点色彩。

content: Every day, in every way, I am getting better and better.
author: Émile Coué
translation: 每一天，我都在以各种方式变得越来越好。

content: Simplicity is the peak of civilization.
author: Jessie Sampter
translation: 极简是文明的极致。

content: Only the mediocre are always at their best.
author: Jean Giraudoux
translation: 只有平庸的人才会永远在他们最好的状态。

content: It is not necessary to understand things in order to argue about them.
author: Pierre Beaumarchais
translation: 没有必要为了争论事物而去理解事物。

content: Parents were invented to make children happy by giving them something to ignore.
author: Ogden Nash
translation: 父母的存在，是有意让孩子忽略一些事情，从而让他们感到欢乐。

content: One machine can do the work of fifty ordinary men. No machine can do the work of one extraordinary man.
author: Elbert Hubbard
translation: 一台机器能干五十个普通人的活，但一个杰出的人的工作没有机器可以做。

content: The world is full of willing people, some willing to work, the rest willing to let them.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 这个世界充满了乐于做事的人。一些人乐意工作，其余的人乐意让他们工作。

content: While we try to teach our children all about life, our children teach us what life is all about.
author: Angela Schwindt
translation: 当我们教会孩子生活的一切时，孩子却教会我们什么是生活的真谛。

content: Only two things are infinite, the universe and human stupidity, and I'm not sure about the former.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 世上只有两种东西是无限的：宇宙以及人类的愚蠢。而对于前者，我还不太确定。

content: You can't build a reputation on what you are going to do.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 你是无法靠你打算去做的事情树立名声的。

content: You must first have a lot of patience to learn to have patience.
author: Stanislaw J. Lec
translation: 你首先得耐下心，才能学会有耐心。

content: If a thing isn't worth saying, you sing it.
author: Pierre Beaumarchais
translation: 如果一件事不值得说出来，你就把它唱出来吧。

content: Everyone is born with genius, but most people only keep it a few minutes.
author: Edgard Varese
translation: 每个人生来都是天才，但大多数人只把天资保留了几分钟。

content: Money is like a sixth sense without which you cannot make a complete use of the other five.
author: W. Somerset Maugham
translation: 金钱就像人的第六感，没有它你就无法完整地使用其他五感。

content: There cannot be a crisis next week. My schedule is already full.
author: Henry Kissinger
translation: 下周不可能有危机，我的日程早就排满了。

content: A problem is a chance for you to do your best.
author: Duke Ellington
translation: 问题也是机会，你得以把事情做到最好。

content: Drama is life with the dull bits cut out.
author: Alfred Hitchcock
translation: 戏剧就是去掉了无聊片段的生活。

content: Life is a long lesson in humility.
author: James M. Barrie
translation: 人生是一门漫长的学习谦卑的课。

content: The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
author: Alan Kay
translation: 预知未来的最好方式是创造未来。

content: Even if you're on the right track, you'll get run over if you just sit there.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 即使你处在正轨上，但如果你只是坐在原地，也会被别人碾过去。

content: Never judge a book by its movie.
author: J. W. Eagan
translation: 永远不要通过由书改编的电影来评判这本书。

content: Education is a progressive discovery of our own ignorance.
author: Will Durant
translation: 教育是一个逐步发现自己无知的过程。

content: It's kind of fun to do the impossible.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 做不可能的事还挺有趣的。

content: Man invented language to satisfy his deep need to complain.
author: Lily Tomlin
translation: 人类发明语言是为了满足他们内心深处对抱怨的需求。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
author: George Bernard Shaw
translation: 生命的意义不在于发现你自己，而在于创造你自己。

content: We are young. So let's set the world on fire. We can burn brighter than the sun.
author: Fun., "We Are Young"
translation: 我们是青年，让我们点亮世界，释放生命，胜过太阳。

content: If there's one thing to be taught, it's dreams are made to be caught.
author: Gavin Degraw, "Fire"
translation: 唯有一事值得谨记，有梦想就要奋力追逐。

content: We're losing all this daylight but soon the moon's gonna rise.
author: Young Rising Sons, “Turnin'”
translation: 虽然白日将尽，但有一轮新月正冉冉高升。

content: The whole secret of a successful life is to find out what is one's destiny to do, and then do it.
author: Henry Ford
translation: 拥有成功的人生，秘诀在于发现自己此生该做什么，然后付诸行动。

content: I took my bruises, took my lumps. Fell down and I got right back up.
author: Eminem, "Beautiful"
translation: 身上带着淤青和肿块，摔倒了也立刻爬起来。

content: In any case you mustn't confuse a single failure with a final defeat.
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald, "Tender Is the Night"
translation: 永远不要把一次失败与最终失败混为一谈。

content: Reading gives us someplace to go when we have to stay where we are.
author: Mason Cooley
translation: 当我们困在原地时，阅读可以带我们去遨游。

content: Do not go where the path may lead; go instead where there is no path and leave a trail.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 别沿着别人的路走，要去开辟自己的路，留下自己的足迹。

content: A life spent making mistakes is not only more honorable, but more useful than a life spent doing nothing.
author: 萧伯纳
translation: 比起无所事事，会犯错的人生不仅更光荣，也更有意义。

content: You're not obligated to win. You're obligated to keep trying.
author: Jason Mraz
translation: 你不一定要获胜，但你必须不断尝试。

content: Intelligence is the ability to adapt to change.
author: 斯蒂芬·霍金
translation: 智慧就是适应变化的能力。

content: It isn't where you came from. It's where you're going that counts.
author: Ella Fitzgerald
translation: 起点并不重要，重要的是，你要去往何方。

content: Forgiveness is the fragrance that the violet sheds on the heel that has crushed it.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 你一脚踩在紫罗兰上，它却把香味留在了你的脚上，这便是宽恕。

content: Motivation comes from working on things we care about.
author: Sheryl Sandberg
translation: 为在意的事付出努力，动力随之而来。

content: You should love and take care of yourself because after all, it's your own life.
author: 《恋恋笔记本》
translation: 要学会爱自己，照顾自己，毕竟生活是你自己的。

content: You must do the things you think you cannot do.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 务必要去尝试你认为不可能的事。

content: Give every day the chance to become the most beautiful day of your life.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 把每天都过成你生命中最美好的一天。

content: The best way to find out if you can trust somebody is to trust them.
author: 海明威
translation: 确认一个人是否可信，最好的办法就是信任他们。

content: Be determined. Instead of intending to just try, do it.
author: 《星球大战》
translation: 要坚定，凡事要抱着拼一把而非试一下的心态。

content: You do not find the happy life. You make it.
author: Camilla Eyring Kimball
translation: 幸福不是刻意的寻找，而是用心的经营。

content: Wrinkles should merely indicate where smiles have been.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 皱纹只是微笑留下的痕迹。

content: Each time you happen to me all over again.
author: The Age of Innocence
translation: 你的每次出现，都在我脑海里浮现千遍。

content: Believe in every dream that you got, you only living once.
author: Nickelback
translation: 你只活一次，要相信属于自己的每一个梦想。

content: You only get one shot; do not miss your chance to blow.
author: Eminem, "Lose Yourself"
translation: 机会只有一次，不要错过。

content: Don't criticize what you can't understand.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 不懂的，不要随意批判。

content: Learn to let go and be clear of where you really want to head for.
author: "Kissing a Fool"
translation: 学会放手，同时也要弄清楚自己的真正所爱。

content: The human race has one really effective weapon, and that is laughter.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 欢笑是人类强而有力的武器。

content: It is your determination and persistence that will make you a successful person.
author: Kenneth J Hutchins
translation: 让你成功的，是决心，以及毅力。

content: Patience is the companion of wisdom.
author: Saint Augustine
translation: 耐心总是与智慧相伴。

content: You have every right to a beautiful life.
author: Selena Gomez
translation: 你值得拥有属于你的美丽人生。

content: There is no friend as loyal as a book.
author: 海明威
translation: 好书如挚友，情谊永不渝。

content: They can because they think they can.
author: Virgil
translation: 他们可以，是因为他们相信自己可以。

content: I have found that if you love life, life will love you back.
author: Arthur Rubinstein
translation: 我发现，如果你爱生活，生活也会用爱来回报你。

content: Forgiveness does not change the past, but it does enlarge the future.
author: Paul Boese
translation: 宽恕无法改变过去，却能拓宽未来。

content: We have to do the best we are capable of. This is our sacred human responsibility.
author: 阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦
translation: 我们必须尽力而为，这是我们生而为人的神圣责任。

content: The worst loneliness is not to be comfortable with yourself.
author: 马克·吐温
translation: 最糟糕的孤独是无法舒适地和自己相处。

content: That's what I consider true generosity. You give your all, and yet you always feel as if it costs you nothing.
author: 西蒙娜·德·波伏娃
translation: 我认为，真正的慷慨是奉献所有，却仍觉得没有损失分毫。

content: Be as simple as you can be. You'll be astonished to see how uncomplicated and happy your life will be.
author: 《乔布斯》
translation: 尽量简单做自己，你就会惊奇地发现，生活是如此简单而且快乐。

content: Today is your opportunity to build the tomorrow you want.
author: Ken Poirot
translation: 想要创造出明天，今天就是你的机会。

content: Believe you can and you're halfway there.
author: Theodore Roosevelt
translation: 相信自己能成功，你就已经成功了一半。

content: Try to be a rainbow in someone's cloud.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 试着去成为别人乌云里的一道彩虹吧！

content: Change the way you look at things and the things you look at change.
author: Wayne W. Dyer
translation: 改变你看待事物的方式，你所看到的事物也会改变。

content: I have failed many times, and that's why I am a success.
author: 迈克尔·乔丹
translation: 我失败过很多次，这就是我成功的原因。

content: There is an applause superior to that of the multitudes: one's own.
author: Elizabeth Elton Smith
translation: 有一种掌声，比大众的掌声更优裕：那就是你自己给自己鼓的掌。

content: Summer friends will melt away like summer snows, but winter friends are friends forever.
author: 《权力的游戏》
translation: 盛夏的朋友会像盛夏的雪一样融化流逝，但数九寒天的朋友会是永远的朋友。

content: Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
author: 亚里士多德
translation: 忍耐是痛苦的，但果实是甜蜜的。

content: Bear in mind that you should conduct yourself in life as at a feast.
author: Epictetus
translation: 要记住，你在生活中应该表现得像出席宴会一样优雅。

content: We cannot choose the day or time when we will fully bloom. It happens in its own time.
author: Denis Waitley
translation: 我们无法选择自己盛开的时日。时候到了，它就会发生的。

content: A lot of people are afraid to say what they want. That's why they don't get what they want.
author: 麦当娜
translation: 很多人想要却不敢开口，这就是为什么他们想要却得不到。

content: Well-timed silence has more eloquence than speech.
author: Martin Fraquhar Tupper
translation: 适时的静默比雄辩更有说服力。

content: A tiny change today brings a dramatically different tomorrow.
author: Richard Bach
translation: 今天的微小改变，会带来全然不同的明天。

content: Family means no one gets left behind or forgotten.
author: David Ogden Stiers
translation: 家意味着没有人会被落下，或被遗忘。

content: We love life, not because we are used to living but because we are used to loving.
author: 弗里德里希·尼采
translation: 我们热爱生活，并不因为我们习惯了生活，而是因为我们习惯了去热爱。

content: In the midst of winter, I found there was, within me, an invincible summer.
author: 阿尔贝·加缪
translation: 在隆冬，我终于知道，我的内心有一个不可战胜的夏天。

content: Success doesn't come from what you do occasionally. It comes from what you do consistently.
author: Marie Forleo
translation: 成功并不来自你偶然做了什么，而是你一直在做什么。

content: Keep a little fire burning; however small, however hidden.
author: Cormac McCarthy
translation: 让心中的火苗一直燃烧吧，不管那有多微弱，不管藏得有多深。

content: I'm not telling you it is going to be easy, I'm telling you it's going to be worth it.
author: Art Williams
translation: 我不会告诉你这个过程很容易。我只会说，这一切都是值得的。

content: Love is the one thing that transcends time and space.
author: 《星际穿越》
translation: 爱是唯一可以超越时空的东西。

content: No amount of money ever bought a second of time.
author: 《复仇者联盟4：终局之战》
translation: 再多的钱也无法买回逝去的光阴。

content: I celebrate myself, and sing myself.
author: Walt Whitman
translation: 我为自己欢庆，为自己歌唱。

content: Sometimes you gotta get through your fears to see the beauty on the other side.
author: 《恐龙当家》
translation: 有时候，你要克服内心的恐惧，才能看见彼端的美景。

content: You must expect great things of yourself before you can do them.
author: 迈克尔·乔丹
translation: 你必须先见到很棒的自己，才能做出很棒的事。

content: When all else is lost, the future still remains.
author: Christian Nestell Bovee
translation: 即使失去一切，未来仍在。

content: Wisdom is the power to put our time and our knowledge to the proper use.
author: Thomas J. Watson
translation: 所谓智慧，就是合理利用好我们的时间和知识。

content: When we seek to discover the best in others, we somehow bring out the best in ourselves.
author: William Arthur Ward
translation: 当我们努力发掘他人的好时，我们往往也会看到自己最好的一面。

content: Being brave means knowing that when you fail, you don't fail forever.
author: Lana Del Rey
translation: 勇敢就是知道即使你失败了，你也不是永远失败。

content: We are the hero of our own story.
author: Mary McCarthy
translation: 我们都是我们自己故事里的英雄。

content: Promise yourself to be so strong that nothing can disturb your peace of mind.
author: Christian D. Larson
translation: 对自己承诺：要强大到任何事情都无法破坏你内心的平和。 ​​​​

content: An aim in life is the only fortune worth finding.
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
translation: 生活的目标，是唯一值得我们去寻找的财富。

content: Nobody realizes that some people expend tremendous energy merely to be normal.
author: 阿尔贝·加缪
translation: 没有人意识到，有些人花了大量的精力就只是为了做个平常人。

content: It is not in the stars to hold our destiny but in ourselves.
author: 威廉·莎士比亚
translation: 我们的命运是由自己，而不是天上的星星掌握。

content: ㅤ
author: ㅤ
translation: ㅤ

content: The wound is the place where the light enters you.
author: Rumi
translation: 伤口是光照进你内心的地方。

content: Nothing you wear is more important than your smile.
author: Connie Stevens
translation: 不管如何穿戴，都不比带上你的微笑。

content: If you focus on what you left behind, you will never see what lies ahead.
author: 《美食总动员》
translation: 如果你只顾回头看，你就永远无法看到前路有什么。

content: I have always regarded myself as the pillar of my life.
author: 梅丽尔·斯特里普
translation: 我一直认为，我才是我人生的中流砥柱。

content: Nothing great in the world has been accomplished without passion.
author: 黑格尔
translation: 世上没有任何伟业的成就能够离得开激情。

content: Instead of wondering when your next vacation is, maybe you should set up a life you don't need to escape from.
author: Seth Godin
translation: 与其期盼下一次假期，不如创造一种不需要逃离的生活。

content: Many individuals have, like uncut diamonds, shining qualities beneath a rough exterior.
author: Juvenal
translation: 很多人像未经雕琢的钻石，在粗糙的表面下有发光的本质。

content: At the end of the day, let there be no excuses, no explanations, no regrets.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 尘埃落定之时，唯愿不找借口，不言苦衷，不存遗憾。

content: The path to your success is not as fixed and inflexible as you think.
author: Misty Copeland
translation: 成功之路并非你想的那么死板和不可改变。

content: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
author: Seneca
translation: 并不是因为事情难我们才不敢去做，而是因为我们不敢做事情才难。

content: There are far, far better things ahead than any we leave behind.
author: C.S. Lewis
translation: 比起遗落在过去的，未来还有更加美好的在等着我们。

content: Without self-discipline, success is impossible, period.
author: Lou Holtz
translation: 无自律，不成功，就这样。

content: I am seeking, I am striving, I am in it with all my heart.
author: Vincent van Gogh
translation: 我在寻找，我在努力，我全身心地投入其中。

content: You are confined only by the walls you build yourself.
author: Andrew Murphy
translation: 限制你的只有你自己筑起的墙。

content: Life's great happiness is to be convinced we are loved.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 人生最大的幸福，就是确信我们是被人爱着的。

content: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
translation: 我们需要决定的是，如何利用好上天赋予我们的时间。

content: Some people could look at a mud puddle and see an ocean with ships.
author: Zora Neale Hurston
translation: 有些人眼望着泥塘，却能看见千帆竞发的海洋。

content: There is just one life for each of us: our own.
author: Euripides
translation: 我们都只有一种生活可以过：自己的生活。

content: Where you stumble and fall, there you will find gold.
author: Joseph Campbell
translation: 你在哪里跌倒，就会在哪里找到金子。

content: Soon is not as good as now.
author: Seth Godin
translation: 别谈未来，现在就行动。

content: A kind heart is a fountain of gladness, making everything in its vicinity freshen into smiles.
author: Washington Irving
translation: 善良的心就如一口快乐的喷泉，让附近的一切都充满欢笑。

content: Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 自律是连接目标与成功的桥梁。

content: Not being heard is no reason for silence.
author: Victor Hugo
translation: 没有被听见不是沉默的理由。

content: Winning isn't everything, but wanting it is.
author: Arnold Palmer
translation: 胜利并不能代表一切，而求胜心可以。

content: I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
author: Thomas Edison
translation: 我没有失败，我只是找到了10000种行不通的方法。

content: Never look back unless you are planning to go that way.
author: Henry David Thoreau
translation: 永远不要回头，除非你想走回头路。

content: It is the supreme art of the teacher to awaken joy in creative expression and knowledge.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 在创造性表达和知识中唤醒快乐，是教师的最高艺术。

content: We ran as if to meet the moon.
author: Robert Frost
translation: 我们奔跑着，像去约见月亮。

content: The key to winning is poise under stress.
author: Paul Brown
translation: 获胜的关键是在压力下依旧保持镇静。

content: How you think when you lose determines how long it will be until you win.
author: Gilbert Chesterton
translation: 成为输家时的想法决定了你何时才能取得胜利。

content: The most difficult thing is the decision to act, the rest is merely tenacity.
author: Amelia Earhart
translation: 最困难的是下定决心去做，剩下的只是坚持而已。

content: The courage to imagine the otherwise is our greatest resource, adding color and suspense to all our life.
author: Daniel J. Boorstin
translation: 敢有不同想像的勇气，是我们最大的资产，它使我们的人生增添色彩、充满悬念。

content: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
author: Suzy Kassem
translation: 比起失败，怀疑自己会扼杀更多的梦想。

content: A single day is enough to make us a little larger or, another time, a little smaller.
author: Paul Klee
translation: 一天的时间足以使我们强大一些，也可以使我们弱小一些。

content: All my life through, the new sights of Nature made me rejoice like a child.
author: Marie Curie
translation: 在我的一生中，大自然中的新景象使我像孩子般快乐。

content: Whoever is happy will make others happy too.
author: Anne Frank
translation: 快乐的人会让他人也感到快乐。

content: You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.
author: Beverly Sills
translation: 失败可能会让你失望，但若不去尝试，就必定会失败。

content: Before anything else, preparation is the key to success.
author: Alexander Graham Bell
translation: 准备是成功的关键，这比其他任何事情都重要。

content: People who live the most fulfilling lives are the ones who are always rejoicing at what they have.
author: Richard Carlson
translation: 永远对所拥有的一切感到欣喜的人，是生活最富足的人。

content: Dream big and dare to fail.
author: Norman Vaughan
translation: 敢于梦想，不畏失败。

content: Never be limited by other people's limited imaginations.
author: Mae Jemison
translation: 永远不要被别人有限的想象力所限制。

content: Eloquent speech is not from lip to ear, but rather from heart to heart.
author: William Jennings Bryan
translation: 有说服力的演讲并非由口传递到耳，而是由心到心。

content: When someone loves you, the way they talk about you is different. You feel safe and comfortable.
author: Jess C. Scott
translation: 爱你的人谈起你的方式是不一样的，你会觉得安全又舒服。

content: If something is important enough, even if the odds are against you, you should still do it.
author: Elon Musk
translation: 如果一件事情对你很重要，即使成功的概率很小，你也应该去做。

content: The only reward of virtue is virtue; the only way to have a friend is to be one.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 对美德的回报是美德，获得友谊的唯一途径是给人以友谊。

content: The most certain way to succeed is always to try just one more time.
author: Thomas Edison
translation: 保证成功的要诀就是永远都再多试一次。

content: Do what is right, not what is easy nor what is popular.
author: Roy T. Bennett
translation: 做事就要做正确的，不挑易事，不随大流。

content: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
author: Chinese Proverb
translation: 千里之行，始于足下。

content: Nothing great was ever achieved without enthusiasm.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 世界上任何伟业的成就都离不开热情。

content: Courage is doing what you're afraid to do. There can be no courage unless you're scared.
author: Eddie Rickenbacker
translation: 行畏惧之事可谓勇；无畏则无勇。

content: All great achievements require time.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 所有伟大的成就都需要时间的历练。

content: We go where our vision is.
author: Joseph Murphy
translation: 我们的视野有多远，就能走多远。

content: The beginning is the most important part of the work.
author: Plato
translation: 工作中最重要的部分是开始阶段。

content: Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
author: Ovid
translation: 水滴石穿非力之所能为，乃能持之以恒也。

content: If you do not believe you can do it, then you have no chance at all.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 如果你不相信自己能做到，你就永远没有机会做到。

content: Above all, be the heroine of your life, not the victim.
author: Nora Ephron
translation: 成为人生的女主角，而不是受害者，这才是最重要的。

content: Change, like healing, takes time.
author: Veronica Roth
translation: 改变犹如伤口愈合，需要时间。

content: It is easy to live for others, everybody does. I call on you to live for yourself.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 为他人而活很简单，每个人都可以做到。我号召你们为自己而活。

content: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens.
author: Tony DeLiso
translation: 一直怀揣着最美的愿望，倾听内心的声音，再看看会发生什么。

content: The creation of a thousand forests is in one acorn.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 上千森林的形成都源自一颗橡木种子。

content: Knowledge speaks, but wisdom listens.
author: Jimi Hendrix
translation: 知识是倾诉，但智慧是倾听。

content: Beauty begins the moment you decide to be yourself.
author: Coco Chanel
translation: 美，从你下决心做自己的那一刻开始。

content: I believe the target of anything in life should be to do it so well that it becomes an art.
author: Arsene Wenger
translation: 我认为，在生活中，不管做任何事，其目标都应该是将它做到艺术一般完美。

content: Spring is nature's way of saying, "Let's party!"
author: Robin Williams
translation: 春天的到来是大自然在说：“来狂欢吧！”

content: The beautiful journey of today can only begin when we learn to let go of yesterday.
author: Steve Maraboli
translation: 学会放过昨天，才能开启明天的美好旅程。

content: Real change, enduring change, happens one step at a time.
author: Ruth Bader Ginsburg
translation: 真正的改变，持久的变化，都是一步一步完成的。

content: I think part of my gift, or if I have one, is that I love listening.
author: Eric Clapton
translation: 我觉得我的天赋——如果我有天赋的话——就是我热爱倾听。

content: There is no time like Spring, when life's alive in everything.
author: Christina Rossetti
translation: 再没有什么时节像春天一样，万物复苏，充满生机。

content: Sometimes if you want to see a change for the better, you have to take things into your own hands.
author: Clint Eastwoods
translation: 有时当你想看到自己变得更好的时候，你就必须自己动手付出努力。

content: Nothing is pleasanter to me than exploring in a library.
author: Walter Savage Landor
translation: 对我来说，没有什么比探索图书馆更快乐的事情了。

content: I alone cannot change the world, but I can cast a stone across the waters to create many ripples.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 我一人之力并不能改变世界，但我往水面抛一块石头，就能激起许多涟漪。

content: Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
author: Marie Curie
translation: 生活中没有什么东西是可怕的，它们只是需要被理解。

content: Respond to every call that excites your spirit.
author: Rumi
translation: 回应每一个使你精神振奋的呼唤。

content: You cannot change what you are, only what you do.
author: Philip Pullman
translation: 你无法改变你是谁，只能改变你的所作所为。

content: The best way to have a good idea is to have lots of ideas.
author: Linus Pauling
translation: 找到好点子的最佳办法就是多想点子。

content: Everything you've ever wanted is on the other side of fear.
author: George Addair
translation: 你想要的一切都在恐惧的背面。

content: Success is falling nine times and getting up ten.
author: Jon Bon Jovi
translation: 成功就是跌倒九次，第十次仍会站起来。

content: Genius is not that you are smarter than everyone else. It is that you are ready to receive the inspiration.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 天才并不是比其他人聪明，而是时刻准备着迎接灵感的到来。

content: Life is about making an impact, not making an income.
author: Kevin Kruse
translation: 生命在于影响他人，而非赚钱糊口。

content: It's faith that will take you through, and determination that will drive you.
author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett
translation: 信念带你渡过难关，决心为你加油鼓劲。

content: How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
author: Anne Frank
translation: 无需等待就可行动起来，让世界变得更美好——这简直妙不可言！

content: Always do your best. What you plant now, you will harvest later.
author: Og Mandino
translation: 总要竭尽全力。你播种什么，就会收获什么。

content: Too many of us are not living our dreams because we are living our fears.
author: Les Brown
translation: 我们中有太多人没有践行自己的梦想，因为我们活在担心惧怕中。

content: We can't help everyone, but everyone can help someone.
author: Ronald Reagan
translation: 我们不能帮助所有人，但每个人都能帮到别人。

content: If I am walking with two other men, each of them will serve as my teacher.
author: Confucius
translation: 三人行，必有我师焉。

content: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any one thing.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 时刻牢记，渴望成功的决心比任何事情都重要。

content: Care and diligence bring luck.
author: Thomas Fuller
translation: 细心和勤奋能带来好运。

content: It takes a great deal of courage to stand up to your enemies, but a great deal more to stand up to your friends.
author: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
translation: 要挺身而出对抗敌人的确需要很大的勇气，但要挺身而出反抗朋友却需要更大的勇气。

content: Leave nothing for tomorrow which can be done today.
author: Abraham Lincoln
translation: 今天能做的，就不要拖到明天。

content: If you tell the truth, you don't have to remember anything.
author: Mark Twain
translation: 如果你说实话，就不必刻意记住任何事。

content: Two wrongs don't make a right, but they make a good excuse.
author: Thomas Szasz
translation: 两个人都犯了错不能把事情变成对的，但能成为一个好借口。

content: Life's most persistent and urgent question is "What are you doing for others?"
author: Martin Luther King
translation: 生命中最永恒和急迫的问题便是：你能为别人做些什么？

content: It is not beauty that endears, it's love that makes us see beauty.
author: Leo Tolstoy
translation: 并非美丽招人爱，而是爱让我们看到了美丽。

content: Nothing is impossible, the word itself says "I'm possible"!
author: Audrey Hepburn
translation: 没有不可能，连“不可能”这个词自己都说：“不，可能！”

content: You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 创新取之不尽用之不竭，越用越多。

content: Every day brings new choices.
author: Martha Beck
translation: 每一天都会有新的选择。

content: It seems the harder I work, the more luck I have.
author: Thomas Jefferson
translation: 我工作愈加努力，似乎就越幸运。

content: Alone we can do so little; together we can do so much.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 独自一人，我们能做的很少；团结一心，我们能成就很多。

content: Don't watch the clock. Do what it does. Keep going.
author: Sam Levenson
translation: 不要只看时钟，要效仿时钟，一直前行。

content: We become what we think about.
author: Earl Nightingale
translation: 我们思考什么，就会变成什么。

content: Failure is success if you learn from it.
author: Malcom Forbes
translation: 只要能吸取教训，失败也是成功。

content: Look back, and smile on perils past.
author: Walter Scott
translation: 回首往事，向过去的苦难微笑。

content: When you reach the end of your rope, tie a knot in it and hang on.
author: Franklin D. Roosevelt
translation: 哪怕希望快要破灭，也要努力挣扎，坚持下去。

content: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 未经你的许可，没人能让你妄自菲薄。

content: Without a struggle, there can be no progress.
author: Frederick Douglass
translation: 没有奋斗，就没有进步。

content: The fruit derived from labor is the sweetest of pleasures.
author: Luc de Clapiers
translation: 劳动所得的果实是最甜美的。

content: In the depth of winter I finally learned that there was in me an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus
translation: 在隆冬，我终于知道，在我的身体里面，藏着一个无法战胜的夏天。

content: Growth is painful. Change is painful. But nothing is as painful as staying stuck somewhere you don't belong.
author: Mandy Hale
translation: 成长很痛苦，改变很痛苦，但是最痛苦的是卡在你本不应该在的地方。

content: Integrity is the most valuable and respected quality of leadership. Always keep your word.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 诚信是最宝贵和最受尊重的领导品质。永远要信守诺言。

content: One benefit of Summer was that each day we had more light to read by.
author: Jeannette Walls
