translation: 夏天的好处之一便是我们有更多的阳光来阅读。

content: We are no longer happy so soon as we wish to be happier.
author: Walter Savage Landor
translation: 在祈求更快乐的那一刻，我们便不再真正快乐。

content: Never deprive someone of hope; it might be all they have.
author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.
translation: 千万不要剥夺别人的希望，那可能是他们所拥有的全部。

content: In fair weather prepare for foul.
author: Thomas Fuller
translation: 宜未雨绸缪。

content: There are no limits to what you can accomplish, except the limits you place on your own thinking.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 你所能完成的事情没有限制，除非你限制了自己的想法。

content: You may not control all the events that happen to you, but you can decide not to be reduced by them.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 你可能无法控制所有发生在你身上的事，但是你可以决定不被它们所累。

content: If you change the way you look at things, the things you look at change.
author: Wayne Dyer
translation: 如果你改变看事物的方式，事物也会因此而改变。

content: We do not remember days, we remember moments.
author: Cesare Pavese
translation: 我们往往记住的不是某一天，而是某个时刻。

content: Shallow men believe in luck. Strong men believe in cause and effect.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 浅薄者相信运气；有能力的人相信因果。

content: You were not made to live like brute beasts, but to pursue virtue and knowledge.
author: Dante Alighieri
translation: 人不应当像走兽一样活着，而应该追求知识和美德。

content: Be a first rate version of yourself, not a second rate version of someone else.
author: Judy Garland
translation: 做一流的自己，不做二流的别人。

content: The expert in anything was once a beginner.
author: Helen Hayes
translation: 任何领域的专家也曾是一名初学者。

content: Wish not so much to live long as to live well.
author: Benjamin Franklin
translation: 与其希望活得久，不如祈盼过得好。

content: I cannot give you the formula for success, but I can give you the formula for failure—which is: try to please everybody.
author: Herbert Swope
translation: 我不能给你成功的公式，但我可以给你失败的公式，那就是：试图取悦每个人。

content: Never help a child with a task at which he feels he can succeed.
author: Maria Montessori
translation: 当一个孩子觉得自己能成功完成一项任务时，千万别去帮他。

content: We've all got both light and dark inside us. What matters is the part we choose to act on. That's who we really are.
author: J.K. Rowling
translation: 我们心中都有光明和黑暗，但更重要的是我们选择哪一面。这才是我们真正的样子。

content: The wisest mind has something yet to learn.
author: George Santayana
translation: 就连最智慧的人也有东西要学。

content: We can draw lessons from the past, but we cannot live in it.
author: Lyndon B. Johnson
translation: 我们可以从过去学些什么，但不能活在过去。

content: One's destination is never a place, but a new way of seeing things.
author: Henry Miller
translation: 一个人的目的地永远不是某个地方，而是一种看待事物的新方式。

content: The knowledge of the world is only to be acquired in the world, and not in a closet.
author: Lord Chesterfield
translation: 对世界的了解是在世界中获得的，而不是在储物间里。

content: The one thing that doesn't abide by majority rule is a person's conscience.
author: 《杀死一只知更鸟》
translation: 世上唯一不能遵循从众原则的东西，是人的良心。

content: Every artist was first an amateur.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 每个艺术家在一开始都是外行。

content: Live your life as though your every act were to become a universal law.
author: Immanuel Kant
translation: 过好你的生活，就像你的每一个行为都将成为一个普遍规律。

content: Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome.
author: Booker T. Washington
translation: 衡量成功的标准不是看一个人在生活中所处的地位，而是看他所克服的障碍。

content: A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and goes to bed at night and in between does what he wants to do.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 成功的生活就是早上起床，晚上睡觉，白天做自己想做的事。

content: However difficult life may seem, there is always something you can do and succeed at.
author: Stephen Hawking
translation: 无论生活看起来多么困难，总有一些你可以做，并能获得成功的事情。

content: Your life is a reflection of your thoughts. If you change your thinking, you change your life.
author: Brian Tracy
translation: 你的生活是你思维的反映。如果你改变了你的思维，你就改变了你的生活。

content: All the adversity I've had in my life, all my troubles and obstacles, have strengthened me.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 我生命中经历的所有逆境，所有的困难和障碍，都让我变得更强大。

content: Dreams are like stars. You may never touch them, but if you follow them, they will lead you to your destiny.
author: Liam Payne
translation: 梦想就像星星。也许你永远无法触碰，但如果你跟随它们，它们将引领你找到人生的路。

content: The hardships that I encountered in the past will help me succeed in the future.
author: Philip Emeagwali
translation: 我过去遇到的困难将帮助我在未来取得成功。

content: The constant happiness is curiosity.
author: Alice Munro
translation: 求知欲是长久的快乐。

content: True friends are never apart, maybe in distance but never in heart.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 真正的朋友从不分离，也许相距甚远，但心永远相连。

content: Nothing is so strong as gentleness, nothing so gentle as real strength.
author: Saint Francis de Sales
translation: 没有什么比温柔更有力量，也没有什么比真正的力量更温柔。

content: Even a happy life cannot be without a measure of darkness, and the word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
author: Carl Jung
translation: 即使是幸福的生活也不可能没有一丝黑暗，如果没有悲伤来平衡，快乐这个词就会失去意义。

content: Life is partly what we make it, and partly what it is made by the friends we choose.
author: Tennessee Williams
translation: 生活一部分是我们自己创造的，另一部分是由我们选择的朋友造就的。

content: Without the dark there isn't light. Without the pain there is no relief.
author: Jenny Lawson
translation: 没有黑暗，也就没有光明。没有痛苦，也就没有痛苦的缓解。

content: Respect for ourselves guides our morals, respect for others guides our manners.
author: Laurence Sterne
translation: 对自己的尊重引导着我们的品德，对他人的尊重指导着我们的礼仪。

content: One can never consent to creep when one feels an impulse to soar.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 一个人内心有了飞翔的冲动，就不会满足于在地上匍匐。

content: Do not look for happiness outside yourself. The awakened seek happiness inside.
author: Peter Deunov
translation: 不要向外寻找快乐，开悟之人在内心寻找幸福。

content: Knowledge will give you power, but character respect.
author: Bruce Lee
translation: 知识会带给你力量，而品格会带给你他人的尊重。

content: First keep peace with yourself, then you can also bring peace to others.
author: Thomas à Kempis
translation: 首先让自己保持平和，然后你也可以给别人带来平和。

content: A multitude of small delights constitute happiness.
author: Charles Baudelaire
translation: 幸福就是许多小确幸的总和。

content: Hope sees the invisible, feels the intangible, and achieves the impossible.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 拥有希望可以看见他人不可见的，感受他人不能觉知的，并且实现那些不可能的事。

content: The only thing I knew how to do was to keep on keeping on like a bird that flew.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 我唯一会的事情就是像只飞鸟一样继续前进。

content: There is more treasure in books than in all the pirate's loot on Treasure Island.
author: Walt Disney
translation: 书中的宝藏比海盗在金银岛上的所有战利品还要多。

content: Gratitude makes sense of our past, brings peace for today, and creates a vision for tomorrow.
author: Melody Beattie
translation: 感恩之心赋予过去意义，为当下带来平静，为未来创造愿景。

content: One of the most sincere forms of respect is actually listening to what another has to say.
author: Bryant H. McGill
translation: 表达尊重最真诚的方式之一就是真正倾听别人说的话。

content: If you have good thoughts they will shine out of your face like sunbeams and you will always look lovely.
author: Roald Dahl
translation: 你若思想美好，面容就会如阳光般灿烂，看上去永远可爱迷人。

content: True love comes quietly, without banners or flashing lights.
author: Erich Segal
translation: 真爱都是悄然降临，既不旗幡招展，也不灯火辉煌。

content: A great obstacle to happiness is to expect too much happiness.
author: Bernard de Fontenelle
translation: 获得幸福的一大障碍是对幸福期望太高。

content: The verse of Qu Ping shines as bright as sun and moon, while palaces of Chu vanish like dreams at noon.
author: 《江上吟》（许渊冲 译）
translation: 屈平辞赋悬日月，楚王台榭空山丘。

content: The two things in life you are in total control over are your attitude and your effort.
author: Billy Cox
translation: 生活中你可以全权掌控的两件事：你的态度和你付出的努力。

content: True happiness is not attained through self-gratification, but through fidelity to a worthy purpose.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 真正的幸福不是通过自我满足获得的，而是来自于对有价值目标的忠诚。

content: Love is just a word until someone comes along and gives it meaning.
author: Paulo Coelho
translation: 爱不过是一个词而已，直到有一个人来到你面前，赋予它意义。

content: Green was the silence, wet was the light, the month of June trembled like a butterfly.
author: Pablo Neruda
translation: 寂静生碧色，黎明露华浓，六月似蝴蝶在颤动。

content: Storms make trees take deeper roots.
author: Dolly Parton
translation: 暴风雨使得树木的根扎得更深。

content: Passion makes the world go round. Love just makes it a safer place.
author: Ice-T
translation: 热情使世界转动。爱让它成为一个更安全的地方。

content: It is very simple to be happy, but it is very difficult to be simple.
author: Tagore
translation: 快乐很简单，但要做到简单却很困难。

content: If you spend your whole life waiting for the storm, you'll never enjoy the sunshine.
author: Morris West
translation: 如果你一生都在等待暴风雨，你就永远不会享受阳光。

content: It is one thing to be clever and another to be wise.
author: George R.R. Martin
translation: 聪明和智慧是两码事。

content: We are never really happy until we try to brighten the lives of others.
author: Helen Keller
translation: 除非我们努力照亮别人的生活，否则我们永远不会真正快乐。

content: Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for a kindness.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
translation: 哪里有人，哪里就有良善的机会。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: This universe is not outside of you. Look inside yourself; everything that you want, you already are.
author: Rumi
translation: 宇宙并不在你之外。看看自己的内心吧。你想要的一切，都已尽在你身。

content: Neutral men are the devil's allies.
author: Edwin Hubbel Chapin
translation: 中立的人是魔鬼的盟友。

content: Culture makes all men gentle.
author: Menander
translation: 文化使人温文尔雅。

content: Good judgment comes from experience, and a lot of that comes from bad judgment.
author: Will Rogers
translation: 正确的决断源自经验，而大部分经验源自错误的决断。

content: One benefit of Summer was that each day we had more light to read by.
author: Jeannette Walls
translation: 夏天的好处之一便是我们有更多的阳光来阅读。

content: Don't go through life, grow through life.
author: Eric Butterworth
translation: 不要此生匆匆过，但求每日都成长。

content: The quality, not the longevity, of one's life is what is important.
author: Martin Luther King, Jr.
translation: 人重要的并非生命的长度，而是生命的质量。

content: Music is well said to be the speech of angels.
author: Thomas Carlyle
translation: 音乐被赞为天使的语言。

content: Weaknesses are just strengths in the wrong environment.
author: Marianne Cantwell
translation: 弱点不过是优点处在了错误的环境中。

content: If you try to be anyone but yourself, you will fail; if you are not true to your own heart, you will fail.
author: Bob Dylan
translation: 如果你试图成为别人而不是你自己，你将会失败；如果你不忠于自己的内心，你也会失败。

content: How you love yourself is how you teach others to love you.
author: Rupi Kaur
translation: 你爱自己的方式教会了别人如何爱你。

content: That it will never come again is what makes life sweet.
author: Emily Dickinson
translation: 生活不会重来，这正是它美好的原因。

content: Maybe that's what life is: a wink of the eye and winking stars.
author: Jack Kerouac
translation: 或许这就是人生：转瞬即逝，像闪烁的繁星。

content: Nature never did betray a heart that loved her.
author: William Wordsworth
translation: 大自然从不离弃一颗爱她的心。

content: The only thing that matters is the everlasting present.
author: Somerset Maugham
translation: 唯一重要的事情就是永恒的现在。

content: With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt
translation: 全新的一天带给你全新的力量和思想。

content: Attention is vitality. It connects you with others. It makes you eager. Stay eager.
author: Susan Sontag
translation: 专注带来活力。它让你和他人联结起来。它让你求知若渴、步履不停。

content: To free us from the expectations of others, to give us back to ourselves—there lies the great, singular power of self-respect.
author: Joan Didion
translation: 将自己从他人的期待中解放出来，把自己还给自己——这样你就获得了最为伟大、独特的自尊。

content: My big fish must be somewhere.
author: Ernest Hemingway
translation: 一定有属于我的大鱼在什么地方等着。

content: There are no seven wonders of the world in the eyes of a child. There are seven million.
author: Walt Streightiff
translation: 在孩子们眼中，这世上不是只有七大奇迹，而是有七百万种奇迹。

content: The real difficulty is to overcome how you think about yourself.
author: Maya Angelou
translation: 真正的困难是克服你对自己的看法。

content: The only limit to the height of your achievements is the reach of your dreams and your willingness to work hard for them.
author: Michelle Obama
translation: 唯一限制你成就高度的，是你梦想的限度，以及为之努力的意愿。

content: A loving heart is the beginning of all knowledge.
author: Thomas Carlyle
translation: 一颗充满热爱的心是一切知识的起源。

content: You think you know someone. But mostly you just know what you want to know.
author: Joe Hill
translation: 你以为你很了解某个人，但大多时候你了解的只是你想了解的部分。

content: We laughed and kept saying "see you soon", but inside we both knew we'd never see each other again.
author: 《海上钢琴师》
translation: 我们笑着说再见，但我们都心知肚明，再见遥遥无期。

content: Adopting the right attitude can convert a negative stress into a positive one.
author: Hans Selye
translation: 采取正确的态度可以将负面的压力转化为积极的动力。

content: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
author: Mother Teresa
translation: 善良的话语或许很简短，很简单，但产生的回响却是无穷止尽。

content: What lies behind you and what lies in front of you, pales in comparison to what lies inside of you.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
translation: 无论是你的过去，还是将来，与你的内在相比，都微不足道。

content: Success is the sum of small efforts — repeated day in and day out.
author: Robert Collier
translation: 成功就是日复一日那一点点小小努力的积累。

content: Climb mountains not so the world can see you, but so you can see the world.
author: David McCullough Jr.
translation: 爬上山顶并不是为了让世界看到你，而是为了让你看到整个世界。

content: Don't go through life; grow through life.
author: Eric Butterworth
translation: 别只是过活，要通过生活获得成长。

content: Appreciation is a wonderful thing. It makes what is excellent in others belong to us as well.
author: 伏尔泰
translation: 欣赏是一件美妙的事，它让别人的优点也成为我们自己的。

content: Here's to a vacation of no regrets!
author: Joan Rylen
translation: 为无悔的假期干杯！

content: Magic is believing in yourself; if you can do that, you can make anything happen.
author: 歌德
translation: 相信自己是种魔法，能做到这一点，就可以实现任何事。

content: Happiness is not by chance, but by choice.
author: Jim Rohn
translation: 幸福靠的不是运气，而是选择。

content: If life throws you a few bad notes or vibrations, don't let them interrupt or alter your song.
author: Suzy Kassem
translation: 即便生活给了你一些不和谐的音符，也别让它们破坏你的人生之歌。

content: The most wasted of all days is one without laughter.
author: E. E. Cummings
translation: 没有欢笑的一天便最是虚度。

content: One man with courage makes a majority.
author: Andrew Jackson
translation: 若有勇气，一个人抵得上千军万马。

content: Life is a pure flame, and we live by an invisible sun within us.
author: Sir Thomas Browne
translation: 生命是一束纯净的火焰，我们依靠内心看不见的太阳而存在。

content: Life is a beautiful magnificent thing, even to a jellyfish.
author: Charlie Chaplin
translation: 生命美好而壮丽，就算对一只水母来说也是。

content: The cure to boredom is curiosity. There is no cure for curiosity.
author: Dorothy Parker
translation: 无聊的解药是好奇心，但好奇心没有解药。

content: The bravest sight in the world is to see a great man struggling against adversity.
author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca
translation: 世界上最勇敢的景象，便是勇者无畏地与逆境搏斗。

content: You must take life the way it comes at you and make the best of it.
author: Yann Martel
translation: 要接受生活本来的样子，而后尽力而为。

content: Never, never, never give up.
author: Winston Churchill
translation: 不，绝不，永不放弃。

content: We must act out passion before we can feel it.
author: 让-保罗·萨特
translation: 要感受热情，须先表达热情。

content: Love one another, but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls.
author: Kahlil Gibran
translation: 相爱吧！但别让爱成为羁绊，爱应当是两个灵魂间涌动的海洋。

content: The horizon of life is broadened chiefly by means of the enlargement of heart.
author: Hugh Black
translation: 扩展生活的视野，主要靠开阔心胸。

content: Nothing behind me, everything ahead of me, as is ever so on the road.
author: Jack Kerouac
translation: 抛开顾虑，探索未知，永远在路上。

content: To exist is to change, to change is to mature, to mature is to go on creating oneself endlessly.
author: Henri Bergson
translation: 生存就意味着去改变，改变就意味着成熟，而成熟就意味着孜孜不倦地创造自我。

content: If you wish to reach the highest, begin at the lowest.
author: Publilius Syrus
translation: 若想到达最高处，先从最低处做起。

content: Love and a cough cannot be hid.
author: George Herbert
translation: 爱与咳嗽均无法掩藏。

content: Tomorrow belongs to those who can hear it coming.
author: David Bowie
translation: 明天属于那些能听见它来临的人。

content: Changes and progress very rarely are gifts from above. They come out of struggles from below.
author: 诺姆·乔姆斯基
translation: 鲜有改变和进步是上天赐予的，它们来自于自己的苦心奋斗。

content: Never give up. Expect only the best from life and take action to get it.
author: Catherine Pulsifer
translation: 永远不要言弃。要永远只期待最好的事物，并为之付出行动。

content: A book should serve as the ax for the frozen sea within us.
author: Franz Kafka
translation: 书籍是一把利斧，凿开我们内心冰封的海洋。

content: Learn from yesterday, live for today, hope for tomorrow.
author: Albert Einstein
translation: 借鉴昨天，活在今天，憧憬明天。

content: Beauty is how you feel inside, and it reflects in your eyes.
author: Sophia Loren
translation: 美是一种内心的感觉，并反映在你的眼睛里。

content: Love is the master key that opens the gates of happiness.
author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.
translation: 爱是打开幸福之门的万能钥匙。

content: The world spins. We stumble on. It is enough.
author: Colum McCann
translation: 世界快速旋转，我们踉跄前行，就已足够。

content: Reprove thy friend privately; commend him publicly.
author: Solon
translation: 在私下批评你的朋友，在公开场合赞扬他。

content: The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
author: 甘地
translation: 弱者永远不懂宽恕，宽恕是强者的品质。

content: Action is the foundational key to all success.
author: Pablo Picasso
translation: 行动是所有成功的根本。

content: The art of being happy lies in the power of extracting happiness from common things.
author: Henry Ward Beecher
translation: 幸福的诀窍在于能从平凡事物中提取快乐。

content: Children are not things to be molded, but are people to be unfolded.
author: Jess Lair
translation: 孩子不是有待铸造的物料，而是有待启发的人。
